thm:comparison.label: thm:comparison
thm:comparison.reconstruction: Given a particular reversed-output conditional s and lift ℓ, apply universality to b⁻¹ℓπ₂. Pairing 1 with the resulting total g proves h g=ℓg, with h=bτΔ. The existence claim is unconditional on nonzeroness; its proper-join consequence uses nonzeroness and join preservation along Fg.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.comparison_zero_inverse_images
references.source:
theorem comparison_zero_inverse_images (F : RangeFunctor R A) {U : R}
    (τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : U ≅ coprod U U) (P N : Idem (F.toFunctor.obj U))
    (hPN : P ⊓ N = ⊥) (ha0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b) ≤ P)
    (ha1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b) ≤ N)
    (s : F.toFunctor.obj U ⟶ coprod (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U))
    (hs0 : Idem.pull s (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) = N)
    (hs1 : Idem.pull s (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) = P)
    (ℓ : U ⟶ coprod U U)
    (hℓ : F.toFunctor.map ℓ = s ≫ (F.comparison U U).hom) :
    ∃ g : U ⟶ U, isTotal g ∧
      Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) P = ⊥ ∧
      Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) N = ⊥ := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hdiag⟩ := turing_diagonal τ hτ b ℓ
  let D := diag U ≫ τ ≫ b.hom
  let E := F.toFunctor.map g
  let H := F.toFunctor.map D ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv
  have hEH : E ≫ H = E ≫ s := by
    have hd : g ≫ D = g ≫ ℓ := hdiag
    have he := congrArg (fun k => F.toFunctor.map k ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv) hd
    simpa only [F.toFunctor.map_comp, hℓ, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      Category.comp_id] using he
  have hsum0 : Idem.pull (F.comparison U U).inv
      (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      F.mapIdem (summand0 U U) := by
    simpa only [summand0, F.map_top, F.map_bot] using
      F.pull_comparison_inv_sum (⊤ : Idem U) (⊥ : Idem U)
  have hsum1 : Idem.pull (F.comparison U U).inv
      (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      F.mapIdem (summand1 U U) := by
    simpa only [summand1, F.map_top, F.map_bot] using
      F.pull_comparison_inv_sum (⊥ : Idem U) (⊤ : Idem U)
  have he0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b) =
      Idem.pull H (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) := by
    change F.mapIdem (Idem.pull D (summand0 U U)) = _
    rw [F.map_pull, show H = F.toFunctor.map D ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv from rfl,
      Idem.pull_comp, hsum0]
  have he1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b) =
      Idem.pull H (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) := by
    change F.mapIdem (Idem.pull D (summand1 U U)) = _
    rw [F.map_pull, show H = F.toFunctor.map D ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv from rfl,
      Idem.pull_comp, hsum1]
  have h0 : Idem.pull E (F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b)) = Idem.pull E N := by
    rw [he0, ← Idem.pull_comp, hEH, Idem.pull_comp, hs0]
  have h1 : Idem.pull E (F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b)) = Idem.pull E P := by
    rw [he1, ← Idem.pull_comp, hEH, Idem.pull_comp, hs1]
  have hle0 := Idem.pull_mono E ha0
  have hle1 := Idem.pull_mono E ha1
  rw [h0] at hle0
  rw [h1] at hle1
  have hequal := le_antisymm hle1 hle0
  have hzero : Idem.pull E P = ⊥ := by
    have hd := congrArg (Idem.pull E) hPN
    simpa only [Idem.pull_inf, Idem.pull_bot, ← hequal, inf_idem] using hd
  exact ⟨g, hg, hzero, hequal.symm.trans hzero⟩

theorem comparison_noncoverage [BinaryJoins A] (F : RangeFunctor R A) {U : R}
    (g : U ⟶ U) (hg : isTotal g) (P N : Idem (F.toFunctor.obj U))
    (hP : Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) P = ⊥)
    (hN : Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) N = ⊥)
    (hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 U) ≠ 0)
    (hjoin : Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) (P ⊔ N) =
      Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) P ⊔ Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g) N) :
    P ⊔ N ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro hcover
  have he : (⊤ : Idem (F.toFunctor.obj U)) = ⊥ := by
    rw [hcover, Idem.pull_top_of_total _ (F.map_total g hg), hP, hN, sup_idem] at hjoin
    exact hjoin
  apply hU
  rw [F.toFunctor.map_id]
  exact congrArg Idem.hom he

cor:separator.label: cor:separator
cor:separator.reconstruction: A complementary enlargement P,N cannot have the specified reversed conditional and lift simultaneously, by the preceding noncover theorem.

references.source:
theorem no_lifted_complementary_separator [BinaryJoins A] [TotalJoinInverse A]
    (F : RangeFunctor R A) {U : R}
    (τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : U ≅ coprod U U) (hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 U) ≠ 0)
    (P N : Idem (F.toFunctor.obj U)) (hPN : Complementary P N)
    (ha0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b) ≤ P)
    (ha1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b) ≤ N) :
    ¬ ∃ (s : F.toFunctor.obj U ⟶ coprod (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U))
      (ℓ : U ⟶ coprod U U),
      Idem.pull s (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) = N ∧
      Idem.pull s (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) = P ∧
      F.toFunctor.map ℓ = s ≫ (F.comparison U U).hom := by
  rintro ⟨s, ℓ, hs0, hs1, hℓ⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hP, hN⟩ :=
    comparison_zero_inverse_images F τ hτ b P N hPN.disjoint ha0 ha1 s hs0 hs1 ℓ hℓ
  exact comparison_noncoverage F g hg P N hP hN hU
    (TotalJoinInverse.pull_sup _ (F.map_total g hg) P N) hPN.cover

cor:source-conditionals.label: cor:source-conditionals
cor:source-conditionals.reconstruction: If every complementary source pair has total ℓ agreeing with the two switched injections, the diagonal pair is inseparable. Its disjointness follows by inverse image. Agreement after [c,c'] of full range identifies the restrictions of ℓ to the two target summands.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.source_inseparable_of_complementary_conditionals
references.source:
theorem source_inseparable_of_complementary_conditionals
    [BinaryJoins R] [BinaryJoins A] [TotalJoinInverse A]
    (F : RangeFunctor R A) {U : R}
    (τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : U ≅ coprod U U) (hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 U) ≠ 0)
    (conditionals : ∀ c c' : Idem U, Complementary c c' →
      ∃ ℓ : U ⟶ coprod U U, isTotal ℓ ∧
        c.hom ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 U U ∧ c'.hom ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 U U) :
    Inseparable (diagonal0 τ b) (diagonal1 τ b) := by
  constructor
  · rw [diagonal0, diagonal1, ← Idem.pull_inf, summands_disjoint, Idem.pull_bot]
  · rintro ⟨c, c', hc, ha0, ha1⟩
    obtain ⟨ℓ, htotal, h1, h0⟩ := conditionals c c' hc
    have hfib := switch_fibers hc ℓ htotal h1 h0
    let s := F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv
    have hs0 : Idem.pull s (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
        F.mapIdem c' := by
      change Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv) _ = _
      rw [Idem.pull_comp]
      have hsum : Idem.pull (F.comparison U U).inv
          (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
          F.mapIdem (summand0 U U) := by
        simpa only [summand0, F.map_top, F.map_bot] using
          F.pull_comparison_inv_sum (⊤ : Idem U) (⊥ : Idem U)
      rw [hsum, ← F.map_pull, hfib.1]
    have hs1 : Idem.pull s (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
        F.mapIdem c := by
      change Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ (F.comparison U U).inv) _ = _
      rw [Idem.pull_comp]
      have hsum : Idem.pull (F.comparison U U).inv
          (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
          F.mapIdem (summand1 U U) := by
        simpa only [summand1, F.map_top, F.map_bot] using
          F.pull_comparison_inv_sum (⊥ : Idem U) (⊤ : Idem U)
      rw [hsum, ← F.map_pull, hfib.2]
    apply no_lifted_complementary_separator F τ hτ b hU
      (F.mapIdem c) (F.mapIdem c') (F.map_complementary hc)
      (F.map_mono ha0) (F.map_mono ha1)
    refine ⟨s, ℓ, hs0, hs1, ?_⟩
    simp only [s, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

prop:disjoint-joins.label: prop:disjoint-joins
prop:disjoint-joins.reconstruction: If disjoint parallel morphisms admit joins, take ℓ=(i₁c)∨(i₀c'). Upper-bounded branches give the two interpolation equations and force both c,c' below bar ℓ, so ℓ is total.

theorem complementary_conditional_of_disjoint_joins [DisjointArrowJoins C]
    {X : C} (c c' : Idem X) (hc : PairComplementary c c') :
    ∃ ℓ : X ⟶ coprod X X, isTotal ℓ ∧
      c.hom ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 X X ∧ c'.hom ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X ∧
      ∀ h : X ⟶ coprod X X,
        ArrowLE (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) h → ArrowLE (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) h → ArrowLE ℓ h :=
  disjoint_joins_switch c c' hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.disjoint_joins_switch
references.source:
theorem disjoint_joins_switch [DisjointArrowJoins C] {X : C}
    (c c' : Idem X) (hc : PairComplementary c c') :
    ∃ ℓ : X ⟶ coprod X X, isTotal ℓ ∧
      c.hom ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 X X ∧ c'.hom ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X ∧
      ∀ h : X ⟶ coprod X X,
        ArrowLE (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) h → ArrowLE (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) h → ArrowLE ℓ h := by
  have h1 : Idem.ofRestrict (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) = c := by
    apply Idem.ext
    exact (rst_comp_of_isTotal _ (RestrictionCoproducts.total_i1 X X)).trans c.restriction
  have h0 : Idem.ofRestrict (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) = c' := by
    apply Idem.ext
    exact (rst_comp_of_isTotal _ (RestrictionCoproducts.total_i0 X X)).trans c'.restriction
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hl1, hl0, hleast⟩ := DisjointArrowJoins.exists_join
    (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) (by rw [h1, h0, hc.disjoint])
  have hle1 := hl1.domain
  have hle0 := hl0.domain
  rw [h1] at hle1
  rw [h0] at hle0
  have ht : Idem.ofRestrict ℓ = ⊤ :=
    le_antisymm le_top (hc.cover _ hle1 hle0)
  have he1 : c.hom ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 X X := by
    have hh := congrArg Idem.hom h1
    change rst (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) = c.hom at hh
    change rst (c.hom ≫ i1 X X) ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 X X at hl1
    rwa [hh] at hl1
  have he0 : c'.hom ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X := by
    have hh := congrArg Idem.hom h0
    change rst (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) = c'.hom at hh
    change rst (c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X at hl0
    rwa [hh] at hl0
  exact ⟨ℓ, congrArg Idem.hom ht, he1, he0, hleast⟩

prop:interpreted-theory.label: prop:interpreted-theory
prop:interpreted-theory.reconstruction: The image of a sentence conclusion after interpretation is Fhat(t_A), split by Fhat(m_A),Fhat(r_A). In Par(E,Mono) factorization of conclusion through v gives its unique factor through v by regular-image universality. Disjointness of validity and its negated inverse image bounds down to interpreted theorems.

theorem interpreted_theory_equations (G : RangeFunctor C A) {P T S : C}
    (c : P ⟶ S) (m : T ⟶ S) (r : S ⟶ T) (t : Idem S)
    (ht : t = Ranges.range c) (hmr : m ≫ r = 𝟙 T) (hrm : r ≫ m = t.hom) :
    G.mapIdem t = Ranges.range (G.toFunctor.map c) ∧
      G.toFunctor.map r ≫ G.toFunctor.map m = (G.mapIdem t).hom ∧
      G.toFunctor.map m ≫ G.toFunctor.map r = 𝟙 (G.toFunctor.obj T) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Idem.ext
    rw [ht]
    exact G.map_range c
  · change _ = G.toFunctor.map t.hom
    rw [← G.toFunctor.map_comp, hrm]
  · rw [← G.toFunctor.map_comp, hmr, G.toFunctor.map_id]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PartialMaps.interpreted_theory
references.source:
theorem interpreted_theory (G : RangeFunctor C (Par D)) {P T S : C}
    (c : P ⟶ S) (hc : isTotal c) (m : T ⟶ S) (hm : isTotal m)
    (r : S ⟶ T) (t : Idem S) (ht : t = Ranges.range c)
    (hmr : m ≫ r = 𝟙 T) (hrm : r ≫ m = t.hom)
    {V : D} (v : V ⟶ (G.toFunctor.obj S).obj) [Mono v]
    (k : (G.toFunctor.obj P).obj ⟶ V)
    (hfac : k ≫ v = totalValue (G.toFunctor.map c) (G.map_total c hc)) (ν : S ⟶ S) :
    G.mapIdem t = Ranges.range (G.toFunctor.map c) ∧
      G.toFunctor.map r ≫ G.toFunctor.map m = (G.mapIdem t).hom ∧
      G.toFunctor.map m ≫ G.toFunctor.map r = 𝟙 (G.toFunctor.obj T) ∧
      Mono (totalValue (G.toFunctor.map m) (G.map_total m hm)) ∧
      (∃ w : (G.toFunctor.obj T).obj ⟶ V,
        w ≫ v = totalValue (G.toFunctor.map m) (G.map_total m hm)) ∧
      (validityDomain v ⊓ Idem.pull (G.toFunctor.map ν) (validityDomain v) = ⊥ →
        G.mapIdem t ⊓ Idem.pull (G.toFunctor.map ν) (G.mapIdem t) = ⊥) := by
  have he := interpreted_theory_equations G c m r t ht hmr hrm
  have hf := interpreted_theory_subobject G c hc m hm r t ht hmr hrm v k hfac
  refine ⟨he.1, he.2.1, he.2.2, hf.1, hf.2, ?_⟩
  intro hd
  exact interpreted_theory_consistency G c hc t ht ν v k hfac hd

theorem theory_subobject {P T S : Par D}
    (c : P ⟶ S) (hc : isTotal c) (m : T ⟶ S) (hm : isTotal m) (r : S ⟶ T)
    (hmr : m ≫ r = 𝟙 T) (hrm : r ≫ m = (Ranges.range c).hom)
    {V : D} (v : V ⟶ S.obj) [Mono v] (k : P.obj ⟶ V)
    (hfac : k ≫ v = totalValue c hc) :
    Mono (totalValue m hm) ∧ ∃ w : T.obj ⟶ V, w ≫ v = totalValue m hm :=
  ⟨totalValue_mono_of_retraction m hm r hmr,
    theory_subobject_factorization c hc m hm r hmr hrm v k hfac⟩

theorem range_totalValue {X Y : Par D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : isTotal f) :
    Ranges.range f = validityDomain (S := Y) (image.ι (totalValue f hf)) := by
  calc
    Ranges.range f = Ranges.range (ofTotal (totalValue f hf)) :=
      congrArg Ranges.range (ofTotal_totalValue f hf).symm
    _ = _ := range_ofTotal _

thm:logical-comparison.label: thm:logical-comparison
thm:logical-comparison.reconstruction: For split target, nonzero FU, total θ,ν, disjoint interpreted domains, both diagonal inclusions and source lift, apply comparison to obtain total g such that Fhat(θg) pulls theorems and refutations to zero.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.logical_comparison
references.source:
theorem logical_comparison (F : RangeFunctor R A)
    (splittings : ∀ X : SplitObject R, V46.TargetSplitting F X) {U : R}
    (τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : U ≅ coprod U U) (hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 U) ≠ 0)
    {S : SplitObject R} (θ : (splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj U ⟶ S)
    (hθ : isTotal θ) (ν : S ⟶ S) (tA : Idem S)
    (ht : (V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA ⊓
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).toFunctor.map ν)
        ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA) = ⊥)
    (ha0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b) ≤
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtensionInclusionIso F splittings).inv.app U ≫
        (V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map θ)
        ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA))
    (ha1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b) ≤
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtensionInclusionIso F splittings).inv.app U ≫
        (V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map θ)
        (Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map ν)
          ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA)))
    (s : F.toFunctor.obj U ⟶ coprod (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U))
    (hs0 : Idem.pull s (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtensionInclusionIso F splittings).inv.app U ≫
        (V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map θ)
        (Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map ν)
          ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA)))
    (hs1 : Idem.pull s (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtensionInclusionIso F splittings).inv.app U ≫
        (V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map θ)
        ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA))
    (ℓ : U ⟶ coprod U U)
    (hℓ : F.toFunctor.map ℓ = s ≫ (F.comparison U U).hom) :
    ∃ g : U ⟶ U, isTotal g ∧
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map
        ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).map g ≫ θ))
        ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA) = ⊥ ∧
      Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map
        ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).map g ≫ θ))
        (Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map ν)
          ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA)) = ⊥ ∧
      (V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA ⊔
        Idem.pull ((V46.chosenSplitExtension F splittings).map ν)
          ((V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings).mapIdem tA) ≠ ⊤ ∧
      tA ⊔ Idem.pull ν tA ≠ ⊤ := by
  let G := V46.chosenSplitRangeFunctor F splittings
  let E := G.toFunctor
  let I := splittingInclusion (C := R)
  let σ : I ⋙ E ≅ F.toFunctor := V46.chosenSplitExtensionInclusionIso F splittings
  let θ' := σ.inv.app U ≫ E.map θ
  have hθ' : isTotal θ' := isTotal_comp (iso_total (σ.app U).symm) (G.map_total θ hθ)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hp, hn, hnc⟩ := logical_comparison_target F τ hτ b hU
    θ' hθ' (E.map ν) (G.mapIdem tA) ht ha0 ha1 s hs0 hs1 ℓ hℓ
  have hmap : E.map (I.map g ≫ θ) = σ.hom.app U ≫ (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ') := by
    have hnatur := σ.hom.naturality g
    change E.map (I.map g) ≫ σ.hom.app U = σ.hom.app U ≫ F.toFunctor.map g at hnatur
    have hid : σ.hom.app U ≫ σ.inv.app U = 𝟙 _ := (σ.app U).hom_inv_id
    change E.map (I.map g ≫ θ) =
      σ.hom.app U ≫ (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ (σ.inv.app U ≫ E.map θ))
    rw [E.map_comp]
    calc
      E.map (I.map g) ≫ E.map θ =
          (E.map (I.map g) ≫ σ.hom.app U) ≫ (σ.inv.app U ≫ E.map θ) := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (σ.hom.app U), hid, Category.id_comp]
      _ = (σ.hom.app U ≫ F.toFunctor.map g) ≫ (σ.inv.app U ≫ E.map θ) := by
        rw [hnatur]
      _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_, ?_, hnc, source_noncoverage_of_interpretation G tA ν hnc⟩
  · change Idem.pull (E.map (I.map g ≫ θ)) (G.mapIdem tA) = ⊥
    rw [hmap, Idem.pull_comp, hp, Idem.pull_bot]
  · change Idem.pull (E.map (I.map g ≫ θ)) (Idem.pull (E.map ν) (G.mapIdem tA)) = ⊥
    rw [hmap, Idem.pull_comp, hn, Idem.pull_bot]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.logical_comparison_target
references.source:
theorem logical_comparison_target (F : RangeFunctor R A) {U : R}
    (τ : nearProd U U ⟶ U) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : U ≅ coprod U U) (hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 U) ≠ 0)
    {S : A} (θ : F.toFunctor.obj U ⟶ S) (hθ : isTotal θ)
    (ν : S ⟶ S) (t : Idem S) (ht : t ⊓ Idem.pull ν t = ⊥)
    (ha0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 τ b) ≤ Idem.pull θ t)
    (ha1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 τ b) ≤ Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t))
    (s : F.toFunctor.obj U ⟶ coprod (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U))
    (hs0 : Idem.pull s (summand0 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t))
    (hs1 : Idem.pull s (summand1 (F.toFunctor.obj U) (F.toFunctor.obj U)) =
      Idem.pull θ t)
    (ℓ : U ⟶ coprod U U)
    (hℓ : F.toFunctor.map ℓ = s ≫ (F.comparison U U).hom) :
    ∃ g : U ⟶ U, isTotal g ∧
      Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) t = ⊥ ∧
      Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) (Idem.pull ν t) = ⊥ ∧
      t ⊔ Idem.pull ν t ≠ ⊤ := by
  have hd : Idem.pull θ t ⊓ Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← Idem.pull_inf, ht, Idem.pull_bot]
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hP, hN⟩ := comparison_zero_inverse_images F τ hτ b
    (Idem.pull θ t) (Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t)) hd ha0 ha1 s hs0 hs1 ℓ hℓ
  have hgt : isTotal (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) := isTotal_comp (F.map_total g hg) hθ
  have hp : Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) t = ⊥ := by
    rw [Idem.pull_comp]; exact hP
  have hn : Idem.pull (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) (Idem.pull ν t) = ⊥ := by
    rw [Idem.pull_comp]; exact hN
  refine ⟨g, hg, hp, hn, ?_⟩
  intro hc
  have he := TotalJoinInverse.pull_sup (F.toFunctor.map g ≫ θ) hgt t (Idem.pull ν t)
  rw [hc, Idem.pull_top_of_total _ hgt, hp, hn, sup_idem] at he
  apply hU
  rw [F.toFunctor.map_id]
  exact congrArg Idem.hom he

cor:domain-incompleteness.label: cor:domain-incompleteness
cor:domain-incompleteness.reconstruction: For all t≥t₀ disjoint from ν*t, both pullbacks of a complementary enlargement under total θ form a complementary separator of a,b. Thus the two target domains are inseparable and their join proper.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.domain_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem domain_incompleteness [TotalJoinInverse C] {U S : C}
    {a b : Idem U} (hab : Inseparable a b)
    (θ : U ⟶ S) (hθ : isTotal θ) (ν : S ⟶ S) (_hν : isTotal ν)
    (t₀ : Idem S) (ha : a ≤ Idem.pull θ t₀)
    (hb : b ≤ Idem.pull θ (Idem.pull ν t₀))
    (t : Idem S) (ht : t₀ ≤ t) (hconsistent : t ⊓ Idem.pull ν t = ⊥) :
    Inseparable t (Idem.pull ν t) ∧ t ⊔ Idem.pull ν t ≠ ⊤ := by
  have hi : Inseparable t (Idem.pull ν t) := by
    refine ⟨hconsistent, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨c, c', hc, htc, htc'⟩
    exact hab.no_separator ⟨Idem.pull θ c, Idem.pull θ c', hc.pull θ hθ,
      ha.trans (Idem.pull_mono θ (ht.trans htc)),
      hb.trans (Idem.pull_mono θ ((Idem.pull_mono ν ht).trans htc'))⟩
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  intro hcomplete
  exact hi.no_separator ⟨t, Idem.pull ν t, ⟨hconsistent, hcomplete⟩, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

thm:first-order-reflection.label: thm:first-order-reflection
thm:first-order-reflection.reconstruction: Gen is extensive by axioms, monotone by leastness, idempotent since C(A) contains j_!Gen(A). Thus Gen(A)≤T iff A≤T for closed T. On any a:A→S use Γ(a)=Gen(im a); a slice map to a theory mono exists uniquely exactly at the same inequality, giving natural Γ⊣J.

theorem extensive (A : Subobject S) : A ≤ generated proofs A := by
  let k := pullback.lift (axiomProof proofs A) A.arrow (axiomProof_conclusion proofs A)
  simpa only [generated, Subobject.mk_arrow] using
    (Subobject.le_mk_of_comm (k ≫ factorThruImage (conclusion proofs A))
      (by simp [k, conclusion, Category.assoc]))

include proofInitial in

theorem monotone : Monotone (generated proofs) := by
  intro A B h
  exact firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone logical sentence A.arrow B.arrow all imp
    (Subobject.ofLE A B h) (Subobject.ofLE_arrow h)
    (proofs A) (proofInitial A) (proofs B)

include proofInitial in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.FirstOrderReflection.idempotent
references.source:
theorem idempotent (A : Subobject S) :
    generated proofs (generated proofs A) = generated proofs A := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · let k : (generated proofs A : D) ⟶ image (proofs A).a.hom :=
      (imageSubobjectIso (conclusion proofs A)).hom ≫
        sentenceImageToFormula (proofs A).a.hom sentence
    apply generated_le_of_formula_factor proofs proofInitial A (generated proofs A) k
    dsimp only [k]
    rw [Category.assoc, sentenceImageToFormula_over, ← Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun h => h ≫ sentence) (imageSubobject_arrow (conclusion proofs A))
  · exact extensive proofs (generated proofs A)

thm:translation-galois.label: thm:translation-galois
thm:translation-galois.reconstruction: Pull a closed Q-formula subobject back by σ_Φ; rule witnesses preserve closure and include the pulled-back axioms. Extensivity makes the pulled-back sentence subobject a theory. Image–pullback adjunction plus Gen gives σ_#⊣σ*.

theorem inverse_closed (T : Q.Theories) :
    FirstOrderReflection.generated P.proofs ((Subobject.pullback σ.sentence).obj T.val) =
      (Subobject.pullback σ.sentence).obj T.val := by
  let A := (Subobject.pullback σ.sentence).obj T.val
  have h := σ.map_generated_le A T.val (Subobject.pullbackπ σ.sentence T.val)
    (Subobject.isPullback σ.sentence T.val).w
  rw [T.property] at h
  exact le_antisymm ((Subobject.existsPullbackAdj σ.sentence).gc _ _ |>.mp h)
    (FirstOrderReflection.extensive P.proofs A)

prop:deduction-comparison.label: prop:deduction-comparison
prop:deduction-comparison.reconstruction: Assume for every A a conclusion-commuting p_A. Preserving the regular-epi part gives LGen₁A≤Gen₂LA, so their generated closures agree. This yields the commuting Γ square, a natural factorization KJ₁→J₂Lth, and restriction of any right adjoint R to closed theories.

      imageFunctor G σ ⋙ FirstOrderReflection.generation Q.proofs Q.initial :=

    (generation_identity G regularEpis P Q σ proofMap proofConclusion A))

    presentationFunctor G σ ⋙ FirstOrderReflection.presentationGeneration Q.proofs Q.initial =
      FirstOrderReflection.presentationGeneration P.proofs P.initial ⋙ theoryFunctor G P Q σ := by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun a => ?_) (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change FirstOrderReflection.generated Q.proofs (imageSubobject (G.map a.hom ≫ σ)) = _
  rw [image_presentation G σ regularEpis]
  exact (generation_identity G regularEpis P Q σ proofMap proofConclusion _).symm

def inclusionComparison :
    FirstOrderReflection.presentationInclusion P.proofs ⋙ presentationFunctor G σ ⟶
      theoryFunctor G P Q σ ⋙ FirstOrderReflection.presentationInclusion Q.proofs where
  app T := Over.homMk
    (factorThruImageSubobject (G.map T.val.arrow ≫ σ) ≫
      Subobject.ofLE _ _ (FirstOrderReflection.extensive Q.proofs (imageObject G σ T.val)))
    (by
      change (_ ≫ Subobject.ofLE _ _ _) ≫
        (FirstOrderReflection.generated Q.proofs (imageObject G σ T.val)).arrow = _
      rw [Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_arrow, imageSubobject_arrow_comp]
      rfl)
  naturality {X Y} f := FirstOrderReflection.presentation_hom_ext Q.proofs
    (T := (theoryFunctor G P Q σ).obj Y) _ _

thm:free-first-order-adjunction.label: thm:free-first-order-adjunction
thm:free-first-order-adjunction.reconstruction: For arbitrary assignment f:X→S_P, initial syntax gives a unique extension on terms/formulas. List initiality gives ℓ preserving occurrence lists and deletion/concatenation, so empty occurrences give a sentence map. Expected adjunction unit θ_X and counit extending identity on S_P.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SignedFirstOrder.adjunction
references.source:
def adjunction : generation F ⊣ extraction F :=
  Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv {
    homEquiv := homEquiv F
    homEquiv_naturality_left_symm := by
      intro A B T f a
      apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
      apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
      apply FirstOrderPresentation.Axioms.Hom.ext
      symm
      change FirstOrderPresentation.Translation.comp (F.map f.arrow)
          (F.interpretation T.presentation a.arrow) =
        F.interpretation T.presentation (f.arrow ≫ a.arrow)
      apply F.interpretation_unique
      change NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData A.carrier) ≫
          ((F.map f.arrow).sentence ≫ (F.interpretation T.presentation a.arrow).sentence) = _
      simp only [NullaryPresentations.map, Category.assoc,
        NullaryPresentations.interpretation_atom_assoc, NullaryPresentations.interpretation_atom]
    homEquiv_naturality_right := by
      intro A B T f g
      apply Pair.Hom.ext
      change NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData A.carrier) ≫
          (f.hom.hom.translation.sentence ≫ g.hom.hom.translation.sentence) =
        (NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData A.carrier) ≫
          f.hom.hom.translation.sentence) ≫ g.hom.hom.translation.sentence
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm }

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SignedFirstOrder.homEquiv

def homEquiv (A : Pair F) (B : Theories (D := D) (V := V)) :
    (generatedObject F A ⟶ B) ≃ (A ⟶ extractionObject F B) where
  toFun := restrict F
  invFun := extend F
  left_inv h := by
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    apply FirstOrderPresentation.Axioms.Hom.ext
    exact (F.interpretation_unique B.presentation _ h.hom.hom.translation rfl).symm
  right_inv h := by
    apply Pair.Hom.ext
    exact F.interpretation_atom B.presentation h.arrow

references.source:
theorem evaluation_consistent (R : FirstOrderPresentation V) (T : R.Theories)
    (hc : R.Consistent T.val) :
    (F.presentation R.syntaxData.sentenceObject).Consistent
      (theory F T.val ((Subobject.pullback R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation).obj T.val)).val := by
  let τ := F.interpretation R (𝟙 R.syntaxData.sentenceObject)
  have hb : (Subobject.«exists» τ.sentence).obj
      (theory F T.val ((Subobject.pullback R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation).obj T.val)).val ≤
      T.val := by
    apply (interpretation_theory_bound F R (𝟙 _) _ _ T).mpr
    simp only [Subobject.pullback_id, le_refl, and_self]
  have hinv := τ.inverse_consistent T.val hc
  exact FirstOrderPresentation.consistent_of_le _
    ((Subobject.existsPullbackAdj τ.sentence).gc _ _ |>.mp hb) hinv

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SignedFirstOrder.interpretation_theory_bound
references.source:
theorem interpretation_theory_bound (R : FirstOrderPresentation V)
    (f : X ⟶ R.syntaxData.sentenceObject) (a b : Subobject X) (T : R.Theories) :
    (Subobject.«exists» (F.interpretation R f).sentence).obj (theory F a b).val ≤ T.val ↔
      a ≤ (Subobject.pullback f).obj T.val ∧
      b ≤ (Subobject.pullback f).obj
        ((Subobject.pullback R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation).obj T.val) := by
  have hn : (NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData X) ≫
      (F.syntaxData X).sentenceNegation) ≫ (F.interpretation R f).sentence =
      f ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation := by
    calc
      _ = NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData X) ≫
          ((F.syntaxData X).sentenceNegation ≫ (F.interpretation R f).sentence) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData X) ≫
          ((F.interpretation R f).sentence ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation) :=
        congrArg (fun k => NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence (F.syntaxData X) ≫ k)
          (F.interpretation R f).sentence_negation
      _ = f ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceNegation := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, F.interpretation_atom]
  rw [image_theory_le_iff, image_axioms_le_iff, F.interpretation_atom, hn,
    Subobject.pullback_comp]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NullaryInterpretation.translation
references.source:
def translation (R : FirstOrderPresentation V) (a : X ⟶ R.syntaxData.sentenceObject) :
    FirstOrderPresentation.Translation (presentation S proofs initial) R where
  term := (interpretation S R.syntaxData a).1
  formula := (interpretation S R.syntaxData a).2
  sentence := sentenceInterpretation S R.syntaxData a
  variable_law := variable_law S R.syntaxData a
  equality := equality S R.syntaxData a
  negation := negation S R.syntaxData a
  implication := implication S R.syntaxData a
  quantifier := quantifier S R.syntaxData a
  term_substitution := term_substitution S R.syntaxData a
  substitution := ⟨admissibleInterpretation S R.syntaxData a,
    admissibleInterpretation_inclusion S R.syntaxData a,
    admissibleInterpretation_result S R.syntaxData a⟩
  sentences := (sentenceInterpretation_inclusion S R.syntaxData a).symm
  logical_axioms := ⟨logicalParameterMap S R.syntaxData a,
    logical_axioms_comparison S R.syntaxData a⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NullaryInterpretation.translation_unique
references.source:
theorem translation_unique (R : FirstOrderPresentation V) (a : X ⟶ R.syntaxData.sentenceObject)
    (τ : FirstOrderPresentation.Translation (presentation S proofs initial) R)
    (ha : atomSentence S ≫ τ.sentence = a) : τ = translation S proofs initial R a := by
  have hatom : atomFormula S ≫ τ.formula = a ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion := by
    calc
      atomFormula S ≫ τ.formula = (atomSentence S ≫ S.sentenceInclusion) ≫ τ.formula :=
        congrArg (fun k => k ≫ τ.formula) (atomSentence_inclusion S).symm
      _ = (atomSentence S ≫ τ.sentence) ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          ((congrArg (fun k => atomSentence S ≫ k) τ.sentences).trans
            (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)
      _ = a ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion :=
        congrArg (fun k => k ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion) ha
  have h := unique S R.syntaxData a (τ.term, τ.formula) τ.variable_law τ.equality
    hatom τ.negation τ.implication τ.quantifier
  apply FirstOrderPresentation.Translation.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h) (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  apply (cancel_mono R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion).mp
  calc
    τ.sentence ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion = S.sentenceInclusion ≫ τ.formula :=
      τ.sentences.symm
    _ = S.sentenceInclusion ≫ (interpretation S R.syntaxData a).2 :=
      congrArg (fun k => S.sentenceInclusion ≫ k) (congrArg Prod.snd h)
    _ = (translation S proofs initial R a).sentence ≫ R.syntaxData.sentenceInclusion :=
      (sentenceInterpretation_inclusion S R.syntaxData a).symm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NullaryInterpretation.formula_substitution_option
references.source:
theorem formula_substitution_option :
    S.formulaSubstitutionOption ≫ OptionSyntax.map (interpretation S Q f).2 =
      prod.map (interpretation S Q f).2 (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) ≫
        Q.formulaSubstitutionOption := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ prod.snd) (formula_pair_fold_comparison S Q f)
  have hs : S.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd ≫
      OptionSyntax.map (interpretation S Q f).2 =
      prod.map (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) (interpretation S Q f).2 ≫
        Q.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd := by
    simpa [substitutionCarrierMap, interpretedFormulaPair, Category.assoc] using h
  have hb : (prod.braiding S.algebra.a.2 S.substitutionParameters).hom ≫
      prod.map (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) (interpretation S Q f).2 =
      prod.map (interpretation S Q f).2 (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) ≫
        (prod.braiding Q.algebra.a.2 Q.substitutionParameters).hom := by
    apply prod.hom_ext <;> simp [prod.braiding_hom]
  calc
    S.formulaSubstitutionOption ≫ OptionSyntax.map (interpretation S Q f).2 =
        (prod.braiding S.algebra.a.2 S.substitutionParameters).hom ≫
          (S.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd ≫
            OptionSyntax.map (interpretation S Q f).2) := by
      simp only [CategoricalSyntax.formulaSubstitutionOption, Category.assoc]
    _ = (prod.braiding S.algebra.a.2 S.substitutionParameters).hom ≫
        (prod.map (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) (interpretation S Q f).2 ≫
          Q.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd) := congrArg (fun k => _ ≫ k) hs
    _ = ((prod.braiding S.algebra.a.2 S.substitutionParameters).hom ≫
        prod.map (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) (interpretation S Q f).2) ≫
          Q.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = prod.map (interpretation S Q f).2 (substitutionParameterMap S Q f) ≫
        Q.formulaSubstitutionOption := by
      rw [hb]
      simp only [CategoricalSyntax.formulaSubstitutionOption, Category.assoc]

def admissibleInterpretation : S.admissibleSubstitution ⟶ Q.admissibleSubstitution :=
  pullback.lift
    (S.admissibleInclusion ≫
      prod.map (interpretation S Q f).2 (substitutionParameterMap S Q f))
    (S.formulaSubstitution ≫ (interpretation S Q f).2) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, ← formula_substitution_option S Q f,
        ← Category.assoc, S.formulaSubstitution_square, Category.assoc, OptionSyntax.map_ok]
      simp only [Category.assoc])

theorem morphism_bound_iff {A B : ConsistentTheoryCategory (D := D) (V := V)}
    (σ : A.presentation.Translation B.presentation) :
    (Subobject.«exists» σ.sentence).obj A.theory.val ≤ B.theory.val ↔
      (σ.pushforward.obj A.theory).val ≤ B.theory.val := by
  change (Subobject.«exists» σ.sentence).obj A.theory.val ≤ B.theory.val ↔
    FirstOrderReflection.generated B.presentation.proofs
      ((Subobject.«exists» σ.sentence).obj A.theory.val) ≤ B.theory.val
  exact (FirstOrderReflection.generated_le_iff B.presentation.proofs
    B.presentation.initial _ B.theory).symm

@[reassoc] theorem substitution_value :
    S.formulaSubstitution ≫ valuation S d =
      S.admissibleInclusion ≫ prod.fst ≫ valuation S d := by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => S.admissibleInclusion ≫ f) (substitution_option_value S d)
  rw [← Category.assoc, S.formulaSubstitution_square, Category.assoc,
    OptionSyntax.map_ok, OptionSyntax.mask_precomp, S.formulaSubstitution_square,
    OptionSyntax.mask_ok] at h
  exact (cancel_mono (coprod.inr : Two D ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj (Two D))).mp (by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h)

@[reassoc] theorem logical_axioms_value :
    S.logicalAxioms ≫ valuation S d = Two.constant _ true := by
  unfold CategoricalSyntax.logicalAxioms
  dsimp only [CategoricalSyntax.logicalParameters]
  apply coprod.hom_ext
  · apply coprod.hom_ext
    · apply coprod.hom_ext
      · apply coprod.hom_ext
        · apply coprod.hom_ext
          · apply coprod.hom_ext
            · simp [hilbert_one_value, Two.constant]
            · simp [hilbert_two_value, Two.constant]
          · simp [hilbert_three_value, Two.constant]
        · simp [hilbert_instantiation_value, Two.constant]
      · simp [hilbert_distribution_value, Two.constant]
    · simp [hilbert_reflexivity_value, Two.constant]
  · simp [hilbert_equality_value, Two.constant]

def truthAlgebra {A : D} (a : A ⟶ S.sentenceObject)
    (ha : a ≫ S.sentenceInclusion ≫ valuation S d = Two.constant A true) :
    Endofunctor.Algebra (S.logicalRules a).inference where
  a := Over.mk (trueInclusion S d)
  str := Over.homMk (Sigma.desc fun i => equalizer.lift
    ((S.logicalRules a).ruleConclusion (Over.mk (trueInclusion S d)) i)
    (by rw [rule_value S d a ha i, Two.comp_constant])) (by
      apply Sigma.hom_ext
      intro i
      simp [RulePresentation.inference])

references.source:
theorem sentence_closed :
    FirstOrderReflection.generated proofs (sentenceTheory S d) = sentenceTheory S d := by
  have ha : (sentenceTheory S d).arrow ≫ S.sentenceInclusion ≫ valuation S d =
      Two.constant _ true := Two.fiber_arrow_value (sentenceValue S d) true
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (firstOrder_least_image S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion
    (sentenceTheory S d).arrow S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor
    (proofs (sentenceTheory S d)) (initial _)).2
      (trueInclusion S d) (truth_closed S d _ ha)
  have hf : imageSubobject (proofs (sentenceTheory S d)).a.hom ≤
      Two.fiberSubobject (valuation S d) true := Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm w hw
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [FirstOrderReflection.generated_eq_pullback]
    change (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceInclusion).obj
      (imageSubobject (proofs (sentenceTheory S d)).a.hom) ≤ _
    have hb := (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceInclusion).monotone hf
    simpa only [← Two.fiberSubobject_comp, sentenceTheory, sentenceValue] using hb
  · exact FirstOrderReflection.extensive proofs (sentenceTheory S d)

def orderIso (X : Tot C) : Subobject X ≃o Idem X.obj where
  toEquiv := Equiv.ofBijective (domain h) ⟨domain_injective h, domain_surjective h X⟩
  map_rel_iff' := domain_le_iff h _ _

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.RestrictionSubobjects.inseparable_iff
references.source:
theorem inseparable_iff (a b : Subobject X) :
    Inseparable (domain h a) (domain h b) ↔ SubobjectInseparable a b := by
  let e := orderIso h X
  have he (A : Subobject X) : e A = domain h A := rfl
  constructor
  · intro hi
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · apply e.injective
      simpa only [e.map_inf, e.map_bot, he] using hi.disjoint
    · rintro ⟨p, ha, hb⟩
      exact hi.no_separator ⟨domain h p.positive, domain h p.negative,
        (complementary_iff h _ _).mpr p.complementary,
        (domain_le_iff h _ _).mpr ha, (domain_le_iff h _ _).mpr hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hs⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [e.map_inf, e.map_bot, he] using congrArg e hd
    · rintro ⟨c, c', hc, ha, hb⟩
      have hp : Complementary (domain h (e.symm c)) (domain h (e.symm c')) := by
        change Complementary (e (e.symm c)) (e (e.symm c'))
        simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hc
      apply hs
      refine ⟨⟨e.symm c, e.symm c', (complementary_iff h _ _).mp hp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply (domain_le_iff h _ _).mp
        change e a ≤ e (e.symm c)
        simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply, he] using ha
      · apply (domain_le_iff h _ _).mp
        change e b ≤ e (e.symm c')
        simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply, he] using hb

lem:partial-slice-turing.label: lem:partial-slice-turing
lem:partial-slice-turing.reconstruction: General lemma: completed category and partial slices are Turing, restricted constant objects from the original R form a recursion category and generate the split slice. Terminality in the split category follows by factoring through the domain of each f.

theorem parameter_total {W : R} (V : SplitObject R) (g : V.base ⟶ W)
    (hg : isTotal g) :
    @PCategoryStruct.rst (SplitObject R) inferInstance productData
      V ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj W) (parameter V g) = 𝟙 V := by
  rw [productData_restriction]
  apply Hom.ext
  change CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst (V.domain.hom ≫ g) = V.domain.hom
  rw [rst_comp_of_isTotal _ hg, V.domain.restriction]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SplitTuring.evaluator_isTuring
references.source:
theorem evaluator_isTuring {W : R} (X Y : SplitObject R)
    (τ : nearProd W X.base ⟶ Y.base) (hτ : IsTuringMorphism τ) :
    IsTuringMorphism (evaluator X Y τ) := by
  intro V φ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hcode⟩ := hτ V.base φ.hom
  refine ⟨parameter V g, parameter_total V g hg, ?_⟩
  apply Hom.ext
  change nearProd_map (V.domain.hom ≫ g) X.domain.hom ≫
    (nearProd_map (𝟙 W) X.domain.hom ≫ τ ≫ Y.domain.hom) = φ.hom
  calc
    _ = (nearProd_map (V.domain.hom ≫ g) X.domain.hom) ≫ τ ≫ Y.domain.hom := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, PCategory.nearProd_comp, Category.comp_id, X.domain.idem]
    _ = nearProd_map V.domain.hom X.domain.hom ≫
        (nearProd_map g (𝟙 X.base) ≫ τ) ≫ Y.domain.hom := by
      simp only [← Category.assoc, PCategory.nearProd_comp, Category.comp_id]
    _ = φ.hom := by
      rw [hcode]
      change (binaryProduct V X).domain.hom ≫ φ.hom ≫ Y.domain.hom = φ.hom
      have hs : (binaryProduct V X).domain.hom ≫ φ.hom = φ.hom := φ.source
      rw [← Category.assoc, hs, φ.target]

theorem turing_object (T : PRecursionCategory R) :
    ∃ (Q : SplitObject R) (τ : nearProd Q Q ⟶ Q),
      IsTuringMorphism τ ∧
      ∀ X : SplitObject R, ∃ (m : X ⟶ Q) (r : Q ⟶ X),
        isTotal m ∧ m ≫ r = 𝟙 X := by
  let Q := (splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj T.W
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := turingFamily T Q Q
  exact ⟨Q, τ, hτ, exists_total_retract T.W⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SplitSliceTuring.turing_object
references.source:
theorem turing_object (rec : PRecursionCategory R) :
    let Q := (splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj rec.W
    ∃ τ : nearProd Q Q ⟶ Q, IsTuringMorphism τ ∧
      @IsTuringMorphism (PartialMaps.Par (Over T)) inferInstance
        (PartialSliceProducts.pcategoryStruct inverses T)
        (PartialSliceProducts.pcategoryLaws inverses T)
        (PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T Q) (PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T Q)
        (PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T Q) (SliceProductTuring.evaluator inverses T τ) ∧
      ∀ X : PartialMaps.Par (Over T),
        ∃ (j : X ⟶ PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T Q)
          (s : PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T Q ⟶ X),
          isTotal j ∧ j ≫ s = 𝟙 X ∧ s ≫ j = CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst s := by
  dsimp only
  let Q := (splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj rec.W
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := SplitTuring.turingFamily rec Q Q
  have hQ : ∀ Y : SplitObject R, ∃ (m : Y ⟶ Q) (r : Q ⟶ Y),
      isTotal m ∧ m ≫ r = 𝟙 Y := by
    intro Y
    obtain ⟨m, r, hm, hmr⟩ := SplitTuring.exists_total_retract rec.W Y
    refine ⟨m, r, ?_, hmr⟩
    change @PCategoryStruct.rst (SplitObject R) inferInstance SplitObject.productData Y Q m = 𝟙 Y
    rw [SplitObject.productData_restriction]
    exact hm
  exact ⟨τ, hτ, SliceProductTuring.evaluator_isTuring inverses T τ hτ,
    PartialSliceRetractions.exists_total_retract inverses T hQ⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SliceTuringParameters.total_retract_over
references.source:
theorem total_retract_over (inverses : MonoInverses C) {X T Q : C}
    (p : X ⟶ T) (hp : isTotal p) (m : X ⟶ Q) (hm : isTotal m)
    (r : Q ⟶ X) (hmr : m ≫ r = 𝟙 X) :
    ∃ (j : X ⟶ nearProd T Q) (s : nearProd T Q ⟶ X),
      isTotal j ∧ j ≫ p0 T Q = p ∧ j ≫ s = 𝟙 X ∧ s ≫ j =
        CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst s ∧
      s ≫ p = CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst s ≫ p0 T Q := by
  let j := partialPairing p m
  have hj : isTotal j := PCategory.isTotal_partialPairing hp hm
  have hj0 : j ≫ p0 T Q = p := PCategory.p0_partialPairing_of_isTotal p hm
  have hjr : j ≫ (p1 T Q ≫ r) = 𝟙 X := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, PCategory.p1_partialPairing_of_isTotal m hp, hmr]
  let j' : (⟨X⟩ : Tot C) ⟶ ⟨nearProd T Q⟩ := ⟨j, hj⟩
  have : Mono j' := by
    constructor
    intro Z f g he
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    have hh := congrArg (fun k => k.hom ≫ (p1 T Q ≫ r)) he
    change (f.hom ≫ j) ≫ (p1 T Q ≫ r) = (g.hom ≫ j) ≫ (p1 T Q ≫ r) at hh
    simpa only [Category.assoc, hjr, Category.comp_id] using hh
  let s := inverse inverses j'
  have hs : s ≫ j = CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst s := inverse_hom inverses j'
  refine ⟨j, s, hj, hj0, hom_inverse inverses j', hs, ?_⟩
  rw [← hj0, ← Category.assoc, hs]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ConstantSlice.dense
references.source:
theorem dense (Q : R) (X : AmbientPartialSlice.Family T.obj) :
    ∃ (Y : ConstantCategory T.obj) (j : X ⟶ (inclusion T.obj).obj Y)
      (s : (inclusion T.obj).obj Y ⟶ X),
      isTotal j ∧ j ≫ s = 𝟙 X ∧ s ≫ j = rst s := by
  obtain ⟨m, r, hm, hmr⟩ := SplitTuring.exists_total_retract Q X.base
  have hm' : isTotal m := by
    change @PCategoryStruct.rst (SplitObject R) inferInstance SplitObject.productData _ _ m = _
    rw [SplitObject.productData_restriction]
    exact hm
  obtain ⟨j, s, hj, hj0, hjs, hsj, hs0⟩ := SliceTuringParameters.total_retract_over
    inverses X.proj X.total m hm' r hmr
  let j' : X ⟶ (inclusion T.obj).obj (Q : ConstantCategory T.obj) := ⟨j, by
    change j ≫ p0 T.obj _ = CategoryTheory.RestrictionCategory.rst j ≫ X.proj
    rw [hj0, hj, Category.id_comp]⟩
  let s' : (inclusion T.obj).obj (Q : ConstantCategory T.obj) ⟶ X := ⟨s, hs0⟩
  exact ⟨Q, j', s', (AmbientPartialSlice.total_iff j').mpr hj,
    AmbientPartialSlice.Hom.ext hjs, AmbientPartialSlice.Hom.ext hsj⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ConstantSlice.Full.recursionCategory

@[instance_reducible] def recursionCategory (rec : PRecursionCategory R) (T : SplitObject R) :
    @PRecursionCategory (FullCategory T) inferInstance (productData T) (productLaws T)
      inferInstance (prodominical T) (isotype T) := by
  let : PCategoryStruct (FullCategory T) := productData T
  let : PCategory (FullCategory T) := productLaws T
  let : Prodominical (FullCategory T) := prodominical T
  exact {
    W := object T rec.W
    X := object T rec.W
    Y := object T rec.W
    tau := Classical.choose (exists_evaluator rec T)
    is_turing := Classical.choose_spec (exists_evaluator rec T)
  }

theorem actualInclusion_range (Z : PartialMaps.Par (Over T)) :

theorem reindex_eq_spanPullback : reindex i inverses = spanPullback i := by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) ?_
  intro X Y f
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  induction f using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ s =>
    change (reindex i inverses).map (PartialMaps.ofSpan s) =
      (spanPullback i).map (PartialMaps.ofSpan s)
    rw [PartialMaps.ofSpan_factorization s, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, reindex_inverseMono i inverses, reindex_ofTotal i inverses]
    change _ = (PartialMaps.inducedFunctor (Over.pullback i)).map _ ≫
      (PartialMaps.inducedFunctor (Over.pullback i)).map _
    rw [PartialMaps.inducedFunctor_inverseMono, PartialMaps.inducedFunctor_ofTotal]

theorem theory_bound (t : T ⟶ S) (u : U ⟶ S) [Mono t] [Mono u] (ht : i ≫ u = t) :
    sourceTheorySubobject inverses t ≤ pulledTheorySubobject inverses i u := by
  let := total_mono (sourceTheory inverses t) (constant_mono inverses T t)
  let hm := mono_of_retraction _ _ (pulledTheory_section inverses i u)
  let := total_mono (pulledTheory inverses i u) hm
  change Subobject.mk (sourceTheory inverses t) ≤ Subobject.mk (pulledTheory inverses i u)
  let w : constantTotal T T.obj ⟶ (⟨(PartialSliceChangeBase.reindex i inverses).obj
      (PartialSliceTuring.constantObject U U.obj)⟩ : TotalSlice T) :=
    ⟨theoremComparison inverses i, theoremComparison_total inverses i⟩
  apply Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm w
  apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
  change theoremComparison inverses i ≫
      ((PartialSliceChangeBase.reindex i inverses).map ((constantFunctor inverses U).map u.hom) ≫
        (sentenceIso inverses i S.obj).inv) = (constantFunctor inverses T).map t.hom
  have ht' : i.hom ≫ u.hom = t.hom := congrArg (fun k => k.hom) ht
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← theorem_square inverses i t.hom u.hom ht', Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

theorem associated_incompleteness (U : P.Theories) (hcU : P.Consistent U.val) :
    (P.EssentiallyIncomplete U ↔
      AssociatedClosedTheories.EssentiallyIncomplete P (U.val : Tot C) (Q (U.val : Tot C))
        (constantTheory P (U.val : Tot C) (Q (U.val : Tot C)) (hQ (U.val : Tot C)) U)) ∧
    (¬ P.Complete U.val ↔
      ¬ isTotal ((PartialSliceTheoryFamilies.constantFunctor inverses (U.val : Tot C)).map
        (theoryDecision inverses P U.val hcU))) ∧
    (SubobjectInseparable U.val ((Subobject.pullback P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation).obj U.val) ↔
      ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension
        ((PartialSliceTheoryFamilies.constantFunctor inverses (U.val : Tot C)).map
          (theoryDecision inverses P U.val hcU))) := by
  obtain ⟨point, _⟩ := factors U hcU
  exact ⟨essential_incomplete_iff P (U.val : Tot C) (Q (U.val : Tot C))
      (hQ (U.val : Tot C)) point hZ U hcU,
    incomplete_iff_decision_not_total inverses P U.val hcU point hZ,
    subobject_inseparable_iff_no_total_extension inverses P U.val hcU point hZ⟩

include hQ factors hZ in

theorem essential_incomplete_iff (T : P.Theories) (hc : P.Consistent T.val) :
    P.EssentiallyIncomplete T ↔ EssentiallyIncomplete P U Q (constantTheory P U Q hQ T) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨SliceSubobjectPredicates.constant_consistency U
      P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation T.val hc, ?_⟩
    intro W hTW hcW hcompW
    let W₀ := evaluationTheory P U Q hQ point hZ W
    have hbound : T.val ≤ W₀.val := by
      have hb := SliceSubobjectPredicates.evaluate_monotone point hZ hTW
      rw [constantTheory_value, SliceSubobjectPredicates.evaluate_constant] at hb
      exact hb
    exact h.2 W₀ hbound
      (SliceSubobjectPredicates.evaluate_consistency point hZ
        P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation W.val hcW)
      (SliceSubobjectPredicates.evaluate_completeness point hZ
        P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation W.val hcompW)
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    intro W hTW hcW hcompW
    exact h.2 (constantTheory P U Q hQ W)
      (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_monotone (constantFamilyFunctor U) hTW)
      (SliceSubobjectPredicates.constant_consistency U P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation W.val hcW)
      (SliceSubobjectPredicates.constant_completeness U P.syntaxData.sentenceNegation W.val hcompW)

theorem closed_back (W : Subobject (B.obj S))
    (hW : FirstOrderReflection.generated sliceProofs W = W) :
    FirstOrderReflection.generated proofs (backObject B E e W) = backObject B E e W := by
  let A := backObject B E e W
  let m := image.ι (sliceProofs W).a.hom
  let τ := RetractedRuleComparison.translation B E e logical sentence all imp W A
    (axiomMap B E e W) (axiomMap_law B E e W)
  have hc := FirstOrderReflection.formula_closed sliceProofs sliceInitial W
  have he := FiniteRuleTransport.map_closed E
    (firstOrderRules (B.map logical) (B.map sentence) W.arrow
      (FirstOrderRuleTransport.mappedAll B all) (FirstOrderRuleTransport.mappedImp B imp)) m hc
  have hr := τ.closed_pullback (E.map m) he
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (firstOrder_least_image logical sentence A.arrow all imp
    (proofs A) (proofInitial A)).2 (pullback.snd (E.map m) (e.inv.app F)) hr
  have hg : FirstOrderReflection.generated proofs A ≤
      (Subobject.pullback sentence).obj
        (Subobject.mk (pullback.snd (E.map m) (e.inv.app F))) := by
    rw [FirstOrderReflection.generated_eq_pullback]
    exact (Subobject.pullback sentence).monotone (Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm w hw)
  have hs : sentence ≫ e.inv.app F = e.inv.app S ≫ E.map (B.map sentence) :=
    e.inv.naturality sentence
  have hws : (Subobject.pullback (B.map sentence)).obj
      (FirstOrderReflection.formulaTheory sliceProofs W) = W :=
    (FirstOrderReflection.generated_eq_pullback sliceProofs W).symm.trans hW
  have ha : A = (Subobject.pullback sentence).obj
      (Subobject.mk (pullback.snd (E.map m) (e.inv.app F))) := by
    calc
      A = (Subobject.pullback (e.inv.app S)).obj
          (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E ((Subobject.pullback (B.map sentence)).obj
            (FirstOrderReflection.formulaTheory sliceProofs W))) :=
        congrArg (fun T => (Subobject.pullback (e.inv.app S)).obj
          (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E T)) hws.symm
      _ = _ := by
        rw [FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_pullback, ← Subobject.pullback_comp,
          ← hs, Subobject.pullback_comp]
        change (Subobject.pullback sentence).obj
          ((Subobject.pullback (e.inv.app F)).obj
            (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E (Subobject.mk m))) = _
        rw [FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_mk,
          Subobject.pullback_obj_mk (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (E.map m) (e.inv.app F))]
  exact le_antisymm (hg.trans_eq ha.symm) (FirstOrderReflection.extensive proofs A)

def comparison (U : Tot C) : constantFamilyFunctor U ≅ actualConstant U :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (component U) (by
    intro X Y f
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply (nearProductLimit U Y).hom_ext
    rintro ⟨j⟩
    cases j
    · change (prod.map (𝟙 U) f ≫ (productIso U Y).hom) ≫
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductFst U Y =
        ((productIso U X).hom ≫ ((actualConstant U).map f).left) ≫
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductFst U Y
      rw [Category.assoc, productIso_fst, prod.map_fst, Category.comp_id]
      have hp : ((actualConstant U).map f).left ≫ TotalSubcategory.binaryProductFst U Y =
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductFst U X := by
        apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
        change PCategoryStruct.nearProd_map (𝟙 U.obj) f.hom ≫
          PCategoryStruct.p0 U.obj Y.obj = PCategoryStruct.p0 U.obj X.obj
        simpa only [Category.comp_id] using PCategory.p0_nat_of_isTotal (𝟙 U.obj) f.property
      rw [Category.assoc, hp, productIso_fst]
    · change (prod.map (𝟙 U) f ≫ (productIso U Y).hom) ≫
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductSnd U Y =
        ((productIso U X).hom ≫ ((actualConstant U).map f).left) ≫
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductSnd U Y
      rw [Category.assoc, productIso_snd, prod.map_snd, Category.assoc]
      have hp : ((actualConstant U).map f).left ≫ TotalSubcategory.binaryProductSnd U Y =
          TotalSubcategory.binaryProductSnd U X ≫ f := by
        apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
        exact PCategory.p1_nat_of_isTotal f.hom (rst_id U.obj)
      rw [hp, ← Category.assoc, productIso_snd])

def translation :
    (rules n' i' W).Translation (FiniteRuleTransport.mappedRules K (rules n i A)) where
  formula := σ
  map := Fin.cases (coprod.desc (logicalMap K p q ≫ K.map coprod.inl) (k ≫ K.map coprod.inr))
    (Fin.cases (initial.to _) (Fin.cases p (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)))
  premises j := by
    fin_cases j
    · exact terminal.hom_ext _ _
    · exact initial.hom_ext _ _
    · change p ≫ K.map (prod.lift prod.fst i) ≫ (FiniteRuleTransport.powerIso K S 2).hom =
        prod.lift prod.fst i' ≫ prod.map σ σ
      rw [FiniteRuleTransport.powerIso_two, PropositionalSchemeTransport.map_lift_comparison,
        prod.comp_lift, hp, hi]
      simp
  conclusion j := by
    fin_cases j
    · change coprod.desc _ _ ≫ K.map (coprod.desc (logical n i) A.arrow) =
        coprod.desc (logical n' i') W.arrow ≫ σ
      apply coprod.hom_ext
      · rw [coprod.inl_desc_assoc, coprod.inl_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, ← K.map_comp,
          coprod.inl_desc]
        exact logicalMap_law n i K n' i' σ p q h₁ h₂ h₃
      · rw [coprod.inr_desc_assoc, coprod.inr_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, ← K.map_comp,
          coprod.inr_desc, hk]
    · exact initial.hom_ext _ _
    · exact hr

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PropositionalRuleComparison.generated_le
references.source:
theorem generated_le (P : Proofs n i) (Q : Proofs n' i') (hQ : ∀ W, IsInitial (Q W))
    (τ : (rules n' i' W).Translation (FiniteRuleTransport.mappedRules K (rules n i A))) :
    generated n' i' Q W ≤ (Subobject.pullback τ.formula).obj
      (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object K (generated n i P A)) := by
  let V := FiniteRuleTransport.mappedAlgebra K (rules n i A) (P A)
  have hc : (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object K (generated n i P A)).Factors (K.map (P A).a.hom) := by
    apply (Subobject.factors_iff _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨K.map (factorThruImageSubobject (P A).a.hom) ≫
      (Subobject.underlyingIso (K.map (generated n i P A).arrow)).inv, ?_⟩
    change (_ ≫ (Subobject.underlyingIso _).inv) ≫ (Subobject.mk _).arrow = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Subobject.underlyingIso_arrow, ← K.map_comp]
    exact congrArg K.map (imageSubobject_arrow_comp _)
  have hf := Subobject.factors_of_factors_right (τ.fold (Q W) (hQ W) V) hc
  change (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object K (generated n i P A)).Factors
    (τ.fold (Q W) (hQ W) V ≫ V.a.hom) at hf
  rw [τ.fold_conclusion] at hf
  have ht := pullback_factors τ.formula _ _ hf
  exact imageSubobject_le _ (Subobject.factorThru _ _ ht) (Subobject.factorThru_arrow _ _ ht)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PropositionalClosureTransfer.forward_closed
references.source:
theorem forward_closed (A : Subobject S) (hA : generated n i P A = A) :
    generated (B.map n) (implication B i) Q (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object B A) =
      FiniteLimitSubobjects.object B A := by
  let W := FiniteLimitSubobjects.object B A
  let c := prodComparison B S S
  let τ := translation n i B (B.map n) (implication B i) (𝟙 _) (inv c)
    (inv (ternaryComparison B S))
    (by rw [PropositionalSchemeTransport.one, Category.comp_id, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
    (by rw [PropositionalSchemeTransport.two, Category.comp_id, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
    (by rw [PropositionalSchemeTransport.three, Category.comp_id, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
    A W (Subobject.underlyingIso (B.map A.arrow)).hom
    (by rw [Subobject.underlyingIso_hom_comp_eq_mk, Category.comp_id]; rfl)
    (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact inv_prodComparison_map_fst B)
    (Category.comp_id _).symm
    (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact inv_prodComparison_map_snd B)
  apply le_antisymm _ (extensive _ _ _ _)
  have h := generated_le n i B (B.map n) (implication B i) A W P Q hQ τ
  change generated _ _ Q W ≤ (Subobject.pullback (𝟙 _)).obj
    (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object B (generated n i P A)) at h
  rwa [Subobject.pullback_id, hA] at h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PropositionalClosureTransfer.backward_closed
references.source:
theorem backward_closed (W : Subobject (B.obj S))
    (hW : generated (B.map n) (implication B i) Q W = W) :
    let A := RetractedClosedTheories.backObject B E e W
    generated n i P A = A := by
  let A := RetractedClosedTheories.backObject B E e W
  let p := productBackward B E e S S
  let q := e.inv.app (Triple S) ≫ E.map (ternaryComparison B S)
  let τ := translation (B.map n) (implication B i) E n i (e.inv.app S) p q
    (by
      dsimp only [p, productBackward]
      rw [Category.assoc, ← E.map_comp, ← PropositionalSchemeTransport.one]
      exact (e.inv.naturality _).symm)
    (by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [Category.assoc, ← E.map_comp, ← PropositionalSchemeTransport.two]
      exact (e.inv.naturality _).symm)
    (by
      dsimp only [p, productBackward]
      rw [Category.assoc, ← E.map_comp, ← PropositionalSchemeTransport.three]
      exact (e.inv.naturality _).symm)
    W A (RetractedClosedTheories.axiomMap B E e W) (RetractedClosedTheories.axiomMap_law B E e W)
    (RetractedRuleComparison.productBackward_fst B E e S S)
    (RetractedRuleComparison.productBackward_operation B E e i)
    (RetractedRuleComparison.productBackward_snd B E e S S)
  apply le_antisymm _ (extensive n i P _)
  have h := generated_le (B.map n) (implication B i) E n i W A Q P hP τ
  change generated n i P A ≤ (Subobject.pullback (e.inv.app S)).obj
    (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E (generated _ _ Q W)) at h
  rw [hW] at h
  exact h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PropositionalAssociatedIncompleteness.associated_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem associated_incompleteness :
    (EssentiallyIncomplete n i P U ↔ EssentiallyIncomplete ((Bᵤ).map n)
      (implication (Bᵤ) i) (Q _) (constantTheory n i P _ (Q _) (hQ _) U)) ∧
    (¬ Complete n U.val ↔ ¬ isTotal (familyDecision m n i P U hc)) ∧
    (SubobjectInseparable U.val ((Subobject.pullback n).obj U.val) ↔
      ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension (familyDecision m n i P U hc)) := by
  obtain ⟨z, _⟩ := factors U hc
  exact ⟨essential_iff n i P hP _ (Q _) (hQ _) z hZ U hc,
    (not_congr ((AssociatedCategory.constant_total_iff m z hZ _).trans
      (BooleanPartialDecision.total_iff m _ _ hc))).symm,
    (BooleanPartialDecision.inseparable_iff_noTotalExtension m _ _ hc).trans
      (AssociatedCategory.noTotalExtension_iff m z hZ _).symm⟩

include hP factors hZ in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PropositionalAssociatedIncompleteness.associated_reduction
references.source:
theorem associated_reduction {X : Tot C} (a b : Subobject X) (hab : SubobjectInseparable a b)
    (θ : X ⟶ S) (t : Theory n i P) (ha : a ≤ (Subobject.pullback θ).obj t.val)
    (hb : b ≤ (Subobject.pullback θ).obj ((Subobject.pullback n).obj t.val)) (htU : t.val ≤ U.val) :
    EssentiallyIncomplete ((Bᵤ).map n) (implication (Bᵤ) i) (Q _)
      (constantTheory n i P _ (Q _) (hQ _) U) ∧
    ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension (familyDecision m n i P U hc) := by
  have h := associated_incompleteness m n i P hP Q hQ logicalTheorem hZ factors U hc
  have hi := AssociatedCategory.extension_inseparable a b hab θ n t.val U.val ha hb htU hc
  exact ⟨h.1.mp ⟨hc, fun W hUW hcW => SliceInseparability.noncoverage n U.val hi W.val hUW hcW⟩,
    h.2.2.mp hi⟩

lem:arithmetized-evaluation.label: lem:arithmetized-evaluation
lem:arithmetized-evaluation.reconstruction: A universal program and primitive recursive s,comp satisfy graph identities uniformly *in PA*. Recode the underlying parameter theorem twice; simulate composed traces and use functionality. For each fixed e a program k_e represents the PA-provably total specialization a↦s(e,a).

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.UniformTrace.arithmetized_evaluation
references.source:
theorem arithmetized_evaluation :
    Nat.Primrec (fun n : ℕ =>
      traceCheck n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2.unpair.1 n.unpair.2.unpair.2) ∧
    PrimrecPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => traceFormula.val.Evalb ![p.1,p.2.1,p.2.2]) ∧
    Nat.Primrec (out : ℕ → ℕ) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ traceProgramComparisonSentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ primitiveTraceGraphSentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ traceProgramTotalitySentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ functionalitySentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ universalSentence) ∧
    Nat.Primrec (Nat.unpaired (specialize : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)) ∧
    Nat.Primrec (Nat.unpaired (compose : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ)) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ buildersTotalitySentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ specializationSentence) ∧
    (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ compositionSentence) ∧
    (∀ e : ℕ, (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ specializerSectionSentence e) ∧
      (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ specializerSectionTotalitySentence e)) := by
  exact ⟨traceCheck_natPrimrec, trace_primrec, out_natPrimrec,
    traceProgram_comparison_PA, primitive_trace_graph_PA,
    traceProgram_totality_PA, functionality_PA, universal_PA, specialize_natPrimrec,
    compose_natPrimrec, builders_totality_PA, specialization_PA, composition_PA,
    fun e => ⟨specializerSection_PA e, specializerSection_totality_PA e⟩⟩

references.source:
theorem trace_primrec :
    PrimrecPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => traceFormula.val.Evalb ![p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2]) := by
  have h := Primrec.eq.comp traceCheck_primrec (Primrec.const 1)
  apply PrimrecPred.of_eq h
  intro p
  classical
  by_cases hp : traceFormula.val.Evalb ![p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2] <;>
    simp [traceCheck, hp]

  apply complete.{0} 𝗣𝗔

  have h : ∀ e x z y : M, z = ExponentialPairing.code e x →
      (graph.val.Evalb ![(universalIndex : M), z, y] ↔ graph.val.Evalb ![e, x, y]) := by
    intro e x z y he
    subst z
    exact universal_eval e x y
  simpa [models_iff, universalSentence, numeral_eq_natCast_app] using h

theorem specialization_PA : 𝗣𝗔 ⊢ specializationSentence := by
  apply complete.{0} 𝗣𝗔
  intro M _ _
  have hmodel : ∀ e a p x y : M, specializationGraph.val.Evalb ![p, e, a] →
      (graph.val.Evalb ![p, x, y] ↔ ∃ z : M,
        ExponentialPairing.graph.val.Evalb ![z, a, x] ∧ graph.val.Evalb ![e, z, y]) := by
    intro e a p x y hp
    have he : p = specialize e a := (specializationGraph_eval p e a).mp hp
    subst p
    rw [specialize_eval]
    simp
  simpa [models_iff, specializationSentence] using hmodel

      (graph.val.Evalb ![p, x, z] ↔ ∃ y : M,
        graph.val.Evalb ![e, x, y] ∧ graph.val.Evalb ![f, y, z]) := by
    intro f e p x z hp
    have he : p = compose f e := (compositionGraph_eval p f e).mp hp
    subst p
    exact compose_eval f e x z
  simpa [models_iff, compositionSentence] using hmodel

theorem specializerSection_eval (e : ℕ) (a p : M) :
    graph.val.Evalb ![(specializerSectionIndex e : M), a, p] ↔ p = specialize (e : M) a := by
  have hsection := canonicalPartrecGraphFormula_eval_iff_eventualGraph
    (M := M) (specializerSectionIndex e) a p
  simp only [numeral_eq_natCast_app] at hsection
  have hU := SyntacticSearch.search_uniform_of_functional 𝗣𝗔
    (specializerSectionGraph e) (specializerSectionGraph_functional e)
  have hmodel := consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound hU) M inferInstance
  rw [models_iff, uniformSentence_eval] at hmodel
  exact hsection.trans (by
    simpa only [specializerSectionIndex, specializerSectionGraph_model] using hmodel a p)

lem:syntactic-functional-search.label: lem:syntactic-functional-search
lem:syntactic-functional-search.reconstruction: For every Σ₁ Γ(x,y), least coded pair of output/witness yields program aΓ. PA proves outputs satisfy Γ and its domain iff ∃y Γ; full equivalence of the graph needs functionality in T.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticSearch.functional_search
references.source:
theorem functional_search (F : Graph) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ soundSentence e F) ∧ (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ domainSentence e F) ∧
      ∀ (T : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗣𝗔 ⪯ T],
        (T ⊢ functionalSentence F) → Uniform T (eventualGraph e) F :=
  ⟨searchIndex F, search_sound F, search_domain F,
    fun T _ hF => search_uniform_of_functional T F hF⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticSearch.search_uniform_of_functional
references.source:
theorem search_uniform_of_functional (T : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗣𝗔 ⪯ T]
    (F : Graph) (hF : T ⊢ functionalSentence F) :
    Uniform T (eventualGraph (searchIndex F)) F := by
  apply complete.{0} T
  intro M _ hM
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  have hf : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ functionalSentence F :=
    consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound hF) M hM
  rw [models_iff, functionalSentence_eval] at hf
  rw [models_iff, uniformSentence_eval]
  intro x y
  constructor
  · exact search_sound_in_model F x y
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (search_domain_in_model F x).mpr ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hzy := hf x z y (search_sound_in_model F x z hz) hy
    simpa only [hzy] using hz

lem:syntactic-total-category.reconstruction: J(C)=(ω,[C]) and J(Γ)=[aΓ] satisfy support, totality and composition. Claim equivalence with the completed total category, regularity/extensivity, monic partial inverses, existential image formula and presentation of all subobjects.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticPredicates.subobject_is_predicate_inclusion
references.source:
theorem subobject_is_predicate_inclusion {C D : PredicateCategory T} (m : C ⟶ D) [Mono m] :
    ∃ (P : Carrier) (h : T ⊢ inclusionSentence P D) (i : C ≅ (P : PredicateCategory T)),
      i.hom ≫ representedArrow T (GraphMorphism.inclusion h) = m := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep m
  have hf' : representedArrow T f = m := hf
  let : Mono (representedArrow T f) := by rw [hf']; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := represented_mono_image_iso T f
  exact ⟨imageCarrier f.graph, f.imageInclusionProof, i, hi.trans hf'⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticPredicates.totalSplit_mono_partial_inverse
references.source:
theorem totalSplit_mono_partial_inverse {X Y : TotalSplit T} (m : X ⟶ Y) [Mono m] :
    ∃ r : Y.obj ⟶ X.obj, m.hom ≫ r = 𝟙 X.obj ∧ r ≫ m.hom = rst r := by
  let E := predicateEquivalence T
  let C := E.inverse.obj X
  let D := E.inverse.obj Y
  let a := E.counitIso.app X
  let b := E.counitIso.app Y
  let n := a.hom ≫ m ≫ b.inv
  let f : C ⟶ D := (realization T).preimage n
  have hn : (realization T).map f = n := (realization T).map_preimage n
  let : Mono n := by dsimp [n]; infer_instance
  let : Mono f := (realization T).mono_of_mono_map (by rw [hn]; infer_instance)
  obtain ⟨r, hfr, hrf⟩ := realized_mono_partial_inverse T f
  let A : (interpretedObject T C).obj ≅ X.obj :=
    (wideSubcategoryInclusion (isTotal (C := SplitObject (CodedProgramCategory T)))).mapIso a
  let B : (interpretedObject T D).obj ≅ Y.obj :=
    (wideSubcategoryInclusion (isTotal (C := SplitObject (CodedProgramCategory T)))).mapIso b
  have hconj : A.inv ≫ ((realization T).map f).hom ≫ B.hom = m.hom := by
    rw [hn]
    change a.inv.hom ≫ ((a.hom ≫ m ≫ b.inv).hom) ≫ b.hom.hom = m.hom
    have hh : a.inv ≫ (a.hom ≫ m ≫ b.inv) ≫ b.hom = m := by simp
    exact congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => k.hom) hh
  refine ⟨B.inv ≫ r ≫ A.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := (transport_partial_inverse A B ((realization T).map f).hom r hfr hrf).1
    simpa only [hconj] using h
  · have h := (transport_partial_inverse A B ((realization T).map f).hom r hfr hrf).2
    simpa only [hconj] using h

lem:st-finite-sigma1.label: lem:st-finite-sigma1

For a finite tagged menu D_j test a finite Σ₁ disjunction of graph equalities of ℓ and D_j before applying the same construction.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.FiniteSigmaOne.witnessVector_exists
references.source:
theorem witnessVector_exists (R : Matrix) (a : M)
    (h : ∀ i < len a, ∃ w : M, R.val.Evalb ![w, nth a i]) :
    ∃ b : M, len b = len a ∧ ∀ i < len a,
      nth a i < a ∧ nth b i < b ∧ R.val.Evalb ![nth b i, nth a i] := by
  have hR : 𝚺₁-Relation (fun i w : M => R.val.Evalb ![w, nth a i]) := by
    let N : 𝚺₁.Semiformula M 3 := nthDef.rew Rew.emb
    let R' : 𝚺₀.Semiformula M 2 := R.rew Rew.emb
    refine ⟨.mkSigma “i w. ∃ x, !N.val x &a i ∧ !R'.val w x”, ?_⟩
    intro v
    simp [N, R']
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbody⟩ := sigmaOne_skolem_vec hR h
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  exact ⟨nth_lt_self hi, nth_lt_self (by simpa only [hb] using hi), hbody i hi⟩

theorem natPrimrec_representation {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Nat.Primrec f) :
    ∃ (A : Graph) (P : 𝚷₁.Semisentence 2),
      (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ totalSentence A) ∧ (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ piTotalSentence P) ∧
      (𝗣𝗔 ⊢ graphAgreementSentence A P) ∧
      ∀ x y : ℕ, (A.val.Evalb ![y, x] ↔ y = f x) ∧
        (P.val.Evalb ![y, x] ↔ y = f x) := by
  let c := codeFor hf
  refine ⟨c.graph, (deltaGraph c).pi, graph_total_PA c, graph_pi_total_PA c,
    graph_coherent_PA c, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  constructor
  · simpa only [c, codeFor_spec] using c.graph_nat_iff x y
  · simp only [deltaGraph_pi_eval, interpret_nat, c, codeFor_spec]

def foldHom : (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters a b (postfixAlgebra T a b) P) ⟶ B where
  f := fold T a b B
  h := Prod.ext (termFold_commutes T a b B) (formulaFold_commutes T a b B)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticSyntax.foldHom_unique
references.source:
theorem foldHom_unique : H = foldHom T a b B := by
  apply Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply PredicateInterpretation.jointly_faithful T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
    intro q
    let p := (F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ termCarrier a b ⟶ P) q
    let w := (F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ termCarrier a b ⟶ termCarrier a b) q
    let x := (F T M).map H.f.1.left q
    let y := (F T M).map (termFold T a b B).left q
    have hq := (constantLeaf_model T M P (termCarrier a b) p w q).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hx := (rawArrow_model T M H.f.1 p w q x hq).mpr rfl
    have hy := (termFoldMap_eval T a b B M q y).mp rfl
    have he := (decode T P a b B).evaluation_unique (rawArrow T H.f.1)
      (rawArrow T H.f.2) (hom_root_equations T a b B H M) false
        p.val w.val x.val y.val hx hy
    exact Subtype.ext he
  · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply PredicateInterpretation.jointly_faithful T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
    intro q
    let p := (F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ formulaCarrier a b ⟶ P) q
    let w := (F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ formulaCarrier a b ⟶ formulaCarrier a b) q
    let x := (F T M).map H.f.2.left q
    let y := (F T M).map (formulaFold T a b B).left q
    have hq := (constantLeaf_model T M P (formulaCarrier a b) p w q).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hx := (rawArrow_model T M H.f.2 p w q x hq).mpr rfl
    have hy := (formulaFoldMap_eval T a b B M q y).mp rfl
    have he := (decode T P a b B).evaluation_unique (rawArrow T H.f.1)
      (rawArrow T H.f.2) (hom_root_equations T a b B H M) true
        p.val w.val x.val y.val hx hy
    exact Subtype.ext he

def categoricalSyntax (V : PredicateCategory T) (σ π : ℕ → PredicateCategory T) (d : ℕ) :
    CategoricalSyntax V σ π d where
  decidableVariables := SyntacticDecidableVariables.decidableVariables T V
  algebra := postfixAlgebra T (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)
  initial := postfixInitial T (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)
  stable P := withParametersInitial T P (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)
  lists := SyntacticLists.stableListAlgebra T V

def totalCategoricalSyntax (V : TotalSplit T) (σ π : ℕ → TotalSplit T) (d : ℕ) :
    CategoricalSyntax V σ π d where
  decidableVariables := ConcreteDecidableVariables.total T V
  algebra := (mappedPostfixData T (predicateEquivalence T)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)).1
  initial := (mappedPostfixData T (predicateEquivalence T)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)).2.1
  stable := (mappedPostfixData T (predicateEquivalence T)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)).2.2
  lists := SyntacticLists.totalStableListAlgebra T V

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticSyntax.Postfix.plainCarrierIso
references.source:
def plainCarrierIso (formula : Bool) (a b : RawPolynomial) :
    @CategoryTheory.Iso (PredicateCategory T) inferInstance
      (carrier formula a b) (plainCarrier formula a b) where
  hom := classOfGraph T (toPlainMorphism T formula a b)
  inv := classOfGraph T (fromPlainMorphism T formula a b)
  hom_inv_id := by
    apply Quotient.sound
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁ := models_of_subtheory (U := 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
    rw [models_iff, uniformSentence_eval]
    intro x z
    change (comp (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (plainCarrier formula a b))
      (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (carrier formula a b))).val.Evalb ![x, z] ↔
        (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (carrier formula a b)).val.Evalb ![x, z]
    rw [comp_eval]
    simp only [GraphMorphism.identityGraph_eval, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hx, hy⟩, ⟨_, hz⟩⟩
      subst y
      subst z
      exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨hx, hz⟩
      subst z
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hx, rfl⟩, ⟨(carrier_plain_model formula a b x).mp hx, rfl⟩⟩
  inv_hom_id := by
    apply Quotient.sound
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁ := models_of_subtheory (U := 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
    rw [models_iff, uniformSentence_eval]
    intro x z
    change (comp (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (carrier formula a b))
      (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (plainCarrier formula a b))).val.Evalb ![x, z] ↔
        (GraphMorphism.identityGraph (plainCarrier formula a b)).val.Evalb ![x, z]
    rw [comp_eval]
    simp only [GraphMorphism.identityGraph_eval, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hx, hy⟩, ⟨_, hz⟩⟩
      subst y
      subst z
      exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨hx, hz⟩
      subst z
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hx, rfl⟩, ⟨(carrier_plain_model formula a b x).mpr hx, rfl⟩⟩
