references.source:
def algebra (V : PredicateCategory T) : ListAlgebra (D := PredicateCategory T) V where
  carrier := listObject T V
  nil := representedArrow T (nilMorphism T (⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) V)
  cons := toRawProduct T V (listObject T V) ≫ representedArrow T (consMorphism T V)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticLists.decode
references.source:
def decode : SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra T P V B.carrier.left where
  projection := chosenGraph T B.carrier.hom
  nilOp := chosenGraph T (nilMap T B)
  nil_over := by
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    have hnil : ∀ p y : M, (chosenGraph T (nilMap T B)).graph.val.Evalb ![p, y] →
        (chosenGraph T B.carrier.hom).graph.val.Evalb ![y, p] := by
      intro p y h
      have hs := (chosenGraph T (nilMap T B)).support_model M p y h
      let pp : Obj T M P := ⟨p, hs.1⟩
      let yy : Obj T M B.carrier.left := ⟨y, hs.2⟩
      have hn := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M (nilMap T B) pp yy).mp h
      have he := congrArg (F T M).map (nilMap_over T B)
      rw [Functor.map_comp, (F T M).map_id P] at he
      have hp := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he pp
      change (F T M).map B.carrier.hom ((F T M).map (nilMap T B) pp) = pp at hp
      rw [hn] at hp
      exact (chosenGraph_map_iff T M B.carrier.hom yy pp).mpr hp
    simpa [models_iff, SyntacticListEvaluation.nilOverSentence] using hnil
  consOp := decodedCons T B
  cons_support := by
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    have hsup : ∀ p v x y : M, (decodedCons T B).val.Evalb ![p, v, x, y] →
        P.val.Evalb ![p] ∧ V.val.Evalb ![v] ∧ B.carrier.left.val.Evalb ![x] ∧
          (chosenGraph T B.carrier.hom).graph.val.Evalb ![x, p] ∧
            B.carrier.left.val.Evalb ![y] ∧
              (chosenGraph T B.carrier.hom).graph.val.Evalb ![y, p] := by
      intro p v x y h
      obtain ⟨hp, hv, hx, hy⟩ := decodedCons_support T B M p v x y h
      have hfib := decodedCons_fibers T B M ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ h
      exact ⟨hp, hv, hx, (chosenGraph_map_iff T M B.carrier.hom ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩).mpr
        hfib.1, hy, (chosenGraph_map_iff T M B.carrier.hom ⟨y, hy⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩).mpr hfib.2⟩
    simpa [models_iff, SyntacticListEvaluation.consSupportSentence] using hsup
  cons_total := by
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    have htotal : ∀ p v x : M, P.val.Evalb ![p] → V.val.Evalb ![v] →
        B.carrier.left.val.Evalb ![x] →
          (chosenGraph T B.carrier.hom).graph.val.Evalb ![x, p] →
            ∃! y : M, (decodedCons T B).val.Evalb ![p, v, x, y] := by
      intro p v x hp hv hx hxp
      have hfib := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M B.carrier.hom ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩).mp hxp
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hu⟩ := decodedCons_existsUnique T B M ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩ hfib
      refine ⟨y.val, hy, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      have hsz := (decodedCons_support T B M p v x z hz).2.2.2
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hu ⟨z, hsz⟩ hz)
    simpa [models_iff, SyntacticListEvaluation.consTotalSentence] using htotal

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticLists.fold
references.source:
def fold : constantFamily P (listObject T V) ⟶ B.carrier :=
  Over.homMk (foldMap T B) (foldMap_over T B)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticLists.fold_nil
references.source:
theorem fold_nil : ((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil ≫ fold T B = B.nil := by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply PredicateInterpretation.jointly_faithful T
  intro M _ _
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  change (F T M).map (((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil.left ≫ foldMap T B) = _
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
  intro t
  change (F T M).map (foldMap T B)
    ((F T M).map ((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil.left t) =
      (F T M).map B.nil.left t
  apply (foldMap_eval T B M _ _).mpr
  rw [parameter_nil_fst, parameter_nil_snd, (decode T B).evaluation_nil]
  apply (chosenGraph_map_iff T M (nilMap T B) _ _).mpr
  have hm := congrArg (F T M).map (terminal_nilMap T B)
  rw [Functor.map_comp] at hm
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hm t

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticLists.fold_cons
references.source:
theorem fold_cons : ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons ≫ fold T B =
    prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) (fold T B) ≫ B.cons := by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply PredicateInterpretation.jointly_faithful T
  intro M _ _
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  change (F T M).map (((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons.left ≫ foldMap T B) =
    (F T M).map ((prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) (fold T B)).left ≫ B.cons.left)
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
  apply ConcreteCategory.hom_ext
  intro q
  let u := (F T M).map (prod.fst : constantFamily P V ⨯
    constantFamily P (listObject T V) ⟶ constantFamily P V).left q
  let w := (F T M).map (prod.snd : constantFamily P V ⨯
    constantFamily P (listObject T V) ⟶ constantFamily P (listObject T V)).left q
  let p := (F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ V ⟶ P) u
  let v := (F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ V ⟶ V) u
  let a := (F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ listObject T V ⟶ listObject T V) w
  let x := (F T M).map (fold T B).left w
  let r := (F T M).map (prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) (fold T B)).left q
  let y := (F T M).map B.cons.left r
  have hbase : (F T M).map (constantFamily P V ⨯
      constantFamily P (listObject T V)).hom q = p :=
    (over_value T M (prod.fst : constantFamily P V ⨯
      constantFamily P (listObject T V) ⟶ constantFamily P V) q).symm
  have hwp : (F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ listObject T V ⟶ P) w = p :=
    (over_value T M (prod.snd : constantFamily P V ⨯
      constantFamily P (listObject T V) ⟶ constantFamily P (listObject T V)) q).trans hbase
  have hx : (decode T B).evaluationFormula.val.Evalb ![p.val, a.val, x.val] := by
    have hh := (foldMap_eval T B M w x).mp rfl
    rw [hwp] at hh
    exact hh
  have hr₁ : (F T M).map (consFirst T B) r = u := by
    have hh := modelOverProduct_map_fst T M (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) (fold T B) q
    have hi : (F T M).map (Over.Hom.left (𝟙 (constantFamily P V))) u = u :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((F T M).map_id (P ⨯ V)) u
    exact hh.trans hi
  have hr₂ : (F T M).map (consSecond T B) r = x :=
    modelOverProduct_map_snd T M (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) (fold T B) q
  have hc : (decodedCons T B).val.Evalb ![p.val, v.val, x.val, y.val] :=
    (decodedCons_model T B M p v x y).mpr
      ⟨r, (congrArg ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ V ⟶ P)) hr₁),
        (congrArg ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ V ⟶ V)) hr₁), hr₂, rfl⟩
  have he := (decode T B).evaluation_adjoin_intro p.val v.val a.val x.val y.val hx hc
  apply (foldMap_eval T B M _ y).mpr
  have hfst := (parameter_cons_fst T (P := P) (V := V) M q).trans hbase
  have hsnd := parameter_cons_snd T (P := P) (V := V) M q
  have hvec :
      ![((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⨯ listObject T V ⟶ P)
        ((F T M).map ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons.left q)).val,
        ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⨯ listObject T V ⟶ listObject T V)
          ((F T M).map ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons.left q)).val, y.val] =
      ![p.val, adjoin v.val a.val, y.val] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val hfst
    · exact hsnd
    · rfl
  exact (congrArg (fun e => (decode T B).evaluationFormula.val.Evalb e) hvec).mpr he

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticLists.fold_unique
references.source:
theorem fold_unique
    (hn : ((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil ≫ m = B.nil)
    (hc : ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons ≫ m =
      prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) m ≫ B.cons) : m = fold T B := by
  let H := candidateMorphism T B m
  have hnil : ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] (p y : M),
      (SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb ![p, 0, y] ↔
        (decode T B).nilOp.graph.val.Evalb ![p, y] := by
    intro M _ _ p y
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hp := (SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.candidate_source H p 0 y h).1
      have hy := (H.support_model M _ y
        ((SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.unpackedGraph_eval H.graph p 0 y).mp h)).2
      exact (candidate_nil_typed T B m M hn ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩).mp h
    · intro h
      have hs := (decode T B).nilOp.support_model M p y h
      exact (candidate_nil_typed T B m M hn ⟨p, hs.1⟩ ⟨y, hs.2⟩).mpr h
  have hcons : ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔]
      (p v a y : M),
      (SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb
        ![p, adjoin v a, y] ↔ V.val.Evalb ![v] ∧ ∃ x : M,
          (SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb ![p, a, x] ∧
            (decode T B).consOp.val.Evalb ![p, v, x, y] := by
    intro M _ _ _ p v a y
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨hp, hva⟩ := SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.candidate_source H p (adjoin v a) y h
      obtain ⟨hv, ha⟩ := (listCarrier_cons V v a).mp hva
      have hy := (H.support_model M _ y
        ((SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.unpackedGraph_eval H.graph p (adjoin v a) y).mp h)).2
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := (candidate_cons_typed T B m M hc
        ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩).mp h
      exact ⟨hv, x.val, hx, hxy⟩
    · rintro ⟨hv, x, hx, hxy⟩
      obtain ⟨hp, ha⟩ := SyntacticListEvaluation.SliceAlgebra.candidate_source H p a x hx
      obtain ⟨_, _, hxx, hyy⟩ := decodedCons_support T B M p v x y hxy
      exact (candidate_cons_typed T B m M hc
        ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨y, hyy⟩).mpr ⟨⟨x, hxx⟩, hx, hxy⟩
  have he := (decode T B).evaluation_unique H hnil hcons
  change representedArrow T (chosenGraph T
    (fromRawProduct T P (listObject T V) ≫ m.left)) = _ at he
  rw [chosenGraph_class] at he
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change m.left = foldMap T B
  have hh := congrArg (fun f => toRawProduct T P (listObject T V) ≫ f) he
  simpa only [← Category.assoc, toRaw_fromRaw, Category.id_comp, foldMap] using hh

def withParametersInitial : IsInitial ((algebra T V).withParameters P).asAlgebra :=
  IsInitial.ofUniqueHom (foldHom T P V) (by
    intro B m
    apply Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.ext
    apply fold_unique T (targetListAlgebra T P V B) m.f
    · have h := congrArg (fun k => coprod.inl ≫ k) m.h
      change coprod.inl ≫
        (coprod.map (𝟙 (⊤_ (Over P))) (prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) m.f) ≫ B.str) =
          coprod.inl ≫ (coprod.desc ((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil
            ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons ≫ m.f) at h
      rw [← Category.assoc, coprod.inl_map, Category.id_comp,
        ← Category.assoc, coprod.inl_desc] at h
      exact h.symm
    · have h := congrArg (fun k => coprod.inr ≫ k) m.h
      change coprod.inr ≫
        (coprod.map (𝟙 (⊤_ (Over P))) (prod.map (𝟙 (constantFamily P V)) m.f) ≫ B.str) =
          coprod.inr ≫ (coprod.desc ((algebra T V).withParameters P).nil
            ((algebra T V).withParameters P).cons ≫ m.f) at h
      simp only [← Category.assoc, coprod.inr_map, coprod.inr_desc] at h
      rw [Category.assoc] at h
      exact h.symm)

def evaluationMorphism : GraphMorphism T (productCarrier P (listCarrier V)) X where
  graph := A.evaluationGraph
  support := by
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    rw [models_iff, supportSentence_eval]
    intro q y hq
    have h : ∃ p a : M, q = Arithmetic.pair p a ∧
        A.evaluationFormula.val.Evalb ![p, a, y] := by
      simpa [evaluationGraph] using hq
    obtain ⟨p, a, he, hy⟩ := h
    have hs := A.evaluation_source p a y hy
    exact ⟨(productCarrier_eval P (listCarrier V) q).mpr ⟨p, a, he, hs.1, hs.2⟩,
      (A.evaluation_fiber p a y hy).1⟩
  total := by
    apply complete.{0} T
    intro M _ _
    let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
    rw [models_iff, totalSentence_eval]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, a, he, hp, ha⟩ := (productCarrier_eval P (listCarrier V) q).mp hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hu⟩ := A.evaluation_existsUnique p a hp ha
    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [evaluationGraph] using Exists.intro p (Exists.intro a ⟨he, hy⟩)
    · intro z hz
      have h : ∃ p' a' : M, q = Arithmetic.pair p' a' ∧
          A.evaluationFormula.val.Evalb ![p', a', z] := by
        simpa [evaluationGraph] using hz
      obtain ⟨p', a', he', hz'⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨hp', ha'⟩ := (pair_eq_pair_iff _ _ _ _).mp (he'.symm.trans he)
      subst p'
      subst a'
      exact hu z hz'

references.source:
theorem evaluation_unique
    (H : GraphMorphism T (productCarrier P (listCarrier V)) X)
    (hn : ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] (p y : M),
      (unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb ![p, 0, y] ↔ A.nilOp.graph.val.Evalb ![p, y])
    (hc : ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔]
      (p v a y : M),
      (unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb ![p, adjoin v a, y] ↔
        V.val.Evalb ![v] ∧ ∃ x : M, (unpackedGraph H.graph).val.Evalb ![p, a, x] ∧
          A.consOp.val.Evalb ![p, v, x, y]) :
    representedArrow T H = representedArrow T A.evaluationMorphism := by
  apply Quotient.sound
  apply complete.{0} T
  intro M _ _
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  rw [models_iff, uniformSentence_eval]
  intro q y
  let p := π₁ q
  let a := π₂ q
  have he : q = Arithmetic.pair p a := by simp [p, a]
  rw [he]
  change H.graph.val.Evalb ![Arithmetic.pair p a, y] ↔
    A.evaluationGraph.val.Evalb ![Arithmetic.pair p a, y]
  have h := A.evaluation_unique_model H (hn M) (hc M) p a y
  simpa [unpackedGraph, evaluationGraph] using h

theorem admissible_iff_source_and_success (n : M) :
    (plainAdmissibleCarrier T V σ π d).val.Evalb ![n] ↔
      ∃ h : (Y ⨯ P : PredicateCategory T).val.Evalb ![n],
        let q : Obj T M (Y ⨯ P) := ⟨n, h⟩
        substitutionFreeFor V σ π d
          ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⟶ V) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
          ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
          ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have hf := (plainAdmissibleCarrier_freeFor T V σ π d M n).mp ha
    change (imageCarrier (chosenGraph T (S).admissibleInclusion).graph).val.Evalb ![n] at ha
    rw [imageCarrier_eval] at ha
    obtain ⟨a, h⟩ := ha
    have hs := ((chosenGraph T (S).admissibleInclusion).support_model M a n h).2
    exact ⟨hs, (plainFreeForPredicate_model T V σ π d M ⟨n, hs⟩).mp hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
    exact (plainAdmissibleCarrier_freeFor T V σ π d M n).mpr
      ((plainFreeForPredicate_model T V σ π d M ⟨n, hs⟩).mpr h)

      ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val =
        ConcreteNamedSubstitution.ok ((F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitution a).val := by

      (F T M).map (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y)) ((F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitution a) := by
    exact parameterPoint_diagram T M (S).admissibleInclusion (S).formulaSubstitutionOption
      (S).formulaSubstitution (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y)) (S).formulaSubstitution_square a

theorem plain_admissible_model_iff (q : Obj T M (Y ⨯ P)) :
    (∃ a : Obj T M (S).admissibleSubstitution, (F T M).map (S).admissibleInclusion a = q) ↔
      ConcreteNamedSubstitution.substitutionFreeFor V σ π d
        ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⟶ V) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
        ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
        ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val = 1 := by
  change (∃ a : Obj T M (pullback (S).formulaSubstitutionOption (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y))),
      (F T M).map (pullback.fst (S).formulaSubstitutionOption (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y))) a = q) ↔ _
  refine (model_successFiber_iff T M (C := (Y ⨯ P)) (D := Y)
    (S).formulaSubstitutionOption q).trans ?_
  erw [plain_formulaSubstitutionOption_value T V σ π d M q]
  exact (ConcreteNamedSubstitution.substitutionFreeFor_iff_success V σ π d
    ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⟶ V) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
    ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
    ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val
    (plainPoint_canonical T V σ π d M false
      ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)))
    (plainPoint_canonical T V σ π d M true
      ((F T M).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := Y) («Y» := P)) q))).symm

def substitutionAlgebraIso :
    AlgebraTransport.mappedAlgebra ((H).prod H) (syntaxParameterLanguageIso E b V σ π d)
        S₀.substitutionAlgebra ≅ S₁.substitutionAlgebra := by
  let A := S₀.substitutionAlgebra
  let B := S₁.substitutionAlgebra
  let α := syntaxParameterLanguageIso E b V σ π d
  let i := substitutionFamilyPairIso E b S₀.substitutionCarriers S₁.substitutionCarriers a
  refine Endofunctor.Algebra.isoMk i ?_
  apply (cancel_epi (α.app A.a).hom).mp
  change (α.app A.a).hom ≫
      ((SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
        ((SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d).withParameters P₁)
        ((SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d).withParameters P₁)).map i.hom ≫ B.str) =
    (α.app A.a).hom ≫ (((α.app A.a).inv ≫ ((H).prod H).functor.map A.str) ≫ i.hom)
  simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change ((syntaxParameterLanguageIso E b V σ π d).hom.app
      (constantFamily P₀ S₀.substitutionCarriers.1,constantFamily P₀ S₀.substitutionCarriers.2)).1 ≫
        ((SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d).withParameters P₁).eval.map
          (substitutionFamilyPairIso E b S₀.substitutionCarriers S₁.substitutionCarriers a).hom ≫ B.str.1 =
      (H).functor.map A.str.1 ≫ (coefficientComparison E b S₀.substitutionCarriers.1
        S₁.substitutionCarriers.1 (substitutionTermStateIso E V σ π d S₀ S₁ c)).hom
    rw [syntaxParameterLanguageIso_fst_assoc]
    exact (substitutionTargetTerm_structure E V σ π d S₀ S₁ c).symm
  · change ((syntaxParameterLanguageIso E b V σ π d).hom.app
      (constantFamily P₀ S₀.substitutionCarriers.1,constantFamily P₀ S₀.substitutionCarriers.2)).2 ≫
        ((SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d).withParameters P₁).eval.map
          (substitutionFamilyPairIso E b S₀.substitutionCarriers S₁.substitutionCarriers a).hom ≫ B.str.2 =
      (H).functor.map A.str.2 ≫ (coefficientComparison E b S₀.substitutionCarriers.2
        S₁.substitutionCarriers.2 f).hom
    rw [syntaxParameterLanguageIso_snd_assoc]
    exact (substitutionTargetFormula_structure E V σ π d S₀ S₁ c
      ℓ hnil hsingleton happend hdeletion hmembership).symm

include hnil hsingleton happend hdeletion hmembership in

        (substitutionAlgebraIso E V σ π d S₀ S₁ c ℓ hnil hsingleton happend hdeletion hmembership).hom.f =
      (syntaxParameterAlgebraIso E b V σ π d S₀ S₁ c).hom.f ≫ S₁.substitutionFold := by
  let α := syntaxParameterLanguageIso E b V σ π d
  let A := SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression (E.inverse.obj V) (fun n => E.inverse.obj (σ n)) d)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression (E.inverse.obj V) (fun n => E.inverse.obj (π n)) d)
    S₀.algebra P₀
  let I := AlgebraTransport.initial ((H).prod H) α A (S₀.stable P₀)
  have h := I.hom_ext
    ((AlgebraTransport.functor ((H).prod H) α).map ((S₀.stable P₀).to S₀.substitutionAlgebra) ≫
      (substitutionAlgebraIso E V σ π d S₀ S₁ c ℓ hnil hsingleton happend hdeletion hmembership).hom)
    ((syntaxParameterAlgebraIso E b V σ π d S₀ S₁ c).hom ≫

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticDerivation.derivationConstructor_tree
references.source:
theorem derivationConstructor_tree :
    (derivationAlgebra T R).str.left ≫ treeInclusion T R =
      InputGeometry.forget R (derivationAlgebra T R).a ≫
        (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (treeInclusion T R) ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str := by
  let v : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory T) inferInstance (ordinaryTree T R).a
      (OptionSyntax.obj F) := (validatorFold T R).f
  let j := pullback.fst v (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F)
  let e := SuccessCarrier.overIso v
  have hc : (chosenAlgebra T R).str.left ≫ j =
      SuccessComparison.input T R (Over.mk v) ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str := by
    have hp : ((SuccessComparison.success T).map (validatedSlice T R).str).left ≫ j =
        pullback.fst ((SliceInitial.functor (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R)
          (SuccessComparison.validator T R)).obj (Over.mk v)).hom
          (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F) ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str := by
      simp [j, v, Over.pullback, validatedSlice, SliceInitial.algebra, validatorFold]
    change (((SuccessComparison.comparison T R).inv.app (Over.mk v)).left ≫
      ((SuccessComparison.success T).map (validatedSlice T R).str).left) ≫ j = _
    rw [SuccessComparison.comparison_inv_app, Category.assoc, hp,
      ← Category.assoc, SuccessComparison.componentIso_input]
  change (SuccessCarrier.rawAlgebra v R.inference (chosenAlgebra T R).str).str.left ≫
    representedArrow T (SuccessCarrier.inclusion v) = _
  rw [SuccessCarrier.rawAlgebra_tree, hc, SuccessComparison.input_eq_forget]
  have hf : (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map e.hom.left ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str =
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (treeInclusion T R) ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    have hi : e.hom.left ≫ j = treeInclusion T R := SuccessCarrier.overIso_tree v
    rw [hi]
  have he := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str)
    (InputGeometry.forget_natural R e.hom)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  change (R.inference.map e.hom).left ≫
      InputGeometry.forget R ((Over.pullback (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F)).obj (Over.mk v)) ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str =
    InputGeometry.forget R (Over.mk (representedArrow T (SuccessCarrier.conclusion v))) ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (treeInclusion T R) ≫ (ordinaryTree T R).str
  simpa only [Category.assoc, hf] using he

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticDerivation.totalDerivationConstructor_tree
references.source:
theorem totalDerivationConstructor_tree :
    (totalDerivationAlgebra T R).str.left ≫ totalTreeInclusion T R =
      InputGeometry.forget R (totalDerivationAlgebra T R).a ≫
        (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (totalTreeInclusion T R) ≫
          (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str := by
  let v : @Quiver.Hom (TotalSplit T) inferInstance (totalOrdinaryTree T R).a
      (OptionSyntax.obj F) := (totalValidatorFold T R).f
  let j := pullback.fst v (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F)
  let e := SuccessTransport.overIso T v
  have hc : (totalChosenAlgebra T R).str.left ≫ j =
      SuccessComparisonCore.input R (Over.mk v) ≫ (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str := by
    have hp : ((SuccessComparisonCore.success (F := F)).map (totalValidatedSlice T R).str).left ≫ j =
        pullback.fst ((SliceInitial.functor (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R)
          (SuccessComparisonCore.validator R (totalRuleEquality T R))).obj (Over.mk v)).hom
          (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F) ≫ (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str := by
      simp [j, v, Over.pullback, totalValidatedSlice, SliceInitial.algebra, totalValidatorFold]
    change (((SuccessComparisonCore.comparison (totalInterpretation T) R
      (totalRuleEquality T R)).inv.app (Over.mk v)).left ≫
      ((SuccessComparisonCore.success (F := F)).map (totalValidatedSlice T R).str).left) ≫ j = _
    rw [SuccessComparisonCore.comparison_inv_app, Category.assoc, hp,
      ← Category.assoc, SuccessComparisonCore.componentIso_input]
  change (SuccessTransport.algebra T v R.inference (totalChosenAlgebra T R).str).str.left ≫
    SuccessTransport.inclusion T v = _
  rw [SuccessTransport.algebra_tree, hc, SuccessComparisonCore.input_eq_forget]
  have hf : (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map e.hom.left ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫ (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str =
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (totalTreeInclusion T R) ≫
        (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    have hi : e.hom.left ≫ j = totalTreeInclusion T R := SuccessTransport.overIso_tree T v
    rw [hi]
  have he := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫
      (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str) (InputGeometry.forget_natural R e.hom)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  change (R.inference.map e.hom).left ≫
      InputGeometry.forget R ((Over.pullback (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F)).obj (Over.mk v)) ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map j ≫ (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str =
    InputGeometry.forget R (Over.mk (SuccessTransport.conclusion T v)) ≫
      (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (totalTreeInclusion T R) ≫
        (totalOrdinaryTree T R).str
  simpa only [Category.assoc, hf] using he

thm:syntactic-generated-theory.label: thm:syntactic-generated-theory
thm:syntactic-generated-theory.reconstruction: Under consistency and bounded finite arity, all syntax/derivation hypotheses are realized; for every axiom mono the conclusion image is least closed formula subobject, whose sentence pullback is the least sentence theory.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.proofInitial
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.generated_theory
references.source:
theorem generated_theory {A : PredicateCategory T} (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    ClosedUnder ((S).logicalRules axioms).inference
        (image.ι (conclusion T V σ π d axioms)) ∧
      (∀ {U : PredicateCategory T} (m : U ⟶ (S).algebra.a.2) [Mono m],
        ClosedUnder ((S).logicalRules axioms).inference m →
          ∃ w : image (conclusion T V σ π d axioms) ⟶ U,
            w ≫ m = image.ι (conclusion T V σ π d axioms)) ∧
      (∃ a : (S).logicalParameters ⨿ A ⟶ image (conclusion T V σ π d axioms),
        a ≫ image.ι (conclusion T V σ π d axioms) =
          coprod.desc (S).logicalAxioms (axioms ≫ (S).sentenceInclusion)) ∧
      sentenceTheory T V σ π d axioms =
        (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceInclusion).obj (formulaTheory T V σ π d axioms) :=
  (S).generated_firstOrder_theory axioms (proofAlgebra T V σ π d axioms)
    (proofInitial T V σ π d axioms)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.sentence_theory_pullback
references.source:
theorem sentence_theory_pullback {A : PredicateCategory T} (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    sentenceTheory T V σ π d axioms =
      (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceInclusion).obj (formulaTheory T V σ π d axioms) :=
  (generated_theory T V σ π d axioms).2.2.2

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.sentence_axioms_factor
references.source:
theorem sentence_axioms_factor {A : PredicateCategory T} (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    ∃ a : A ⟶ image (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms),
      a ≫ image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms) = axioms := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (generated_theory T V σ π d axioms).2.2.1
  let c := conclusion T V σ π d axioms
  let j := (S).sentenceInclusion
  let u : A ⟶ image c := coprod.inr ≫ g
  have hu : u ≫ image.ι c = axioms ≫ j := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hg, coprod.inr_desc]
  refine ⟨pullback.lift u axioms hu ≫ (sentenceImageIso c j).hom, ?_⟩
  change (pullback.lift u axioms hu ≫ (sentenceImageIso c j).hom) ≫
    image.ι (pullback.snd c j) = axioms
  rw [Category.assoc, sentenceImageIso_hom_ι, pullback.lift_snd]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.sentence_theory_closed
references.source:
theorem sentence_theory_closed {A : PredicateCategory T} (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    IsSentenceTheory T V σ π d (image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms)) :=
  firstOrder_generated_sentence_closed (S).logicalAxioms (S).sentenceInclusion axioms
    (S).quantifierConstructor (S).implicationConstructor
    (proofAlgebra T V σ π d axioms) (proofInitial T V σ π d axioms)
    (proofAlgebra T V σ π d (image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms)))
    (proofInitial T V σ π d (image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms)))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.sentence_theory_least
references.source:
theorem sentence_theory_least {A U : PredicateCategory T}
    (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) (m : U ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) [Mono m]
    (hm : IsSentenceTheory T V σ π d m) (k : A ⟶ U) (hk : k ≫ m = axioms) :
    sentenceTheory T V σ π d axioms ≤ Subobject.mk m := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hm
  exact firstOrder_generated_sentence_least (S).logicalAxioms (S).sentenceInclusion axioms
    (S).quantifierConstructor (S).implicationConstructor
    (proofAlgebra T V σ π d axioms) (proofInitial T V σ π d axioms) m
    (proofAlgebra T V σ π d m) k hk w hw

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticGeneratedTheory.sentence_theory_idempotent
references.source:
theorem sentence_theory_idempotent {A : PredicateCategory T}
    (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    sentenceTheory T V σ π d (image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms)) =
      sentenceTheory T V σ π d axioms := by
  let m := image.ι (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d axioms)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := sentence_theory_closed T V σ π d axioms
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := sentence_axioms_factor T V σ π d m
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact imageSubobject_le_mk m (sentenceConclusion T V σ π d m) w hw
  · exact Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm a ha

references.source:
theorem sentenceConclusion_range {A : PredicateCategory T} (axioms : A ⟶ (S).sentenceObject) :
    FailureOfComposition.TypedRanges.rangeArrow T

prop:model.reconstruction: Universal T-provable graph equivalence and functionality define F_M. γ_Y^M identifies arbitrary intermediate codes with actual Y_M elements in composition; identity graph handles identities.

  toFunctor := modelFunctor T M
  map_restrict := model_map_restriction T M

theorem model_map_product {Q R S V : CodedProgramCategory T} (f : Q ⟶ R) (g : S ⟶ V) :
    (modelFunctor T M).map (PCategoryStruct.nearProd_map f g) =
      PFun.prodMap ((modelFunctor T M).map f) ((modelFunctor T M).map g) := by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := exists_arrowOfIndex T (objectCode Q) (objectCode R) f
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := exists_arrowOfIndex T (objectCode S) (objectCode V) g
  apply PFun.ext
  intro x y
  rw [mem_model, PFun.mem_prodMap, mem_model, mem_model]
  exact map_product_graph T M _ _ _ _ q r
    (codingEquiv T M _ x.1) (codingEquiv T M _ x.2)
    (codingEquiv T M _ y.1) (codingEquiv T M _ y.2)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.SyntacticModel.model_map_first_projection
references.source:
theorem model_map_first_projection (Q R : STObjectCode) :
    (modelFunctor T M).map (PCategoryStruct.p0 (object T Q) (object T R)) =
      PFun.lift (Prod.fst : interpretedType M Q × interpretedType M R → interpretedType M Q) := by
  apply PFun.ext
  intro x y
  rw [mem_model]
  change codingEquiv T M Q y ∈
    (functor T M).map (PCategoryStruct.p0 (object T Q) (object T R))
    (productCoding T M Q R (codingEquiv T M Q x.1, codingEquiv T M R x.2)) ↔ _
  rw [map_first_projection]
  simp only [PFun.lift, Part.mem_some_iff]
  change codingEquiv T M Q y = codingEquiv T M Q x.1 ↔ y = x.1
  exact (codingEquiv T M Q).injective.eq_iff

  apply PFun.ext
  intro x y
  rw [mem_model]

    (functor T M).map (PCategoryStruct.p1 (object T Q) (object T R))

  simp only [PFun.lift, Part.mem_some_iff]

lem:switch.label: lem:switch
lem:switch.reconstruction: For complementary source domains, their Σ₁ predicates give a T-provably total functional reversed-tag relation, so obtain total source switch by search; in each model it will be the unique section of the specified partial injection.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.SyntacticModel.syntactic_finite_switch
references.source:
theorem syntactic_finite_switch {X : CodedProgramCategory T} (c c' : Idem X)
    (hc : Complementary c c') :
    ∃ s : X ⟶ coprod X X, isTotal s ∧
      c.hom ≫ s = c.hom ≫ i1 X X ∧ c'.hom ≫ s = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_arrowOfIndex T (objectCode X) (objectCode X) c.hom
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_arrowOfIndex T (objectCode X) (objectCode X) c'.hom
  exact ⟨finiteSwitchArrow T X q r, finiteSwitchArrow_total T c c' hc q r hq.symm hr.symm,
    finiteSwitchArrow_branch1 T c c' hc q r hq.symm hr.symm,
    finiteSwitchArrow_branch0 T c c' hc q r hq.symm hr.symm⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.SyntacticModel.family_finite_switch
references.source:
theorem family_finite_switch {X : CodedProgramCategory T} (c c' : Idem X)
    (hc : Complementary c c') :
    ∃ s : X ⟶ coprod X X, isTotal s ∧
      c.hom ≫ s = c.hom ≫ i1 X X ∧ c'.hom ≫ s = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X ∧
      (familyFunctor T).map s =
        switchSection ((familyRangeFunctor T).mapIdem c) ((familyRangeFunctor T).mapIdem c')
          ((familyRangeFunctor T).map_complementary hc) ≫
            ((familyRangeFunctor T).comparison X X).hom := by
  obtain ⟨s, ht, h1, h0⟩ := syntactic_finite_switch T c c' hc
  exact ⟨s, ht, h1, h0, image_switch_eq (familyRangeFunctor T) c c' hc s h1 h0⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.image_switch_eq
references.source:
theorem image_switch_eq (F : RangeFunctor C A) {X : C}
    (c c' : Idem X) (hc : Complementary c c') (ℓ : X ⟶ coprod X X)
    (h1 : c.hom ≫ ℓ = c.hom ≫ i1 X X)
    (h0 : c'.hom ≫ ℓ = c'.hom ≫ i0 X X) :
    F.toFunctor.map ℓ =
      switchSection (F.mapIdem c) (F.mapIdem c') (F.map_complementary hc) ≫
        (F.comparison X X).hom := by
  let s := switchSection (F.mapIdem c) (F.mapIdem c') (F.map_complementary hc)
  have hs := switchSection_spec (F.mapIdem c) (F.mapIdem c') (F.map_complementary hc)
  have he : F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ (F.comparison X X).inv = s := by
    apply complementary_hom_ext (F.map_complementary hc)
    · change F.toFunctor.map c.hom ≫ (F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ _) = _
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← F.toFunctor.map_comp, h1, F.toFunctor.map_comp,
        Category.assoc, ← F.i1_comparison, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
        Category.comp_id, hs.2.2.1]
      rfl
    · change F.toFunctor.map c'.hom ≫ (F.toFunctor.map ℓ ≫ _) = _
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← F.toFunctor.map_comp, h0, F.toFunctor.map_comp,
        Category.assoc, ← F.i0_comparison, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
        Category.comp_id, hs.2.2.2]
      rfl
  have hh := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (F.comparison X X).hom) he
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] using hh

theorem syntactic_pair_inseparable_v46_of_model
    (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T]
    (τ : nearProd (omegaObject T) (omegaObject T) ⟶ omegaObject T)
    (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ)
    (b : omegaObject T ≅ coprod (omegaObject T) (omegaObject T)) :
    Inseparable (diagonal0 τ b) (diagonal1 τ b) := by
  have hU : (modelRangeFunctor T M).toFunctor.map (𝟙 (omegaObject T)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [(modelRangeFunctor T M).toFunctor.map_id]
    intro he
    have h := congrFun he (0 : M)
    change Part.some (0 : M) = Part.none at h
    exact Part.notMem_none 0 (h ▸ Part.mem_some 0)
  exact source_inseparable_of_complementary_conditionals (modelRangeFunctor T M)
    τ hτ b hU (fun c c' hc => syntactic_finite_switch T c c' hc)

    PreservesFiniteCoproducts (functor T M) ∧
    ∀ (C D : PredicateCategory T) (f : C ⟶ D),

theorem recursiveDomainFunctor_graph {X Y : TotalSplit T} (f : X ⟶ Y)

    (recursiveDomainFunctor T M).map f x = y ↔
      y.val ∈ (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor T M).map f.hom.hom x.val := by

lem:semantic-substitution.label: lem:semantic-substitution
lem:semantic-substitution.reconstruction: Term substitution is evaluation under a reassigned variable; admissible formula substitution has the corresponding iff for every assignment. Prove free-variable dependence by induction over all constructors.

theorem evaluate_termSubstitution (q : Obj 𝗣𝗔 ℕ (X ⨯ P)) (ρ : ℕ → K) :
    evaluate σ π d functions ((G).map (S).termSubstitution q) ρ =
      evaluate σ π d functions ((G).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := X) («Y» := P)) q)
        (Function.update ρ
          ((G).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) («Y» := X))
            ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := X) («Y» := P)) q)).val
          (evaluate σ π d functions ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) («Y» := X))
            ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := X) («Y» := P)) q)) ρ)) := by
  exact numerical_evaluate_substitute σ π d functions
    ((G).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) («Y» := X)) ((G).map prod.snd q)).val
    ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) («Y» := X)) ((G).map prod.snd q))
    ((G).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := X) («Y» := P)) q) ((G).map (S).termSubstitution q) ρ
    (plain_termSubstitution_value 𝗣𝗔 variableCarrier σ π d ℕ q).symm

    Holds σ π d functions relations ((G).map (S).formulaSubstitution a) ρ ↔
      Holds σ π d functions relations
        ((G).map (prod.fst (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := Y) («Y» := P)) ((G).map (S).admissibleInclusion a))
        (Function.update ρ

            ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := Y) («Y» := P)) ((G).map (S).admissibleInclusion a))).val
          (evaluate σ π d functions ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) («Y» := X))
            ((G).map (prod.snd (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) («X» := Y) («Y» := P)) ((G).map (S).admissibleInclusion a))) ρ)) := by

references.source:
theorem evaluate_substitute (r t : Term Sig d) (x : ℕ) (ρ : ℕ → K) :
    (r.substitute x t).evaluate functions ρ =
      r.evaluate functions (Function.update ρ x (t.evaluate functions ρ)) := by
  induction r with
  | var y => by_cases h : y = x <;> simp [substitute, evaluate, h]
  | app n f children ih =>
      apply congrArg (functions n f)
      funext i
      exact ih i

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedFiniteSyntax.Formula.holds_substitute
references.source:
theorem holds_substitute (φ ψ : Formula Sig Rel d) (t : Term Sig d) (x : ℕ) (ρ : ℕ → K)
    (h : φ.substitute x t = some ψ) :
    ψ.Holds functions relations ρ ↔
      φ.Holds functions relations (Function.update ρ x (t.evaluate functions ρ)) := by
  induction φ generalizing ψ ρ with
  | equal r s =>
      simp only [substitute, Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst ψ
      simp only [Holds, Term.evaluate_substitute]
  | relation n p children =>
      simp only [substitute, Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst ψ
      simp only [Holds, Term.evaluate_substitute]
  | neg body ih =>
      cases hb : body.substitute x t with
      | none => simp [substitute, hb] at h
      | some body' =>
          simp only [substitute, hb, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst ψ
          exact not_congr (ih body' ρ hb)
  | imp left right il ir =>
      cases hl : left.substitute x t with
      | none => simp [substitute, hl] at h
      | some left' =>
          cases hr : right.substitute x t with
          | none => simp [substitute, hl, hr] at h
          | some right' =>
              simp [substitute, hl, hr] at h
              subst ψ
              exact imp_congr (il left' ρ hl) (ir right' ρ hr)
  | all y body ih =>
      by_cases hy : y = x
      · subst y
        simp [substitute] at h
        subst ψ
        simp only [Holds, Function.update_idem]
      · by_cases hx : x ∉ body.freeVariables
        · have hf : x ∉ (all y body).freeVariables := by
            intro hm
            exact hx (List.mem_filter.mp hm).1
          rw [substitute_absent _ x t hf] at h
          have he := Option.some.inj h
          subst ψ
          exact (holds_update_absent functions relations _ x ρ _ hf).symm
        · by_cases ht : y ∉ t.freeVariables
          · cases hb : body.substitute x t with
            | none => simp [substitute, hy, ht, hb] at h
            | some body' =>
                simp [substitute, hy, ht, hb] at h
                subst ψ
                simp only [Holds]
                apply forall_congr'
                intro a
                have hi := ih body' (Function.update ρ y a) hb
                have hv := t.evaluate_update_absent functions y ρ a ht
                rw [hv, Function.update_comm hy] at hi
                exact hi
          · simp [substitute, hy, hx, ht] at h

theorem plain_termSubstitution_value (q : Obj T M (X ⨯ P)) :
    ((F T M).map (S).termSubstitution q).val =
      ConcreteNamedSubstitution.substitutionResult V σ π d
        ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⟶ V) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
        ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
        ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val := by
  erw [plain_termSubstitution_eq_computed T V σ π d]
  exact braided_value T M (computedPlainTermResult T V V σ π d) Subtype.val
    (ConcreteNamedSubstitution.substitutionResult V σ π d)
    (fun z => computedPlainTermResult_value T V V σ π d M z) q

references.source:
theorem plain_formulaSubstitution_result (a : Obj T M (S).admissibleSubstitution) :
    let q := (F T M).map (S).admissibleInclusion a
    ConcreteNamedSubstitution.substitutionResult V σ π d
      ((F T M).map (prod.fst : P ⟶ V) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
      ((F T M).map (prod.snd : P ⟶ X) ((F T M).map prod.snd q)).val
      ((F T M).map prod.fst q).val =
        ConcreteNamedSubstitution.ok ((F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitution a).val := by
  let q := (F T M).map (S).admissibleInclusion a
  have hv := plain_formulaSubstitutionOption_value T V σ π d M q
  have hs : (F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitutionOption q =
      (F T M).map (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y)) ((F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitution a) := by
    exact parameterPoint_diagram T M (S).admissibleInclusion (S).formulaSubstitutionOption
      (S).formulaSubstitution (coprod.inr (C := PredicateCategory T) («X» := ⊤_ (PredicateCategory T)) («Y» := Y)) (S).formulaSubstitution_square a
  exact hv.symm.trans ((congrArg (optionCode T M Y) hs).trans
    (optionCode_inr T M Y ((F T M).map (S).formulaSubstitution a)))

def functor : Type u ⥤ Type u where
  obj := Obj U
  map f := ↾(Germ.map f)
  map_id X := by
    ext x
    exact congrFun Germ.map_id x

    ∀ (X Y : Type u) (f : X ⟶ Y),
      ∃ e : (functor U).obj (image f) ≅ image ((functor U).map f),
        e.hom ≫ image.ι ((functor U).map f) = (functor U).map (image.ι f) :=

def subtypeEquiv {X : Type u} (p : X → Prop) :
    Obj U {x // p x} ≃ {x : Obj U X // Germ.LiftPred p x} :=
  Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun x => ⟨Germ.map Subtype.val x, (subtype_range U p _).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨fun x y h => map_injective U Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h),
      fun x => by

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticUltrapower.eval_representative
references.source:
theorem eval_representative {n : ℕ} (φ : ArithmeticSemisentence n)
    (b : Fin n → I → ℕ) :
    φ.Evalb (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) ↔
      ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (fun j => b j i) := by
  induction φ using Semiformula.rec' with
  | hverum => simp
  | hfalsum =>
    change False ↔ ∀ᶠ _ in (U : Filter I), False
    constructor
    · exact False.elim
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h.exists
      exact hi
  | hrel r ts =>
    cases r with
    | eq =>
      change (ts 0).val _ _ = (ts 1).val _ _ ↔
        ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), (ts 0).val _ _ = (ts 1).val _ _
      rw [term_representative, term_representative]
      exact Germ.coe_eq
    | lt =>
      change Germ.LiftRel (l := (U : Filter I)) (fun a b : ℕ => a < b)
        ((ts 0).val (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) Empty.elim)
        ((ts 1).val (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) Empty.elim) ↔
        ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I),
          (ts 0).val (M := ℕ) (fun j => b j i) Empty.elim <
            (ts 1).val (M := ℕ) (fun j => b j i) Empty.elim
      rw [term_representative, term_representative]
      rfl
  | hnrel r ts =>
    cases r with
    | eq =>
      change (¬(ts 0).val _ _ = (ts 1).val _ _) ↔
        ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), ¬(ts 0).val _ _ = (ts 1).val _ _
      rw [term_representative, term_representative, Germ.coe_eq]
      exact Ultrafilter.eventually_not.symm
    | lt =>
      change (¬Germ.LiftRel (l := (U : Filter I)) (fun a b : ℕ => a < b)
        ((ts 0).val (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) Empty.elim)
        ((ts 1).val (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) Empty.elim)) ↔
        ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I),
          ¬(ts 0).val (M := ℕ) (fun j => b j i) Empty.elim <
            (ts 1).val (M := ℕ) (fun j => b j i) Empty.elim
      rw [term_representative, term_representative, Germ.liftRel_coe]
      exact Ultrafilter.eventually_not.symm
  | hand φ ψ hp hq =>
    change (φ.Evalb (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) ∧
      ψ.Evalb (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j))) ↔ _
    rw [hp, hq]
    exact Filter.eventually_and.symm
  | hor φ ψ hp hq =>
    change (φ.Evalb (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j)) ∨
      ψ.Evalb (M := Model U) (fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j))) ↔ _
    rw [hp, hq]
    exact Ultrafilter.eventually_or.symm
  | hall φ ih =>
    change (∀ x : Model U, φ.Evalb (x :> fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j))) ↔
      ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), ∀ x : ℕ, φ.Evalb (x :> fun j => b j i)
    constructor
    · intro h
      let x : I → ℕ := fun i => Classical.epsilon
        (fun a => ¬φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (a :> fun j => b j i))
      have ihx := ih (x :> b)
      simp only [germ_cons, coordinate_cons] at ihx
      have hx := ihx.mp (h (Germ.ofFun x))
      filter_upwards [hx] with i hi a
      by_contra ha
      have hn := Classical.epsilon_spec (p := fun z =>
        ¬φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (z :> fun j => b j i)) ⟨a, ha⟩
      exact hn hi
    · intro h x
      induction x using Germ.inductionOn with | _ x =>
        have ihx := ih (x :> b)
        simp only [germ_cons, coordinate_cons] at ihx
        apply ihx.mpr
        filter_upwards [h] with i hi
        exact hi (x i)
  | hexs φ ih =>
    change (∃ x : Model U, φ.Evalb (x :> fun j => Germ.ofFun (b j))) ↔
      ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), ∃ x : ℕ, φ.Evalb (x :> fun j => b j i)
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      induction x using Germ.inductionOn with | _ x =>
        have ihx := ih (x :> b)
        simp only [germ_cons, coordinate_cons] at ihx
        have hx' := ihx.mp hx
        filter_upwards [hx'] with i hi
        exact ⟨x i, hi⟩
    · intro h
      let x : I → ℕ := fun i => Classical.epsilon
        (fun a => φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (a :> fun j => b j i))
      refine ⟨Germ.ofFun x, ?_⟩
      have hx : ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I),
          φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (x i :> fun j => b j i) := by
        filter_upwards [h] with i hi
        exact Classical.epsilon_spec (p := fun a =>
          φ.Evalb (M := ℕ) (a :> fun j => b j i)) hi
      have ihx := ih (x :> b)
      simp only [germ_cons, coordinate_cons] at ihx
      exact ihx.mpr hx

references.source:
def predicateComparison :
    PredicateInterpretation.functor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ ⋙ Ultrapower.functor U ≅
      PredicateInterpretation.functor 𝗣𝗔 (Model U) :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun C => (predicateEquiv U C).toIso) (by
    intro C D f
    induction f using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ f =>
      ext a
      induction a using Germ.inductionOn with | _ a =>
        symm
        apply (PredicateInterpretation.value_eq_iff 𝗣𝗔 (Model U) f _ _).mpr
        change f.graph.val.Evalb
          ![Germ.ofFun (fun i => (a i).val),
            Germ.ofFun (fun i => (PredicateInterpretation.value 𝗣𝗔 ℕ f (a i)).val)]
        have h : ∀ᶠ i in (U : Filter I), f.graph.val.Evalb
            ![(a i).val, (PredicateInterpretation.value 𝗣𝗔 ℕ f (a i)).val] :=
          Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun i => PredicateInterpretation.value_graph 𝗣𝗔 ℕ f (a i))
        have hl := eval_representative U f.graph.val
          ![fun i => (a i).val,
            fun i => (PredicateInterpretation.value 𝗣𝗔 ℕ f (a i)).val]
        simp only [germ_cons, coordinate_cons, Matrix.empty_eq] at hl
        exact hl.mpr h)

theorem canonicalSoundnessFactor_inclusion :
    canonicalSoundnessFactor σ π d functions relations (A := A) axioms haxioms ≫
      canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations =
        (H).map ((E).map (FirstOrderModelSoundness.sentenceConclusion 𝗣𝗔 (V := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (σ := σ) (π := π) (d := d) (S) (A := A) axioms)) := by
  let P := FirstOrderModelSoundness.sentenceProofObject 𝗣𝗔 (V := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (σ := σ) (π := π) (d := d) (S) (A := A) axioms
  let c := FirstOrderModelSoundness.sentenceConclusion 𝗣𝗔 (V := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (σ := σ) (π := π) (d := d) (S) (A := A) axioms
  let e := soundnessFactor σ π d functions relations (A := A) axioms haxioms
  let v := sentenceValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations
  change ((η).inv.app P ≫ e) ≫ (v ≫ (η).hom.app (S).sentenceObject) = (H).map ((E).map c)
  calc
    _ = (η).inv.app P ≫ ((e ≫ v) ≫ (η).hom.app (S).sentenceObject) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (η).inv.app P ≫ ((G).map c ≫ (η).hom.app (S).sentenceObject) := by
      rw [soundnessFactor_inclusion]
    _ = (η).inv.app P ≫ ((η).hom.app P ≫ (H).map ((E).map c)) := by
      rw [(η).hom.naturality c]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by
      have hi := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (H).map ((E).map c)) ((η).inv_hom_id_app P)
      simpa only [Category.assoc,Category.id_comp] using hi

theorem canonicalValidity_disjoint [Nonempty K] :
    Disjoint (Set.range (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations))
      (((H).map ((E).map (S).sentenceNegation)) ⁻¹'
        Set.range (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations)) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro z ⟨a,rfl⟩ ⟨b,hb⟩
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f (sentenceValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations a))
    ((η).hom.naturality (S).sentenceNegation)
  have he := ((η).app (S).sentenceObject).toEquiv.injective (hb.trans hn.symm)
  have hb' : sentenceValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations b ∈
      validSentenceSet σ π d functions relations := b.property
  have hneg := (congrArg (fun s : Obj 𝗣𝗔 ℕ (S).sentenceObject =>
    s ∈ validSentenceSet σ π d functions relations) he).mp hb'
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (sentence_validity_disjoint σ π d functions relations)
    a.property hneg

theorem canonical_ultrapower_soundness [Nonempty K] {I : Type} (U : Ultrafilter I) :
    Mono (Ultrapower.transportValidity U (ArithmeticUltrapower.canonicalComparison U)
      (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations)) ∧
    Ultrapower.transportSoundness U (ArithmeticUltrapower.canonicalComparison U)
        (canonicalSoundnessFactor σ π d functions relations (A := A) axioms haxioms) ≫
      Ultrapower.transportValidity U (ArithmeticUltrapower.canonicalComparison U)
        (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations) =
      (PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)).map
        ((E).map (FirstOrderModelSoundness.sentenceConclusion 𝗣𝗔 (V := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (σ := σ) (π := π) (d := d) (S) (A := A) axioms)) ∧
    Disjoint (Set.range (Ultrapower.transportValidity U (ArithmeticUltrapower.canonicalComparison U)
      (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations)))
      (((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)).map
          ((E).map (S).sentenceNegation)) ⁻¹'
        Set.range (Ultrapower.transportValidity U (ArithmeticUltrapower.canonicalComparison U)
          (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations))) :=
  ArithmeticUltrapower.canonical_soundness_transport U
    ((E).map (FirstOrderModelSoundness.sentenceConclusion 𝗣𝗔 (V := (variableCarrier : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (σ := σ) (π := π) (d := d) (S) (A := A) axioms)) ((E).map (S).sentenceNegation)
    (canonicalValidityInclusion σ π d functions relations)
    (canonicalSoundnessFactor σ π d functions relations (A := A) axioms haxioms)
    (canonicalSoundnessFactor_inclusion σ π d functions relations (A := A) axioms haxioms)
    (canonicalValidity_disjoint σ π d functions relations)

include functions relations haxioms in

theorem theta_theory_pull (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) :
    Idem.pull (thetaMap M φ hφ) (theory M Γ) =
      setIdem {n : M | (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n]} := by
  have h := ArithmeticSetModelLaws.pull_some_of_support
    (fun n => (H).map (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.theta φ hφ)
      (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 M n))
    (theory M Γ) (fun s => (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![s.val.val])
    (theory_support M Γ)
  apply h.trans
  apply congrArg (fun S : Set M => setIdem S)
  apply Set.ext
  intro n
  change (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb
    ![((H).map (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.theta φ hφ)
      (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 M n)).val.val] ↔
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n]
  exact (Iff.of_eq (congrArg
    (fun w : M => (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![w]) (theta_value M φ hφ n))).trans
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive_eval M Γ φ n).symm

theorem theta_refutation_pull (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) :
    Idem.pull (thetaMap M φ hφ) (Idem.pull (negationMap M) (theory M Γ)) =
      setIdem {n : M | (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n]} := by
  have h := ArithmeticSetModelLaws.pull_twice_some_of_support
    (fun n => (H).map (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.theta φ hφ)
      (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 M n))
    ((H).map ((E).map negation)) (theory M Γ)
    (fun s => (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![s.val.val]) (theory_support M Γ)
  apply h.trans
  apply congrArg (fun S : Set M => setIdem S)
  apply Set.ext
  intro n
  exact (Iff.of_eq (congrArg
    (fun w : M => (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![w])
    ((negation_value M ((H).map (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.theta φ hφ)
      (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 M n))).trans
        (congrArg (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord M) (theta_value M φ hφ n))))).trans
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative_eval_word M Γ φ hφ n).symm

    (Ranges.range ((realization 𝗣𝗔).map (conclusion Γ)).hom).hom = _
  exact ((canonicalExtension M).map_range ((realization 𝗣𝗔).map (conclusion Γ)).hom).trans
    (congrArg (fun g => (Ranges.range g).hom)
