references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticDiagonalRepresentation.printed_representation
references.source:
theorem printed_representation :
    ∃ f : ArithmeticOmegaComparison.identityOmega 𝗣𝗔 ⟶
        NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.literalSentence,
      isTotal f.hom ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map f
        (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ n)).val.val =
          formulaCode (NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula
            ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n)) ∧
      ∀ Γ : Carrier, ArithmeticNamedAxiomComparison.ExtendsPA Γ →
        ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M ≡ₑ[ℒₒᵣ] ℕ],
          letI : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := Tarski.Structure.ElementaryEquiv.modelsTheory' M ℕ 𝗣𝗔
          (SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).mapIdem ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.a0 ≤
            Idem.pull (modelTheta M f)
              ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension M).mapIdem
                (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory Γ)) ∧
          (SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).mapIdem ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.a1 ≤
            Idem.pull (modelTheta M f)
              (Idem.pull ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension M).toFunctor.map
                ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceNegation)
                ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension M).mapIdem
                  (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory Γ))) :=
  ⟨theta,theta_total,theta_standard,fun Γ hΓ M _ _ => bounds Γ hΓ M⟩

lem:arithmetic-proof-search.label: lem:arithmetic-proof-search
lem:arithmetic-proof-search.reconstruction: For every c.e. Γ, take Γ-proof-search graph R tagged odd for positive and even for negative. Functional search yields a PA program return relation and exact disjunctive domain even without uniform PA disjointness.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.printed_diagonal_partial_proof_search
references.source:
theorem printed_diagonal_partial_proof_search (Γ : Carrier) :
    ∃ l : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ coprod (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔),
      ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔],
        (∀ n : M, ¬(
          (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
              ![NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.value ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n] ∧
          (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
              ![negationWord M (NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.value ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n)])) →
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map l ≫
          ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
            (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv)
          (summand0 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {n : M | (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
                ![negationWord M (NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.value ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n)]} ∧
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map l ≫
          ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
            (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv)
          (summand1 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {n : M | (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
                ![NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.value ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val n]} :=
  printed_partial_proof_search Γ
    (NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.namedFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val)
    (NamedArithmeticUnarySubstitution.namedFormula_freeVariables ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.printed_partial_proof_search
references.source:
theorem printed_partial_proof_search (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) :
    ∃ l : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ coprod (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔),
      ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔],
        (∀ n : M, ¬(
          (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
              ![NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n] ∧
          (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
              ![negationWord M (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n)])) →
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map l ≫
          ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
            (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv)
          (summand0 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {n : M | (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
                ![negationWord M (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n)]} ∧
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map l ≫
          ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
            (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv)
          (summand1 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {n : M | (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
                ![NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n]} := by
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := partial_proof_search Γ φ
  refine ⟨l,fun M _ _ hd => ?_⟩
  have hdisjoint : ∀ n : M, ¬((positive Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n] ∧ (negative Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n]) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hd n ⟨(positive_eval M Γ φ n).mp hn.1,
      (negative_eval_word M Γ φ hφ n).mp hn.2⟩
  obtain ⟨hzero,hone⟩ := hl M hdisjoint
  constructor
  · erw [coproduct_comparison_inv_eq_id M,Category.comp_id]
    simpa only [negative_eval_word M Γ φ hφ] using hzero
  · erw [coproduct_comparison_inv_eq_id M,Category.comp_id]
    simpa only [positive_eval M Γ φ] using hone

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.ell_comparison_inv
references.source:
theorem ell_comparison_inv (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula) (M : Type)
    [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔] :
    (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map (ell Γ φ) ≫
      ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
        (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv =
      (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map (ell Γ φ) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f ≫
      ((SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).comparison
        (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv)
    (ell_comparison M Γ φ)
  simpa only [Category.assoc,Iso.hom_inv_id,Category.comp_id] using h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative_eval_word
references.source:
theorem negative_eval_word (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) (n : M) :
    (negative Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n] ↔
      (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
        variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ).val.Evalb
          ![negationWord M (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n)] := by
  have hs := NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value_sentence (M := M) φ hφ n
  have hx := ((ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔
    variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound M _).mp hs).1
  have hg : ∀ y : M,
      (chosenGraph 𝗣𝗔
        (plainCategoricalSyntax 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound).negationConstructor).graph.val.Evalb
          ![NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n,y] ↔
        y = negationWord M (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ n) := by
    intro y
    exact NegationCoding.constructor_graph_of_member 𝗣𝗔 M
      variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound _ y hx
  rw [negative_eval M Γ φ n]
  simp only [hg,exists_eq_left]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive_source_pull
references.source:
theorem positive_source_pull (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) :
    Idem.pull (sourceTheta φ hφ)
      (predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
        variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ)) =
      predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (positive Γ φ) := by
  unfold sourceTheta
  rw [graphPullCarrier_idem]
  apply Idem.ext
  apply CodedHom.ext
  change predicateClass 𝗣𝗔 (graphPullCarrier 𝗣𝗔 (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.morphism φ hφ)
    (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
      variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ)) = predicateClass 𝗣𝗔 (positive Γ φ)
  apply programClass_ext 𝗣𝗔
  intro M _ _ x y
  simp only [predicateClass_model,graphPullCarrier_eval,
    NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.morphism_graph_eval,positive_eval,exists_eq_left]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative_source_pull
references.source:
theorem negative_source_pull (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) :
    Idem.pull (sourceTheta φ hφ)
      (predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalRefutationCarrier 𝗣𝗔
        variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ)) =
      predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (negative Γ φ) := by
  unfold sourceTheta
  rw [graphPullCarrier_idem]
  apply Idem.ext
  apply CodedHom.ext
  change predicateClass 𝗣𝗔 (graphPullCarrier 𝗣𝗔 (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.morphism φ hφ)
    (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalRefutationCarrier 𝗣𝗔
      variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ)) = predicateClass 𝗣𝗔 (negative Γ φ)
  apply programClass_ext 𝗣𝗔
  intro M _ _ x y
  simp only [predicateClass_model,graphPullCarrier_eval,
    NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.morphism_graph_eval,
    negative_literal_refutation M Γ φ hφ,exists_eq_left]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedArithmeticProofSearch.ell_source_fibers
references.source:
theorem ell_source_fibers (Γ : Carrier) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0)
    (hd : ∀ n : M, ¬((positive Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n] ∧ (negative Γ φ).val.Evalb ![n])) :
    Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map (ell Γ φ))
      (summand0 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
        (SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).mapIdem
          (Idem.pull (sourceTheta φ hφ)
            (predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalRefutationCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ))) ∧
    Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map (ell Γ φ))
      (summand1 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
        (SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).mapIdem
          (Idem.pull (sourceTheta φ hφ)
            (predicateIdem 𝗣𝗔 (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
              variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound Γ))) := by
  exact ⟨(pull_summand0 M Γ φ hd).trans (negative_source_pull_model M Γ φ hφ).symm,
    (pull_summand1 M Γ φ hd).trans (positive_source_pull_model M Γ φ hφ).symm⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.PartialSearchLift.partial_lift
references.source:
theorem partial_lift (C D : Carrier) :
    ∃ ell : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ coprod (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔),
      ∀ (M : Type) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔],
        (∀ x : M, ¬(C.val.Evalb ![x] ∧ D.val.Evalb ![x])) →
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map ell)
          (summand0 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {x : M | D.val.Evalb ![x]} ∧
        Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map ell)
          (summand1 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
            setIdem {x : M | C.val.Evalb ![x]} := by
  exact ⟨lift C D, fun M _ _ hd => ⟨pull_summand0 M C D hd, pull_summand1 M C D hd⟩⟩

thm:arithmetic-internal-comparison.label: thm:arithmetic-internal-comparison
thm:arithmetic-internal-comparison.reconstruction: For consistent c.e. Γ deriving PA axioms, use first-order completeness to get K⊨Γ and standard or ultrapower soundness. Conclude internal and all specified interpreted theories are incomplete, plus standard total g producing independent sentences at every n.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedGammaModel.exists_model
references.source:
theorem exists_model
    (hPA : ArithmeticNamedAxiomComparison.ExtendsPA A)
    (hc : Entailment.Consistent S) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (s : ORingStructure K), letI := s;
      NamedGammaSoundness.Models functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A
        ArithmeticNamedTranslation.functions ArithmeticNamedTranslation.relations
        (fun _ => (0 : K)) := by
  rcases exists_model_all_assignments A hPA hc with ⟨K,s,hK⟩
  let := s
  exact ⟨K,s,hK (fun _ => 0)⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedGammaEvidenceSoundness.standard_sentence_evidence_disjoint
references.source:
theorem standard_sentence_evidence_disjoint (word : ℕ)
    (hs : (ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols
      functionSymbols relationSymbols bound).val.Evalb ![word]) :
    ¬ ((literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A).val.Evalb ![word] ∧
      (literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A).val.Evalb
        ![NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord ℕ word]) := by
  rintro ⟨ht,hn⟩
  have hx := ((ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔
    variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound ℕ word).mp hs).1
  have hg := (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.NegationCoding.constructor_graph_of_member
    𝗣𝗔 ℕ variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound word
    (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord ℕ word) hx).mpr rfl
  apply consistent_standard_word_disjoint A hPA hc word
  exact ⟨ht,(literalRefutationCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound
    ℕ A word).mpr ⟨hs,NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord ℕ word,hg,hn⟩⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NamedGammaEvidenceSoundness.ultrapower_sentence_evidence_disjoint
references.source:
theorem ultrapower_sentence_evidence_disjoint {I : Type} (U : Ultrafilter I)
    (word : ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)
    (hs : (ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols
      functionSymbols relationSymbols bound).val.Evalb ![word]) :
    ¬ ((literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A).val.Evalb ![word] ∧
      (literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A).val.Evalb
        ![NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) word]) := by
  rintro ⟨ht,hn⟩
  have hx := ((ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔
    variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) word).mp hs).1
  have hg := (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.NegationCoding.constructor_graph_of_member
    𝗣𝗔 (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound word
    (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) word) hx).mpr rfl
  apply consistent_ultrapower_word_disjoint A hPA hc U word
  exact ⟨ht,(literalRefutationCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound
    (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) A word).mpr
      ⟨hs,NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U) word,hg,hn⟩⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticComparisonTarget.comparison_of_evidence_bounds
references.source:
theorem comparison_of_evidence_bounds
    (hΓ : ∀ s : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M sentencePredicate,
      ¬ ((theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![s.val] ∧
        (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord M s.val]))
    (hzero : ∀ n : M, ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val.Evalb ![n] →
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive Γ diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![n])
    (hone : ∀ n : M, ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta.val.Evalb ![n] →
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative Γ diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![n]) :
    ∃ g : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ omegaObject 𝗣𝗔, isTotal g ∧
      Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map g ≫
        ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ) = ⊥ ∧
      Idem.pull ((SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map g ≫
        ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
        (Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap M) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ)) = ⊥ ∧
      ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ ⊔ Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap M) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ) ≠ ⊤ := by
  let F := SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M
  have hU : F.toFunctor.map (𝟙 (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [F.toFunctor.map_id]
    intro he
    have h := congrFun he (0 : M)
    change Part.some (0 : M) = Part.none at h
    exact Part.notMem_none 0 (h ▸ Part.mem_some 0)
  have hdisjoint : ∀ n : M, ¬(
      (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb ![NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value diagonalFormula n] ∧
      (theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb
        ![NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord M
          (NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value diagonalFormula n)]) := by
    intro n
    exact hΓ (thetaPoint M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables n)
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := NamedArithmeticProofSearch.printed_partial_proof_search
    Γ diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables
  obtain ⟨hs0,hs1⟩ := hl M hdisjoint
  let s := (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 M).map l ≫
    (F.comparison (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔) (omegaObject 𝗣𝗔)).inv
  have hsa : Idem.pull s (summand0 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
      Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
        (Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap M) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ)) := by
    exact hs0.trans ((ArithmeticSetModelLaws.setIdem_congr (fun n =>
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative_eval_word M Γ diagonalFormula
        diagonalFormula_freeVariables n).symm)).trans
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_refutation_pull M Γ diagonalFormula
        diagonalFormula_freeVariables).symm)
  have hsb : Idem.pull s (summand1 (PartialFun.of M) (PartialFun.of M)) =
      Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ) := by
    exact hs1.trans ((ArithmeticSetModelLaws.setIdem_congr (fun n =>
      (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive_eval M Γ diagonalFormula n).symm)).trans
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_theory_pull M Γ diagonalFormula
        diagonalFormula_freeVariables).symm)
  have ha0 : F.mapIdem (diagonal0 ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.sourceTau (omegaCoprodIso 𝗣𝗔).symm) ≤
      Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ) := by
    exact le_of_eq_of_le (ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.model_a0 M)
      (le_of_le_of_eq (ArithmeticSetModelLaws.setIdem_le hzero)
        (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_theory_pull M Γ diagonalFormula
          diagonalFormula_freeVariables).symm)
  have ha1 : F.mapIdem (diagonal1 ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.sourceTau (omegaCoprodIso 𝗣𝗔).symm) ≤
      Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
        (Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap M) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ)) := by
    exact le_of_eq_of_le (ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.model_a1 M)
      (le_of_le_of_eq (ArithmeticSetModelLaws.setIdem_le hone)
        (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_refutation_pull M Γ diagonalFormula
          diagonalFormula_freeVariables).symm)
  have hlift : F.toFunctor.map l = s ≫ (F.comparison _ _).hom := by
    dsimp only [s]
    simp only [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  exact logical_comparison_target F ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.sourceTau
    ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.sourceTau_isTuring (omegaCoprodIso 𝗣𝗔).symm hU
    (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
    (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap_total M diagonalFormula diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
    (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap M) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory M Γ) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory_consistent M Γ hΓ)
    ha0 ha1 s hsa hsb l hlift

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticInternalComparison.internal_comparison
references.source:
theorem internal_comparison :
    (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A ⊔
      Idem.pull ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceNegation
        (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A) ≠ ⊤) ∧
    ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension ℕ).mapIdem
        (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A) ⊔
      Idem.pull ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension ℕ).toFunctor.map
        ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceNegation)
        ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension ℕ).mapIdem
          (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A)) ≠ ⊤) ∧
    (∀ (I : Type) (U : Ultrafilter I),
      (ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)).mapIdem
          (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A) ⊔
        Idem.pull ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)).toFunctor.map
          ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceNegation)
          ((ArithmeticDomainExtension.canonicalExtension (ArithmeticUltrapower.Model U)).mapIdem
            (ArithmeticDomainExtension.sentenceTheory A)) ≠ ⊤) ∧
    (∃ g : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ omegaObject 𝗣𝗔, isTotal g ∧
      ∃ gamma : ℕ → ℕ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, gamma n ∈ (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map g n) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n)
          ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula.substitute 0 (numeral (gamma n)) = some φ ∧
          φ.freeVariables = [] ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A φ ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A (.neg φ)) :=
  ⟨source_incomplete A hPA hc,interpreted_standard_incomplete A hPA hc,
    (fun _ U => interpreted_ultrapower_incomplete A hPA hc U),total_undecidable_family A hPA hc⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticInternalComparison.total_undecidable_family
references.source:
theorem total_undecidable_family :
    ∃ g : omegaObject 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ omegaObject 𝗣𝗔, isTotal g ∧
      ∃ gamma : ℕ → ℕ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, gamma n ∈ (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map g n) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n)
          ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula.substitute 0 (numeral (gamma n)) = some φ ∧
          φ.freeVariables = [] ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A φ ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound A (.neg φ) := by
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hpositive,hnegative,_⟩ := standard_comparison A hPA hc
  let f : PartialFun.of ℕ ⟶ PartialFun.of ℕ := (SyntacticModel.modelFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map g
  have hf : isTotal f := (SyntacticModel.modelRangeFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map_total g hg
  let gamma : ℕ → ℕ := ArithmeticSetModelLaws.totalValue f hf
  have hgamma (n : ℕ) : gamma n ∈ f n := ArithmeticSetModelLaws.totalValue_mem f hf n
  have hp (n : ℕ) : ¬ (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive A
      ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![gamma n] :=
    avoid_composite_pull f
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap ℕ ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory ℕ A)
      (fun k : ℕ => (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.positive A
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![k])
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_theory_pull ℕ A ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
      hpositive n (gamma n) (hgamma n)
  have hn (n : ℕ) : ¬ (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative A
      ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![gamma n] :=
    avoid_composite_pull f
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.thetaMap ℕ ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
      (Idem.pull (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.negationMap ℕ) (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theory ℕ A))
      (fun k : ℕ => (NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negative A
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula).val.Evalb ![k])
      (ArithmeticLiteralCoordinates.theta_refutation_pull ℕ A ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula
        ArithmeticComparisonTarget.diagonalFormula_freeVariables)
      hnegative n (gamma n) (hgamma n)
  refine ⟨g,hg,gamma,hgamma,?_⟩
  intro n
  let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n)
  have hr := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.standard_instance_result ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n)
  refine ⟨ArithmeticNamedProofTranslation.expanded_instance_substitution ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n),
    hr.2,?_,?_⟩
  · intro hd
    exact hp n (native_instance_positive A ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n) hd)
  · intro hd
    exact hn n (native_instance_negative A ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (gamma n) hd)

cor:arithmetic.label: cor:arithmetic
cor:arithmetic.reconstruction: A recursive separator of all theorem/refutation codes would pull back along Θ to a recursive separator of D₀,D₁. Its branch-coded total recursive conditional has a *partial* syntactic lift under standard interpretation, which contradicts the separator corollary.

theorem enumeration_extension_incomplete (A B : SyntacticPredicates.Carrier)
    (hPA : ArithmeticNamedAxiomComparison.ExtendsPA A)
    (hAB : ∀ word : ℕ, A.val.Evalb (M := ℕ) ![word] → B.val.Evalb (M := ℕ) ![word])

prop:arithmetic-theory-fibers.label: prop:arithmetic-theory-fibers
prop:arithmetic-theory-fibers.reconstruction: Split E into e and its complemented remainder to identify B/(E×Φ) with product of slices by extensive coproduct. Restrict by pullbacks, invert by copairing; naturality under slice maps and unit/counit follow decompositions. Goal is an actual fiber initial algebra and pullback square.

theorem realized_square (AxPA : Carrier) :
    (realization 𝗣𝗔).map (carrierIso AxPA).hom ≫ printedAxioms AxPA =
      ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.axioms AxPA := by
  calc
    _ = (realization 𝗣𝗔).map ((carrierIso AxPA).hom ≫ printedInclusion AxPA) ≫
        ArithmeticIndexedProvability.printedProductIso.hom := by
      dsimp only [printedAxioms]
      rw [Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    _ = (realization 𝗣𝗔).map (ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.predicateInclusion AxPA ≫
        (ExponentialProducts.rawProductIso 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols
          ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentencePredicate).hom) ≫
          ArithmeticIndexedProvability.printedProductIso.hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => (realization 𝗣𝗔).map f ≫ ArithmeticIndexedProvability.printedProductIso.hom)
        (mono_square AxPA)
    _ = (realization 𝗣𝗔).map (ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.predicateInclusion AxPA) ≫
        ((realization 𝗣𝗔).map (ExponentialProducts.rawProductIso 𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols
          ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentencePredicate).hom ≫
            ArithmeticIndexedProvability.printedProductIso.hom) := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp,Category.assoc]
    _ = (realization 𝗣𝗔).map (ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.predicateInclusion AxPA) ≫
        ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.productIso.hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => (realization 𝗣𝗔).map (ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.predicateInclusion AxPA) ≫ f)

    _ = _ := rfl

thm:uniform-independent-sentences.label: thm:uniform-independent-sentences
thm:uniform-independent-sentences.reconstruction: Uniform search on (e,x) returns the odd/even tag for proof/refutation of α(x); PA proves graph correctness and exact disjunctive domain. Claim ∃q:E→S ∀ consistent Γ_e, its standard value is independent.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticIndexedPAEnumeration.axiomCodes_standard
references.source:
theorem axiomCodes_standard (out : ℕ) :
    axiomCodes.val.Evalb ![out] ↔ ∃ ψ : Formula, PAAxiom ψ ∧ formulaCode ψ = out := by
  rw [axiomCodes_eval]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs,seed,hseed,hclosure⟩
    have hparts := (ConcreteNamedComparison.literalSentenceCarrier_eval 𝗣𝗔
      variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound ℕ out).mp hs
    have hstored := (SyntacticSyntax.Postfix.carrier_plain_model true termPolynomial formulaPolynomial out).mpr hparts.1
    obtain ⟨ψ,hψ⟩ := (NamedPostfixEncoding.standard_codes_surjective
      functionSymbols relationSymbols bound).2 out hstored
    change formulaCode ψ = out at hψ
    obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hcodeφ⟩ := (seedCarrier_standard seed).mp hseed
    have hsψ : ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentencePredicate.val.Evalb ![formulaCode ψ] :=
      (congrArg (fun z : ℕ => ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentencePredicate.val.Evalb ![z]) hψ).mpr hs
    have hclosed : ψ.freeVariables = [] := (sentence_formulaCode ψ).mp hsψ
    have huc : UniversalClosure φ ψ := (closureRelation_codes φ ψ).mp (by
      simpa only [hψ,hcodeφ] using hclosure)
    exact ⟨ψ,⟨hclosed,φ,hφ,huc⟩,hψ⟩
  · rintro ⟨ψ,⟨hclosed,φ,hφ,huc⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(sentence_formulaCode ψ).mpr hclosed,formulaCode φ,
      (seedCarrier_standard _).mpr ⟨φ,hφ,rfl⟩,(closureRelation_codes φ ψ).mpr huc⟩

theorem sentenceMorphism_value (C C' : Predicate₂) (φ : Formula)
    (hφ : ∀ y, y ∈ φ.freeVariables → y = 0) (e : M) :
    ((G).map (sentenceMorphism C C' φ hφ)
      (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 M e)).val.val =
        NamedArithmeticFixedSubstitution.value φ (output M C C' e) :=

theorem uniform_independent_sentence_codes :
    ∃ q : ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.parameter ⟶ ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentence,
      ∀ e : ℕ, Entailment.Consistent (ArithmeticNamedProofConnectives.system (gamma e)) →
        let word := ((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map q
          (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ e)).val.val
        ¬ (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e)).val.Evalb ![word] ∧
          ¬ (SyntacticGeneratedAxioms.literalTheoremCarrier 𝗣𝗔
            variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e)).val.Evalb
              ![NamedArithmeticProofSearch.negationWord ℕ word] :=
  ⟨sentence,fun e hc => sentence_code_avoids e hc⟩

references.source:
theorem uniform_independent_sentences :
    ∃ q : ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.parameter ⟶ ArithmeticIndexedAxioms.sentence,
      ∀ e : ℕ, Entailment.Consistent (ArithmeticNamedProofConnectives.system (gamma e)) →
        ∃ φ : Formula, φ.freeVariables = [] ∧
          formulaCode φ =
            ((PredicateInterpretation.canonicalDomainFunctor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map q
              (NamedArithmeticLiteralTotal.omegaPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ e)).val.val ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e) φ ∧
          ¬ SyntacticNamedHilbert.Derives functionSymbols relationSymbols bound (gamma e) (.neg φ) := by
  refine ⟨sentence,?_⟩
  intro e hc
  let φ := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.instanceFormula ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (output e)
  have hr := NamedArithmeticDiagonalBounds.standard_instance_result ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha.val (output e)
  obtain ⟨hclosed,hpos,hneg⟩ := independent_instance e hc
  exact ⟨φ,hclosed,hr.1.symm.trans (sentence_value e).symm,hpos,hneg⟩

theorem constructor_tree :
    (derivationAlgebra R).str.left ≫ treeInclusion R =
      InputGeometry.forget R (derivationAlgebra R).a ≫
        (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R).map (treeInclusion R) ≫ (ordinaryTree R).str := by
  let v := (validatorFold R).f
  let j := pullback.fst v (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F)
  have hp : ((SuccessComparisonCore.success (F := F)).map (validatedSlice R).str).left ≫ j =
      pullback.fst ((SliceInitial.functor (PolynomialComparison.ordinary R) (validator R)).obj
        (Over.mk v)).hom (coprod.inr : F ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj F) ≫ (ordinaryTree R).str := by
    simp [j,v,Over.pullback,validatedSlice,SliceInitial.algebra,validatorFold]
  change (((SuccessComparisonCore.comparison interpretation R (ruleEquality R)).inv.app
      (Over.mk v)).left ≫ ((SuccessComparisonCore.success (F := F)).map (validatedSlice R).str).left) ≫ j = _
  rw [SuccessComparisonCore.comparison_inv_app,Category.assoc,hp,
    ← Category.assoc,SuccessComparisonCore.componentIso_input]
  simpa only [Category.assoc, treeInclusion, derivationAlgebra, AlgebraAdjunction.leftAlgebra,
    validatedSlice, SliceInitial.algebra, validatorFold, v, Functor.comp_obj,
    SuccessComparisonCore.success, Over.mk_hom] using
    congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (ordinaryTree R).str)
      (SuccessComparisonCore.input_eq_forget R (Over.mk v))

theorem numerical_term_constructor :
    numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.1 ≫ termIso.inv =
      numericalTermInputIso.hom ≫ numericalSyntax.algebra.str.1 := by
  let c := NumericalNamed.literalTermIso NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound
  let d := NumericalNamed.termConstructorInputIso E NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound
    sourceSyntax numericalSyntax (NumericalNamed.literalAlgebraIso NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound)
  have hp : numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.1 ≫ termChart.hom =
      termInputIso.hom ≫ E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.1 := term_constructor
  have hn : E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.1 ≫ c.hom =
      d.hom ≫ numericalSyntax.algebra.str.1 :=
    NumericalNamed.termConstructor_input_square E NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound
      sourceSyntax numericalSyntax (NumericalNamed.literalAlgebraIso NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound)
  have hc : termChart.hom ≫ c.hom = termIso.inv := by
    change (termIso.inv ≫ c.inv) ≫ c.hom = termIso.inv
    rw [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id]
  calc
    _ = (numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.1 ≫ termChart.hom) ≫ c.hom :=
      (congrArg (fun f => numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.1 ≫ f) hc).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (termInputIso.hom ≫ E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.1) ≫ c.hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ c.hom) hp
    _ = termInputIso.hom ≫ (d.hom ≫ numericalSyntax.algebra.str.1) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun f => termInputIso.hom ≫ f) hn)
    _ = _ := (Category.assoc termInputIso.hom d.hom numericalSyntax.algebra.str.1).symm

  have hp : numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.2 ≫ formulaChart.hom =
      formulaInputIso.hom ≫ E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.2 := formula_constructor
  have hn : E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.2 ≫ c.hom =
      d.hom ≫ numericalSyntax.algebra.str.2 :=
    NumericalNamed.formulaConstructor_input_square E NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound
      sourceSyntax numericalSyntax (NumericalNamed.literalAlgebraIso NumericalNamed.variableObject functions relations bound)
  have hc : formulaChart.hom ≫ c.hom = formulaIso.inv := by
    change (formulaIso.inv ≫ c.inv) ≫ c.hom = formulaIso.inv
    rw [Category.assoc,Iso.inv_hom_id,Category.comp_id]
  calc
    _ = (numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.2 ≫ formulaChart.hom) ≫ c.hom :=
      (congrArg (fun f => numericalInterpretation.map originalSyntax.algebra.str.2 ≫ f) hc).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (formulaInputIso.hom ≫ E.functor.map sourceSyntax.algebra.str.2) ≫ c.hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ c.hom) hp
    _ = formulaInputIso.hom ≫ (d.hom ≫ numericalSyntax.algebra.str.2) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun f => formulaInputIso.hom ≫ f) hn)

references.source:
theorem admissible_result : admissibleIso.hom ≫ numericalInterpretation.map (S₀).formulaSubstitution =
    (S).formulaSubstitution ≫ formulaIso.hom := by
  apply NumericalTuples.Map.ext
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hv := numericalInterpretation_value (S₀).formulaSubstitution (forward.toFun a)
  let q := (S).admissibleInclusion.toFun a
  have hq : (F).map (S₀).admissibleInclusion (forward.toFun a) = formulaInputIso.hom.toFun q :=
    (numericalInterpretation_value (S₀).admissibleInclusion _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun f => f.toFun a) forward_inclusion)
  have hx := (congrArg (fun t : PredicateInterpretation.Obj ℕ
      (Limits.prod (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) (S₀).algebra.a.2 (S₀).substitutionParameters) =>
    ((F).map (prod.fst : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
      (S₀).substitutionParameters variableSymbols)
      ((F).map (prod.snd : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
        ((S₀).algebra.a.2 ⨯ (S₀).substitutionParameters) (S₀).substitutionParameters) t)).val) hq).trans
          (formulaInput_name q)
  have hr := (congrArg (fun t : PredicateInterpretation.Obj ℕ
      (Limits.prod (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) (S₀).algebra.a.2 (S₀).substitutionParameters) =>
    ((F).map (prod.snd : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
      (S₀).substitutionParameters (S₀).algebra.a.1)
      ((F).map (prod.snd : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
        ((S₀).algebra.a.2 ⨯ (S₀).substitutionParameters) (S₀).substitutionParameters) t)).val) hq).trans
          (formulaInput_replacement q)
  have hw := (congrArg (fun t : PredicateInterpretation.Obj ℕ
      (Limits.prod (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) (S₀).algebra.a.2 (S₀).substitutionParameters) =>
    ((F).map (prod.fst : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
      ((S₀).algebra.a.2 ⨯ (S₀).substitutionParameters) (S₀).algebra.a.2) t).val) hq).trans
        (formulaInput_word q)
  have h := ConcreteNamedComparison.plain_formulaSubstitution_value
    𝗣𝗔 variableSymbols functionSymbols relationSymbols bound ℕ (forward.toFun a)
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val hv).trans
    (h.trans ((congrArg (fun n : ℕ => π₁ n) (result_congr hx hr hw)).trans
      (OperationValues.formula_substitution_value a).symm))

theorem branch_constructor (Γ : Carrier) (i : Fin 3) :
    inputComparison Γ i ≫ Sigma.ι ((targetRules Γ).ruleObject
        (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (targetRules Γ)).a) i ≫
        (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (targetRules Γ)).str.left =
      Sigma.ι ((Rules.rules Γ).ruleObject (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (Rules.rules Γ)).a) i ≫
        (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (Rules.rules Γ)).str.left ≫ (proofIso Γ).hom := by
  calc
    _ = NumericalRuleRebase.inputRebase (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso i ≫
        (NumericalRuleRelabel.inputRelabel (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
          (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ) i ≫
        Sigma.ι ((targetRules Γ).ruleObject (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (targetRules Γ)).a) i ≫
          (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (targetRules Γ)).str.left) := by
      simp only [inputComparison,CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]
    _ = NumericalRuleRebase.inputRebase (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso i ≫
        (Sigma.ι ((sourceRules Γ).ruleObject (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (sourceRules Γ)).a) i ≫
          (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (sourceRules Γ)).str.left ≫
          (NumericalRuleRelabel.codeIso (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
            (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ)).hom) :=
      congrArg (fun f => NumericalRuleRebase.inputRebase (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso i ≫ f)
        (NumericalRuleRelabel.branch_constructor (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
          (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ) i)
    _ = (NumericalRuleRebase.inputRebase (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso i ≫
        Sigma.ι ((sourceRules Γ).ruleObject (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (sourceRules Γ)).a) i ≫
          (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (sourceRules Γ)).str.left) ≫
        (NumericalRuleRelabel.codeIso (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
          (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ)).hom := by simp only [CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]
    _ = (Sigma.ι ((Rules.rules Γ).ruleObject (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (Rules.rules Γ)).a) i ≫
        (NumericalDerivation.codeAlgebra (Rules.rules Γ)).str.left ≫
          (NumericalRuleRebase.codeIso (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso).hom) ≫
        (NumericalRuleRelabel.codeIso (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
          (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ)).hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (NumericalRuleRelabel.codeIso (forward Γ) (backward Γ)
        (forward_backward Γ) (backward_forward Γ)).hom) (rebase_branch (Rules.rules Γ) formulaIso i)
    _ = _ := by simp only [proofIso,Iso.trans_hom,CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]

theorem fixed_provability (Γ : Carrier) (s : NumericalTuples.Point ProofImage.sentenceObject) :
    (∃ p : NumericalTuples.Point (SentenceProofCodes.object Γ), (conclusion Γ).toFun p = s) ↔
      (ArithmeticLiteralModel.theoremPredicate Γ).val.Evalb (M := ℕ) ![s.val] := by
  rw [← ProofImage.image_membership Γ s]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p,hp⟩
    exact ⟨(wordIso Γ).hom.toFun p,
      ((congrArg (fun f => f.toFun p) (wordIso_conclusion Γ)).trans hp)⟩
  · rintro ⟨p,hp⟩
    refine ⟨(wordIso Γ).inv.toFun p,?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f.toFun ((wordIso Γ).inv.toFun p)) (wordIso_conclusion Γ)
    have hi := congrArg (fun f => f.toFun p) (wordIso Γ).inv_hom_id
    exact h.symm.trans ((congrArg (ProofImage.conclusion Γ).toFun hi).trans hp)

theorem canonical_forward_program (Γ : Carrier) :
    ∃ r : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec r ∧
      ∀ p : NumericalTuples.Point (SentenceProofCodes.object Γ),
        r p.val = Part.some ((canonicalRho Γ).hom p).val.val := by
  refine ⟨(rho Γ).hom.program,(rho Γ).hom.program_partrec,?_⟩
  intro p
  exact ((rho Γ).hom.program_apply p).trans
    (congrArg Part.some (canonicalComparison_value (ArithmeticLiteralModel.proofObject Γ)
      ((rho Γ).hom.toFun p)).symm)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NumericalArithmetic.ProofComparison.canonical_backward_program

theorem canonical_backward_program (Γ : Carrier) :
    ∃ r : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec r ∧
      ∀ p : PredicateInterpretation.CanonicalDomain 𝗣𝗔 ℕ
        ((realization 𝗣𝗔).obj (ArithmeticLiteralModel.proofObject Γ)),
        r p.val.val = Part.some ((canonicalRho Γ).inv p).val := by
  refine ⟨(rho Γ).inv.program,(rho Γ).inv.program_partrec,?_⟩
  intro p
  exact (congrArg (rho Γ).inv.program
    (canonicalComparison_inverse_value (ArithmeticLiteralModel.proofObject Γ) p).symm).trans
      ((rho Γ).inv.program_apply (canonicalComparison.inv.app _ p))

lem:arithmetic-signed-theory.label: lem:arithmetic-signed-theory
lem:arithmetic-signed-theory.reconstruction: Assume consistency of PA. Any source complementary separator gives a total ℓ in the original category; universality gives h g=ℓg, so the pulled-back complementary domains are equal and force identity zero. PA consistency rules that out.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticComplementaryInclusions.conditional
references.source:
theorem conditional (A B : Subobject (identityOmega 𝗣𝗔)) (h : IsCompl A B) :
    ∃ (c : (A : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔) ⨿ (B : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔) ≅ identityOmega 𝗣𝗔)
      (ℓ : identityOmega 𝗣𝗔 ⟶ numberSum),
      c.hom = coprod.desc A.arrow B.arrow ∧
      ℓ = c.inv ≫ coprod.desc (A.arrow ≫ rightInjection) (B.arrow ≫ leftInjection) ∧
      A.arrow ≫ ℓ = A.arrow ≫ rightInjection ∧ B.arrow ≫ ℓ = B.arrow ≫ leftInjection ∧
      isTotal ℓ.hom.hom := by
  let p : SubobjectPartition (identityOmega 𝗣𝗔) := ⟨B, A, h.symm⟩
  let : IsIso p.cover := SubobjectPartition.cover_isIso p
  let c := asIso p.cover
  let branches := coprod.desc (A.arrow ≫ rightInjection) (B.arrow ≫ leftInjection)
  let ℓ := c.inv ≫ branches
  have hl : (coprod.inl : (A : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔) ⟶ _) ≫ c.hom = A.arrow :=
    coprod.inl_desc A.arrow B.arrow
  have hr : (coprod.inr : (B : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔) ⟶ _) ≫ c.hom = B.arrow :=
    coprod.inr_desc A.arrow B.arrow
  refine ⟨c, ℓ, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      A.arrow ≫ ℓ = (coprod.inl ≫ c.hom) ≫ ℓ := congrArg (· ≫ ℓ) hl.symm
      _ = A.arrow ≫ rightInjection := by
        rw [Category.assoc, show c.hom ≫ ℓ = branches from c.hom_inv_id_assoc branches]
        exact coprod.inl_desc _ _
  · calc
      B.arrow ≫ ℓ = (coprod.inr ≫ c.hom) ≫ ℓ := congrArg (· ≫ ℓ) hr.symm
      _ = B.arrow ≫ leftInjection := by
        rw [Category.assoc, show c.hom ≫ ℓ = branches from c.hom_inv_id_assoc branches]
        exact coprod.inr_desc _ _
  · exact congrArg SplitObject.Hom.hom ℓ.property

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticDerivation.InternalInduction.model_rule_induction
references.source:
theorem model_rule_induction (φ : 𝚷₁.Semiformula M 1)
    (step : ∀ (i : Fin (bound + 1))
      (r : Obj T M (R.ruleObject (derivationAlgebra T R).a i)),
      (∀ k : Fin i.val,
        φ.val.Eval ![((F T M).map (typedChild T R i k) r).val] id) →
      φ.val.Eval ![((F T M).map (derivationConstructor T R i) r).val] id) :
    ∀ d : Obj T M (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left, φ.val.Eval ![d.val] id := by
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  let Q : M → Prop := fun n =>
    ∀ d : Obj T M (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left,
      len d.val < n → φ.val.Eval ![d.val] id
  have hQ : 𝚷₁-Predicate Q := by
    let C : 𝚺₁.Semiformula M 1 := (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left.rew Rew.emb
    let L : 𝚺₁.Semiformula M 2 := lenDef.rew Rew.emb
    refine ⟨.mkPi “n. ∀ d l, !C.val d → !L.val l d → l < n → !φ.val d”, ?_⟩
    intro v
    simp [C, L, Q, Obj, PredicateInterpretation.Obj]
  have all : ∀ n : M, Q n := by
    intro n
    induction n using ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction
    · exact hQ
    case zero =>
      intro d hd
      exact False.elim (not_lt_zero hd)
    case succ n ih =>
      intro d hd
      obtain ⟨i, r, hr⟩ := derivation_constructor_cases T M R d
      subst d
      apply step i r
      intro k
      apply ih
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (typed_children_smaller T R M i r k)
        (Arithmetic.lt_succ_iff_le.mp hd)
  intro d
  exact all (len d.val + 1) d (by simp)

references.source:
theorem lookup_primrec : Primrec₂ (lookup : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) := by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : ℕ => (construction (M := ℕ)).nil ![x]) := Primrec.const 0
  have hs : Primrec₂ (fun (x : ℕ) (t : ℕ × List ℕ × ℕ) =>
      (construction (M := ℕ)).adjoin ![x] t.1
        (SyntacticSyntax.NatVectors.pack t.2.1) t.2.2) := by
    have h : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × List ℕ × ℕ) =>
        if p.1 = p.2.1 then 1 else p.2.2.2) :=
      Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.const 1) (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
    exact Primrec₂.of_eq h.to₂ fun x t => by
      by_cases hx : x = t.1 <;> simp [construction, hx]
  exact SyntacticSyntax.NatVectors.vecRec_primrec
    (construction (M := ℕ)) (fun x : ℕ => ![x]) hn hs

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SignedDerivation.positiveLabels_primrec
references.source:
theorem positiveLabels_primrec : Primrec (positiveLabels : ℕ → ℕ) := by
  have hn : Primrec (fun _ : ℕ => (positiveLabelsConstruction (M := ℕ)).nil ![]) :=
    Primrec.const 0
  have hs : Primrec₂ (fun (_ : ℕ) (t : ℕ × List ℕ × ℕ) =>
      (positiveLabelsConstruction (M := ℕ)).adjoin ![] t.1 (pack t.2.1) t.2.2) := by
    have hr := Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × List ℕ × ℕ) => p.2))
    have hl := label_primrec.comp hr
    have hi : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × List ℕ × ℕ) => p.2.2.2) :=
      Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
    exact Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp hr (leaf_primrec.comp hl (Primrec.const 0)))
      (adjoin_primrec.comp hl hi) hi
  exact (vecRec_primrec _ (fun _ : ℕ => ![]) hn hs).comp
    (Primrec.pair (Primrec.const 0) Primrec.id)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.evaluate_equality
references.source:
@[reassoc] theorem evaluate_equality (p : W ⟶ P) (a b : W ⟶ S.algebra.a.1) :
    evaluate S P d p (prod.lift a b ≫ S.equalityConstructor) = Two.constant W true := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => prod.lift (frame p a) (frame p b) ≫ k)
    (equality_value S P d)
  simp only [← Category.assoc, frame_product, frame_map, comp_constant] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun k => k.left ≫ prod.snd) h
  simpa only [frame_evaluate, constant_value, Over.mk_left] using hh

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.evaluate_atom
references.source:
@[reassoc] theorem evaluate_atom (p : W ⟶ P) (a : W ⟶ X) :
    evaluate S P d p (a ≫ NullaryInterpretation.atomFormula S) =
      prod.lift p a ≫ d.left ≫ prod.snd := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => frame p a ≫ k) (atom_value S P d)
  rw [← Category.assoc, frame_map] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun k => k.left ≫ prod.snd) h
  simpa only [frame_evaluate, Over.comp_left, frame, Over.homMk_left, Category.assoc,
    evaluate, value, Over.mk_left] using hh

@[reassoc] theorem evaluate_negation (p : W ⟶ P) (f : W ⟶ S.algebra.a.2) :
    evaluate S P d p (f ≫ S.negationConstructor) =
      Two.unary Bool.not (evaluate S P d p f) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => frame p f ≫ k) (negation_value S P d)
  rw [← Category.assoc, frame_map] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun k => k.left ≫ prod.snd) h
  simpa only [← Category.assoc, frame_evaluate, family_unary_value] using hh

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.evaluate_implication

@[reassoc] theorem evaluate_implication (p : W ⟶ P) (f g : W ⟶ S.algebra.a.2) :
    evaluate S P d p (prod.lift f g ≫ S.implicationConstructor) =
      Two.binary NullaryBooleanValuation.implies
        (evaluate S P d p f) (evaluate S P d p g) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun k => prod.lift (frame p f) (frame p g) ≫ k)
    (implication_value S P d)
  simp only [← Category.assoc, frame_product, frame_map, prod.lift_map] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun k => k.left ≫ prod.snd) h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, family_binary_value, frame_evaluate, Over.mk_left] using hh

@[reassoc] theorem evaluate_quantifier (p : W ⟶ P) (v : W ⟶ V) (f : W ⟶ S.algebra.a.2) :

  have h := congrArg (fun k => prod.lift (frame p v) (frame p f) ≫ k)

  simp only [← Category.assoc, frame_product, frame_map, prod.lift_snd] at h

theorem diagonal_negative_axiom (q : Obj T M (atomInputs T X))

      ![((F T M).map (prod.fst : atomInputs T X ⟶ listObject T X) q).val])

      ![((F T M).map (prod.snd : atomInputs T X ⟶ X) q).val]) :

    (ArithmeticSignedFiniteSupport.negative_value _ hs _ hn)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.substitution_value
references.source:
theorem substitution_value {W : D} (p : W ⟶ P) (i : W ⟶ S.admissibleSubstitution) :
    evaluate S P d p (i ≫ S.formulaSubstitution) =
      evaluate S P d p (i ≫ S.admissibleInclusion ≫ prod.fst) := by
  let f := i ≫ S.admissibleInclusion ≫ prod.fst
  let q := i ≫ S.admissibleInclusion ≫ prod.snd
  have h := substitution_option_value S P d p q f
  have hi : prod.lift f q = i ≫ S.admissibleInclusion := by
    simp only [f, q, ← Category.assoc, parameterPair_eta]
  have hr : prod.lift f q ≫ S.formulaSubstitutionOption =
      (i ≫ S.formulaSubstitution) ≫ coprod.inr := by
    rw [hi, Category.assoc, S.formulaSubstitution_square, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [hr, ParameterizedOption.map_ok, OptionSyntax.mask_ok] at h
  exact (cancel_mono (coprod.inr : Two D ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj (Two D))).mp (by
    simpa only [evaluate, Category.assoc, f] using h)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.substitution_option_value
references.source:
theorem substitution_option_value {W : D} (p : W ⟶ P)
    (q : W ⟶ S.substitutionParameters) (f : W ⟶ S.algebra.a.2) :
    ParameterizedOption.map (value S P d) p
      (prod.lift f q ≫ S.formulaSubstitutionOption) =
        OptionSyntax.mask (evaluate S P d p f)
          (prod.lift f q ≫ S.formulaSubstitutionOption) := by
  have h := substitution_pair_good S P d p q f
  dsimp only [PairGood] at h
  have ho := S.formula_fold_original_value q f
  simp only [Category.assoc, ho] at h
  have hb : prod.lift f q ≫ (prod.braiding S.algebra.a.2 S.substitutionParameters).hom =
      prod.lift q f := by
    apply prod.hom_ext <;> simp [prod.braiding_hom]
  simpa only [CategoricalSyntax.formulaSubstitutionOption, ← Category.assoc, hb] using h

theorem fold_invariant :
    ParameterizedSubstitution.fold S r ≫ invariantResult S P d s r =
      ParameterizedSubstitution.fold S r ≫ invariantMask S P d s r := by
  have := AlgebraInvariant.pairEqualizers (Over R)
  exact AlgebraInvariant.fold_equalizes
    (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V (fun _ => ⊥_ D) 0)
      (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V (fun _ => X) 0) S.algebra R)
    (ParameterizedSubstitution.algebra S r) (S.stable R)
    (invariantResult S P d s r) (invariantMask S P d s r) (constructor_closed S P d s r)

theorem hilbert_instantiation_value (a : W ⟶ S.instantiationParameters) :
    evaluate S P d p (a ≫ S.hilbertInstantiation) = Two.constant W true := by
  have hs := substitution_input_value S P d p (a ≫ S.instantiationAdmissible)
    (a ≫ S.instantiationInclusion ≫ S.instantiationInput)
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun k => a ≫ k) S.instantiation_admissible)
  simp only [CategoricalSyntax.instantiationInput, ← Category.assoc,
    prod.comp_lift, prod.lift_fst] at hs
  simp only [CategoricalSyntax.hilbertInstantiation, ← Category.assoc, prod.comp_lift,
    evaluate_implication_input, evaluate_quantifier_input, prod.lift_fst, prod.lift_snd, hs]
  exact NullaryBooleanValuation.implication_self (D := D) _

theorem hilbert_equality_value (a : W ⟶ S.equalitySchemeParameters) :
    evaluate S P d p (a ≫ S.hilbertEquality) = Two.constant W true := by
  have h₁ := substitution_input_value S P d p (a ≫ S.equalityFirstAdmissible)
    (a ≫ S.equalitySchemeInclusion ≫ S.equalityFirstInput)
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun k => a ≫ k) S.equality_first_admissible)
  have h₂ := substitution_input_value S P d p (a ≫ S.equalitySecondAdmissible)
    (a ≫ S.equalitySchemeInclusion ≫ S.equalitySecondInput)
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun k => a ≫ k) S.equality_second_admissible)
  simp only [CategoricalSyntax.equalityFirstInput, CategoricalSyntax.equalitySecondInput,
    ← Category.assoc, prod.comp_lift, prod.lift_fst] at h₁ h₂
  simp only [CategoricalSyntax.hilbertEquality, ← Category.assoc, prod.comp_lift,
    evaluate_implication_input, evaluate_equality_input, prod.lift_fst, prod.lift_snd,
    h₁, h₂, NullaryBooleanValuation.implication_self]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ParameterizedBooleanValuation.logical_axioms_value
references.source:
theorem logical_axioms_value (a : W ⟶ S.logicalParameters) :
    evaluate S P d p (a ≫ S.logicalAxioms) = Two.constant W true := by
  unfold CategoricalSyntax.logicalAxioms
  apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
  · intro U p a
    apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
    · intro U p a
      apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
      · intro U p a
        apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
        · intro U p a
          apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
          · intro U p a
            apply coprod_scheme_true S P d _ _ ?_ ?_ p a
            · intro U p a
              exact hilbert_one_value S P d p a
            · intro U p a
              exact hilbert_two_value S P d p a
          · intro U p a
            exact hilbert_three_value S P d p a
        · intro U p a
          exact hilbert_instantiation_value S P d p a
      · intro U p a
        exact hilbert_distribution_value S P d p a
    · intro U p a
      exact hilbert_reflexivity_value S P d p a
  · intro U p a
    exact hilbert_equality_value S P d p a

theorem formula_value :
    (fold S r).2.left ≫ prod.snd =
      prod.map r (𝟙 S.algebra.a.2) ≫ S.substitutionFold.2.left ≫ prod.snd := by
  have hh : (Over.map r).map (fold S r).2 ≫ baseMap r S.substitutionCarriers.2 =
      baseMap r S.algebra.a.2 ≫ S.substitutionFold.2 :=
    congrArg Prod.snd (fold_comparison r S S.substitutionCarriers (data S))
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.left ≫ prod.snd) hh
  simpa only [Over.comp_left, Over.map_map_left, baseMap, Over.homMk_left,
    Category.assoc, prod.map_snd, Category.comp_id] using h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CoveredDerivationInvariant.formula_eval
references.source:
theorem formula_eval (d : Obj T M D) :
    (formula T M support conclusion v l).val.Eval ![d.val] id ↔
      (ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F T M).map support d).val l.val →
        TrueAt T M v l ((F T M).map conclusion d)) := by
  rw [formula_eval_raw]
  constructor
  · intro h hc q hp hf
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h ((F T M).map support d).val ((F T M).map conclusion d).val q.val
      ((F T M).map v q).val ((F T M).map (Two.constant (P ⨯ Fm) true) q).val
      ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M support _ _).mpr rfl)
      ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M conclusion _ _).mpr rfl)
      ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M prod.fst _ _).mpr hp)
      ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M prod.snd _ _).mpr hf)
      hc ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M v _ _).mpr rfl)
      ((chosenGraph_map_iff T M (Two.constant (P ⨯ Fm) true) _ _).mpr rfl)
  · intro h s f q b t hs hf hp hq hc hb ht
    have ss := ((chosenGraph T support).support_model M _ _ hs).2
    have ff := ((chosenGraph T conclusion).support_model M _ _ hf).2
    have qq := ((chosenGraph T (prod.fst : P ⨯ Fm ⟶ P)).support_model M _ _ hp).1
    have bb := ((chosenGraph T v).support_model M _ _ hb).2
    have tt := ((chosenGraph T (Two.constant (P ⨯ Fm) true)).support_model M _ _ ht).2
    have hs' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M support d ⟨s, ss⟩).mp hs
    have hf' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M conclusion d ⟨f, ff⟩).mp hf
    have hp' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M (prod.fst : P ⨯ Fm ⟶ P) ⟨q, qq⟩ l).mp hp
    have hq' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M (prod.snd : P ⨯ Fm ⟶ Fm) ⟨q, qq⟩ ⟨f, ff⟩).mp hq
    have hb' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M v ⟨q, qq⟩ ⟨b, bb⟩).mp hb
    have ht' := (chosenGraph_map_iff T M (Two.constant (P ⨯ Fm) true) ⟨q, qq⟩ ⟨t, tt⟩).mp ht
    have hc' : ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F T M).map support d).val l.val := by
      simpa only [hs'] using hc
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hb'.symm.trans ((h hc' ⟨q, qq⟩ hp'
      (hq'.trans hf'.symm)).trans ht'))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntacticDerivation.InternalInduction.model_rule_induction
references.source:
theorem model_rule_induction (φ : 𝚷₁.Semiformula M 1)
    (step : ∀ (i : Fin (bound + 1))
      (r : Obj T M (R.ruleObject (derivationAlgebra T R).a i)),
      (∀ k : Fin i.val,
        φ.val.Eval ![((F T M).map (typedChild T R i k) r).val] id) →
      φ.val.Eval ![((F T M).map (derivationConstructor T R i) r).val] id) :
    ∀ d : Obj T M (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left, φ.val.Eval ![d.val] id := by
  let : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔 := models_of_subtheory (U := T) inferInstance
  let Q : M → Prop := fun n =>
    ∀ d : Obj T M (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left,
      len d.val < n → φ.val.Eval ![d.val] id
  have hQ : 𝚷₁-Predicate Q := by
    let C : 𝚺₁.Semiformula M 1 := (derivationAlgebra T R).a.left.rew Rew.emb
    let L : 𝚺₁.Semiformula M 2 := lenDef.rew Rew.emb
    refine ⟨.mkPi “n. ∀ d l, !C.val d → !L.val l d → l < n → !φ.val d”, ?_⟩
    intro v
    simp [C, L, Q, Obj, PredicateInterpretation.Obj]
  have all : ∀ n : M, Q n := by
    intro n
    induction n using ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction
    · exact hQ
    case zero =>
      intro d hd
      exact False.elim (not_lt_zero hd)
    case succ n ih =>
      intro d hd
      obtain ⟨i, r, hr⟩ := derivation_constructor_cases T M R d
      subst d
      apply step i r
      intro k
      apply ih
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (typed_children_smaller T R M i r k)
        (Arithmetic.lt_succ_iff_le.mp hd)
  intro d
  exact all (len d.val + 1) d (by simp)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SignedDerivation.truth_from_leaves
references.source:
theorem truth_from_leaves (l : Obj T M P)
    (hleaf : ∀ a : Obj T M ((R).instances 0),
      ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F T M).map leaf a).val l.val →
        TrueAt T M val l ((F T M).map ((R).conclusion 0) a)) :
    ∀ q : Obj T M (Q).a.left,
      ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F T M).map supp q).val l.val →
        TrueAt T M val l ((F T M).map (Q).a.hom q) := by
  apply CoveredDerivationInvariant.model_rule_induction T M val l R supp
  intro i
  have hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · intro r ih hc
    let a : Obj T M ((R).instances 0) := (F T M).map
      (pullback.fst ((R).premises 0) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 0)) r
    have hp : (F T M).map (nullaryDerivation T R) a =
        (F T M).map (derivationConstructor T R 0) r := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f => (F T M).map f r)
        (nullary_label_constructor T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
          S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor)
      simp only [Functor.map_comp_apply] at h
      exact h
    have hs : ((F T M).map supp ((F T M).map (derivationConstructor T R 0) r)).val =
        ((F T M).map leaf a).val := by
      rw [← hp]
      have h := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram T M
        (nullaryDerivation T R) supp (𝟙 _) leaf
        (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using
          (canonical_nullary_collect T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
            S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor)) a
      simp only [Functor.map_id_apply] at h
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hcon : (F T M).map (Q).a.hom
        ((F T M).map (derivationConstructor T R 0) r) =
        (F T M).map ((R).conclusion 0) a := by
      rw [← hp]
      exact ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram T M
        (nullaryDerivation T R) (Q).a.hom (𝟙 _) ((R).conclusion 0)
        (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using nullaryDerivation_conclusion T R) a
        |>.trans (by rw [Functor.map_id_apply])
    erw [hs] at hc
    exact hcon.symm ▸ hleaf a hc
  · intro r ih hc
    have hs := unary_support_value T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
      S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor r
    erw [hs] at hc
    have ht := ih (0 : Fin 1) hc
    obtain ⟨w, hp, hr⟩ := modelProduct_exists T M P ((R).ruleObject (Q).a 1) l r
    let p : P ⨯ (R).ruleObject (Q).a 1 ⟶ P := prod.fst
    let a : P ⨯ (R).ruleObject (Q).a 1 ⟶ V ⨯ S.algebra.a.2 :=
      prod.snd ≫ pullback.fst ((R).premises 1) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 1)
    have hbody : (F T M).map (a ≫ prod.snd) w =
        (F T M).map (Q).a.hom ((F T M).map (typedChild T R (1 : Fin 3) (0 : Fin 1)) r) := by
      have he := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram T M
        (typedChild T R (1 : Fin 3) (0 : Fin 1)) (Q).a.hom
        (pullback.fst ((R).premises 1) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 1)) prod.snd
        (unary_child_conclusion T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
          S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor) r
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp_apply, hr, Functor.map_comp_apply]
      exact he.symm
    have hf : (F T M).map (evaluate S P d p (a ≫ prod.snd)) w =
        (F T M).map (Two.constant _ true) w := by
      apply (trueAt_lift T M val p (a ≫ prod.snd) w).mp
      rw [hbody]
      have hp' : (F T M).map p w = l := hp
      rw [hp']
      exact ht
    have hout := ParameterizedBooleanModelTruth.generalization_point T M S P d p
      (a ≫ prod.fst) (a ≫ prod.snd) w hf
    have he : prod.lift (a ≫ prod.fst) (a ≫ prod.snd) ≫ S.quantifierConstructor =
        prod.snd ≫ derivationConstructor T R 1 ≫ (Q).a.hom := by
      rw [← prod.comp_lift, prod.lift_fst_snd, Category.comp_id]
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [unary_parent_conclusion]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    rw [he] at hout
    have htrue := (trueAt_lift T M val p
      (prod.snd ≫ derivationConstructor T R 1 ≫ (Q).a.hom) w).mpr hout
    simp only [p, Functor.map_comp_apply, hp, hr] at htrue
    exact htrue
  · intro r ih hc
    have hs := binary_support_value T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
      S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor r
    erw [hs, ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.covers_append] at hc
    have h₀ := ih (0 : Fin 2) hc.1
    have h₁ := ih (1 : Fin 2) hc.2
    obtain ⟨w, hp, hr⟩ := modelProduct_exists T M P ((R).ruleObject (Q).a 2) l r
    let p : P ⨯ (R).ruleObject (Q).a 2 ⟶ P := prod.fst
    let a : P ⨯ (R).ruleObject (Q).a 2 ⟶ S.algebra.a.2 ⨯ S.algebra.a.2 :=
      prod.snd ≫ pullback.fst ((R).premises 2) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 2)
    have hfirst : (F T M).map (a ≫ prod.fst) w =
        (F T M).map (Q).a.hom ((F T M).map (typedChild T R (2 : Fin 3) (0 : Fin 2)) r) := by
      have he := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram T M
        (typedChild T R (2 : Fin 3) (0 : Fin 2)) (Q).a.hom
        (pullback.fst ((R).premises 2) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 2)) prod.fst
        (binary_first_child_conclusion T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
          S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor) r
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp_apply, hr, Functor.map_comp_apply]
      exact he.symm
    have himp : (F T M).map (a ≫ S.implicationConstructor) w =
        (F T M).map (Q).a.hom ((F T M).map (typedChild T R (2 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 2)) r) := by
      have he := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram T M
        (typedChild T R (2 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 2)) (Q).a.hom
        (pullback.fst ((R).premises 2) (finitePowerMap (Q).a.hom 2)) S.implicationConstructor
        (binary_second_child_conclusion T S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
          S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor) r
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp_apply, hr, Functor.map_comp_apply]
      exact he.symm
    have hf : (F T M).map (evaluate S P d p (a ≫ prod.fst)) w =
        (F T M).map (Two.constant _ true) w := by
      apply (trueAt_lift T M val p (a ≫ prod.fst) w).mp
      rw [hfirst]
      have hp' : (F T M).map p w = l := hp
      rw [hp']
      exact h₀
    have hi : (F T M).map
        (evaluate S P d p (prod.lift (a ≫ prod.fst) (a ≫ prod.snd) ≫ S.implicationConstructor)) w =
        (F T M).map (Two.constant _ true) w := by
      rw [← prod.comp_lift, prod.lift_fst_snd, Category.comp_id]
      apply (trueAt_lift T M val p (a ≫ S.implicationConstructor) w).mp
      rw [himp]
      have hp' : (F T M).map p w = l := hp
      rw [hp']
      exact h₁
    have hout := ParameterizedBooleanModelTruth.modus_ponens_point T M S P d p
      (a ≫ prod.fst) (a ≫ prod.snd) w hf hi
    have he : a ≫ prod.snd = prod.snd ≫ derivationConstructor T R 2 ≫ (Q).a.hom := by
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [binary_parent_conclusion]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    rw [he] at hout
    have htrue := (trueAt_lift T M val p
      (prod.snd ≫ derivationConstructor T R 2 ≫ (Q).a.hom) w).mpr hout
    simp only [p, Functor.map_comp_apply, hp, hr] at htrue
    exact htrue

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.leaf_truth
references.source:
theorem leaf_truth (l : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M P)
    (hl : (FiniteSigmaOne.allEntriesCondition ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha).Evalb ![l.val])
    (a : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M ((rules S).instances 0))
    (hc : ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F 𝗣𝗔 M).map leaf a).val l.val) :
    TrueAt 𝗣𝗔 M v l ((F 𝗣𝗔 M).map ((rules S).conclusion 0) a) := by
  rcases modelSum_cases 𝗣𝗔 M S.logicalParameters
    (Limits.coprod (C := PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)
      ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta) a with ⟨x, hx⟩ | ⟨ab, hab⟩
  · rw [← hx]
    have he : (coprod.inl : S.logicalParameters ⟶ (rules S).instances 0) ≫
        (rules S).conclusion 0 = S.logicalAxioms := by
      simp [rules, firstOrderRules]
    have h := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram 𝗣𝗔 M coprod.inl
      ((rules S).conclusion 0) (𝟙 _) S.logicalAxioms
      (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using he) x
    simp only [Functor.map_id_apply] at h
    exact h.symm ▸ logical_true S M l x
  · rcases modelSum_cases 𝗣𝗔 M ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta ab with
      ⟨x, hx⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩
    · let j : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
        ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha ((rules S).instances 0) := coprod.inl ≫ coprod.inr
      have hj : (F 𝗣𝗔 M).map j x = a := by
        dsimp only [j]
        erw [Functor.map_comp_apply, hx, hab]
      have hs : j ≫ leaf = (stableListAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha).singleton := by
        simp [j, SignedDerivation.positiveLeafAssignment]
      have hs' := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram 𝗣𝗔 M j leaf (𝟙 _)
        (stableListAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha).singleton
        (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using hs) x
      simp only [Functor.map_id_apply, hj] at hs'
      have hm : MemVec x.val l.val := by
        have hcov := hc
        erw [hs'] at hcov
        erw [singleton_value, ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.covers_adjoin] at hcov
        exact hcov.1
      have he : j ≫ (rules S).conclusion 0 =
          numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha ≫ NullaryInterpretation.atomFormula S := by
        simp [j, rules, firstOrderRules, axioms, Category.assoc]
      have he' := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram 𝗣𝗔 M j ((rules S).conclusion 0)
        (𝟙 _) (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha ≫ NullaryInterpretation.atomFormula S)
        (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using he) x
      simp only [Functor.map_id_apply, hj] at he'
      exact he'.symm ▸ positive_true M S l x hm
    · let j : @Quiver.Hom (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) inferInstance
        ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta ((rules S).instances 0) := coprod.inr ≫ coprod.inr
      have hj : (F 𝗣𝗔 M).map j x = a := by
        dsimp only [j]
        erw [Functor.map_comp_apply, hx, hab]
      have he : j ≫ (rules S).conclusion 0 =
          numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta ≫ NullaryInterpretation.atomFormula S ≫
            S.negationConstructor := by
        simp [j, rules, firstOrderRules, axioms, Category.assoc,
          CategoricalSyntax.sentenceNegation_inclusion]
      have he' := ConcreteNamedComparison.parameterPoint_diagram 𝗣𝗔 M j ((rules S).conclusion 0)
        (𝟙 _) (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta ≫ NullaryInterpretation.atomFormula S ≫
          S.negationConstructor) (by simpa only [Category.id_comp] using he) x
      simp only [Functor.map_id_apply, hj] at he'
      exact he'.symm ▸ negative_true M S l x hl

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.internal_truth
references.source:
theorem internal_truth (l : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M P)
    (hl : (FiniteSigmaOne.allEntriesCondition ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha).Evalb ![l.val])
    (q : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M (derivationAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 (rules S)).a.left)
    (hc : ArithmeticFiniteCoverage.Covers ((F 𝗣𝗔 M).map (support S) q).val l.val) :
    TrueAt 𝗣𝗔 M v l ((F 𝗣𝗔 M).map (derivationAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 (rules S)).a.hom q) := by
  exact SignedDerivation.truth_from_leaves 𝗣𝗔 M S (axioms S) P
    (SignedFiniteFormulaValuation.atomAssignment 𝗣𝗔 N) l (leaf_truth S M l hl) q hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.jointSupport_alpha
references.source:
theorem jointSupport_alpha (p q : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.left) :

theorem no_contradictory_derivations (p q : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.left)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.consistency_PA
references.source:
theorem consistency_PA : 𝗣𝗔 ⊢ consistencySentence S := by
  apply complete.{0} 𝗣𝗔
  intro M _ _
  rw [models_iff, consistencySentence_eval]
  intro p q f n hp hq hf hn hg
  let pp : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.left := ⟨p, hp⟩
  let qq : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.left := ⟨q, hq⟩
  let ff : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M S.algebra.a.2 :=
    ⟨f, ((chosenGraph 𝗣𝗔 (Q).a.hom).support_model M p f hf).2⟩
  let nn : Obj 𝗣𝗔 M S.algebra.a.2 :=
    ⟨n, ((chosenGraph 𝗣𝗔 (Q).a.hom).support_model M q n hn).2⟩
  have hpf : (F 𝗣𝗔 M).map (Q).a.hom pp = ff :=
    (chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.hom pp ff).mp hf
  have hqn : (F 𝗣𝗔 M).map (Q).a.hom qq = nn :=
    (chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 M (Q).a.hom qq nn).mp hn
  have hfn : (F 𝗣𝗔 M).map S.negationConstructor ff = nn :=
    (chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 M S.negationConstructor ff nn).mp hg
  apply no_contradictory_derivations S M pp qq
  exact hqn.trans (hfn.symm.trans (congrArg ((F 𝗣𝗔 M).map S.negationConstructor) hpf.symm))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.sentence_consistent
references.source:
theorem sentence_consistent :
    sentenceTheory S ⊓ (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceNegation).obj (sentenceTheory S) = ⊥ := by
  have hn : (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceNegation).obj
      ((Subobject.pullback S.sentenceInclusion).obj (formulaTheory S)) =
      (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceInclusion).obj
        ((Subobject.pullback S.negationConstructor).obj (formulaTheory S)) := by
    rw [← Subobject.pullback_comp, S.sentenceNegation_inclusion, Subobject.pullback_comp]
  simp only [sentenceTheory_eq_pullback]
  rw [hn, ← Subobject.inf_pullback, formula_consistent, PresentationLemmas.pullback_bot]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTheoryTruth.presentation_image_comparison
references.source:
theorem presentation_image_comparison {A : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔} (a : A ⟶ S.sentenceObject) :
    imageSubobject (pullback.snd (derivationAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 (S.logicalRules a)).a.hom S.sentenceInclusion) =
      FirstOrderReflection.generated (proofFamily S) (imageSubobject a) := by
  let I := imageSubobject a
  let e := factorThruImageSubobject a
  let : IsSplitEpi (factorThruImage a) := PredicateModelSubobjects.factorThruImage_isSplitEpi 𝗣𝗔 a
  let : IsSplitEpi e := by
    dsimp only [e, factorThruImageSubobject]
    infer_instance
  have he : e ≫ I.arrow = a := imageSubobject_arrow_comp a
  have hs : section_ e ≫ a = I.arrow := by
    calc
      _ = section_ e ≫ (e ≫ I.arrow) := congrArg (fun f => section_ e ≫ f) he.symm
      _ = (section_ e ≫ e) ≫ I.arrow := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = I.arrow := by rw [IsSplitEpi.id, Category.id_comp]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion a I.arrow
      S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor e he
      (derivationAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 (S.logicalRules a)) (derivationInitial 𝗣𝗔 (S.logicalRules a))
      (proofFamily S I)
  · exact firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion I.arrow a
      S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor (section_ e) hs
      (proofFamily S I) (proofFamily_initial S I) (derivationAlgebra 𝗣𝗔 (S.logicalRules a))

theorem signed_theory_eq (F : NullaryPresentations V) :
    (SignedFirstOrder.theory F positiveSubobject negativeSubobject).val =
      sentenceTheory (F.syntaxData N) := by
  change FirstOrderReflection.generated (F.proofs N)
    (SignedFirstOrder.axioms F positiveSubobject negativeSubobject) = _
  have ha : SignedFirstOrder.axioms F positiveSubobject negativeSubobject =
      imageSubobject (axioms (F.syntaxData N)) := (signed_axiom_image (F.syntaxData N)).symm
  rw [ha, generated_eq_canonical (F.syntaxData N) (F.proofs N) (F.initial N)]
  exact (presentation_image_comparison (F.syntaxData N) (axioms (F.syntaxData N))).symm

    (Subobject.pullback (F.syntaxData N).sentenceNegation).obj
      (SignedFirstOrder.theory F positiveSubobject negativeSubobject).val = ⊥

theorem object_exists {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (A : Subobject X) :
    FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E.functor ((Subobject.«exists» f).obj A) =
      (Subobject.«exists» (E.functor.map f)).obj (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E.functor A) := by
  rw [SubobjectImagePresentations.exists_eq_image, object_image, E.functor.map_comp]
  change imageSubobject (E.functor.map A.arrow ≫ E.functor.map f) =
    (Subobject.«exists» (E.functor.map f)).obj (Subobject.mk (E.functor.map A.arrow))
  exact (SubobjectImagePresentations.exists_mk (E.functor.map A.arrow) (E.functor.map f)).symm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.EquivalenceSubobjects.inseparable
references.source:
theorem inseparable {X : C} {a b : Subobject X} (h : SubobjectInseparable a b) :
    SubobjectInseparable (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E.functor a) (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object E.functor b) := by
  let e := orderIso E X
  constructor
  · change e a ⊓ e b = ⊥
    rw [← e.map_inf, h.1, e.map_bot]
  · rintro ⟨p, ha, hb⟩
    change e a ≤ p.positive at ha
    change e b ≤ p.negative at hb
    apply h.2
    have hp : IsCompl (e.symm p.positive) (e.symm p.negative) := by
      constructor
      · apply disjoint_iff.mpr
        rw [← e.symm.map_inf, p.complementary.inf_eq_bot, e.symm.map_bot]
      · apply codisjoint_iff.mpr
        rw [← e.symm.map_sup, p.complementary.sup_eq_top, e.symm.map_top]
    refine ⟨⟨e.symm p.positive, e.symm p.negative, hp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using e.symm.monotone ha
    · simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using e.symm.monotone hb

theorem axioms_image : axioms F =
    imageSubobject ((G).map (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha) ≫ atom F) ⊔
      imageSubobject ((G).map (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta) ≫
        atom F ≫ negation F) := by
  have hp : positive = Subobject.mk ((G).map (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.alpha)) :=
    FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_mk (G) _
  have hn : negative = Subobject.mk ((G).map (numberInclusion ArithmeticDiagonalCodes.beta)) :=
    FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_mk (G) _
  exact congrArg₂ (· ⊔ ·)
    ((congrArg (fun A => (Subobject.«exists» (atom F)).obj A) hp).trans
      (SubobjectImagePresentations.exists_mk _ _))
    ((congrArg (fun A => (Subobject.«exists» (atom F ≫ negation F)).obj A) hn).trans
      (SubobjectImagePresentations.exists_mk _ _))

  change FirstOrderReflection.generated (proofs F) (axioms F) ≤ _
