references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTotal.consistent
references.source:
theorem consistent :
    (theory F).val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj (theory F).val = ⊥ := by
  let T := (SignedFirstOrder.theory F positiveSubobject negativeSubobject).val
  let e := EquivalenceSubobjects.orderIso (E) (S).sentenceObject
  have hc : e T ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj (e T) = ⊥ := by
    change e T ⊓ (Subobject.pullback ((G).map (S).sentenceNegation)).obj
      (FiniteLimitSubobjects.object (G) T) = ⊥
    rw [← FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_pullback]
    change e T ⊓ e ((Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj T) = ⊥
    rw [← e.map_inf]
    have hs := signed_theory_consistent F
    change T ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj T = ⊥ at hs
    rw [hs, e.map_bot]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  exact (inf_le_inf (theory_le_image F)
    ((Subobject.pullback (negation F)).monotone (theory_le_image F))).trans_eq hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ArithmeticSignedTotal.every_consistent_extension_incomplete
references.source:
theorem every_consistent_extension_incomplete
    (U : FirstOrderReflection.Theory (proofs F))
    (hExt : (theory F).val ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj U.val = ⊥) :
    U.val ⊔ (Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj U.val ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro hcomp
  have hb := atomic_bounds F
  have hp := hb.1.trans ((Subobject.pullback (atom F)).monotone hExt)
  have hn := hb.2.trans ((Subobject.pullback (atom F)).monotone
    ((Subobject.pullback (negation F)).monotone hExt))
  have hs : HasSubobjectSeparator U.val ((Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj U.val) :=
    ⟨⟨U.val, (Subobject.pullback (negation F)).obj U.val,
      ⟨disjoint_iff.mpr hc, codisjoint_iff.mpr hcomp⟩⟩, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
  exact inseparable.2 (subobject_separator_mono hp hn
    (subobject_separator_pullback (atom F) hs))

theorem essentially_incomplete

    (hcU : U.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (ArithmeticSignedTotal.negation (F₀))).obj U.val = ⊥) :
    ((constantTheory U).val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback
      ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔)).map
        (ArithmeticSignedTotal.negation (F₀)))).obj (constantTheory U).val = ⊥) ∧
    ∀ W : FirstOrderReflection.Theory (proofs (U.val : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔)),
      (constantTheory U).val ≤ W.val →
      W.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔)).map
        (ArithmeticSignedTotal.negation (F₀)))).obj W.val = ⊥ →
      W.val ⊔ (Subobject.pullback ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔)).map
        (ArithmeticSignedTotal.negation (F₀)))).obj W.val ≠ ⊤ :=
  ⟨SliceSubobjectPredicates.constant_consistency (U.val : TotalSplit 𝗣𝗔)
    (ArithmeticSignedTotal.negation (F₀)) U.val hcU,
    every_consistent_extension_incomplete U hExt⟩

references.source:
def turingData (rec : PRecursionCategory R) : TuringData (PartialMaps.Par (Over T)) := by
  subst ρ
  let ex := SplitSliceTuring.turing_object inverses T rec
  let τ := Classical.choose ex
  have hτ := Classical.choose_spec ex
  exact {
    products := PartialSliceProducts.pcategoryStruct inverses T
    laws := PartialSliceProducts.pcategoryLaws inverses T
    restriction_eq := PartialSliceProducts.restrictionCategory_eq inverses T
    Q := PartialSliceTuring.constantObject T ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj rec.W)
    evaluator := SliceProductTuring.evaluator inverses T τ
    turing := hτ.2.1
    universal := hτ.2.2
    terminal := PartialSliceRetractions.terminalObject T
    terminate := PartialSliceRetractions.terminate inverses T
    terminate_total := PartialSliceRetractions.terminate_total inverses T
    terminate_self := PartialSliceRetractions.terminate_self inverses T
    terminate_naturality := PartialSliceRetractions.terminate_naturality inverses T
    terminate_unique := PartialSliceRetractions.terminate_unique inverses T
    splittings := inferInstance
  }

omit [HasZeroMorphisms R] [Prodominical R] [Isotype R] in
include hρ inverses in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.OriginalConstantFunctor.evaluator_isTuring
references.source:
theorem evaluator_isTuring (T : SplitObject R) {Q : R} (τ : nearProd Q Q ⟶ Q)
    (hτ : IsTuringMorphism τ) :
    @IsTuringMorphism (ConstantSlice.Full.FullCategory T) inferInstance
      (ConstantSlice.Full.productData T) (ConstantSlice.Full.productLaws T)
      ((functor T).obj Q) ((functor T).obj Q) ((functor T).obj Q) (evaluator T τ) := by
  let F := ConstantSlice.Full.inclusion T
  let D := AmbientSliceProducts.restrictionProducts T
  let e := AmbientProductTuring.evaluator T
    (SplitTuring.evaluator ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj Q)
      ((splittingInclusion (C := R)).obj Q) τ)
  have he := AmbientProductTuring.evaluator_isTuring T _
    (SplitTuring.evaluator_isTuring _ _ τ hτ)
  have hh := FullRestrictionProducts.evaluator_isTuring F
    (ConstantSlice.Full.inclusion_restriction T) D
    (ConstantSlice.Full.product T) (ConstantSlice.Full.productIso T) ((functor T).obj Q) e he
  have hEq : evaluator T τ = FullRestrictionProducts.evaluator F D
      (ConstantSlice.Full.product T) (ConstantSlice.Full.productIso T) ((functor T).obj Q) e := by
    apply F.map_injective
    change F.map ((productComparison T Q Q).hom ≫ (functor T).map τ) =
      F.map (F.preimage (_ ≫ e))
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_preimage]
    have hp : F.map (productComparison T Q Q).hom =
        (ConstantSlice.Full.productIso T ((functor T).obj Q) ((functor T).obj Q)).hom ≫
          (ConstantSlice.productIso T Q Q).inv := by
      exact F.map_preimage _
    rw [hp, Category.assoc]
    change _ ≫ ((ConstantSlice.productIso T Q Q).inv ≫ ((functor T).map τ).hom) = _
    erw [← ambient_evaluator T τ,
      ← Category.assoc (ConstantSlice.productIso T Q Q).inv,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hEq]
  exact hh

theorem no_total_extension (U : ArithmeticAssociatedIncompleteness.GlobalTheory)
    (hExt : (ArithmeticSignedTotal.theory (F₀)).val ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (ν)).obj U.val = ⊥) :
    ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension ((constantFunctor U).map (decision U hc)) := by
  have hi := ArithmeticAssociatedIncompleteness.extension_inseparable U hExt hc
  have hn : ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension (decision U hc) :=
    (BooleanPartialDecision.inseparable_iff_noTotalExtension inverses _ _ hc).mp hi
  intro he
  exact hn (((constantData U).property.2.2 _).mp he)

lem:miller-unanimity.label: lem:miller-unanimity
lem:miller-unanimity.reconstruction: For any z, one oracle program using *any* p representing z computes exact common-value/domain function τ_z(e,n). A finite cylinder projects to a computable finite union of closed dyadic coordinate boxes. Strict comparisons semidecide that z violates a bound; enumerating such cylinders covers the fiber complement.

@[simp] theorem rho_value (p : Bits) (n : ℕ) :

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.rho_surjective
references.source:
theorem rho_surjective : Function.Surjective rho := by
  intro z
  have h : ∀ n, ∃ d : Bits, Real.ofDigits d = (z n : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨d, _, hd⟩ := Real.ofDigits_SurjOn (b := 2) (by decide) (z n).property
    exact ⟨d, hd⟩
  choose d hd using h
  refine ⟨fun k => d (Nat.unpair k).1 (Nat.unpair k).2, ?_⟩
  funext n
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Real.ofDigits (fun j => d (Nat.unpair (Nat.pair n j)).1
    (Nat.unpair (Nat.pair n j)).2) = (z n : ℝ)
  simpa only [Nat.unpair_pair] using hd n

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.FiniteCover.covers_iff
references.source:
theorem covers_iff (L : List Word) :
    covers L = true ↔ ∀ p : Bits,∃ s ∈ L,p ∈ cylinder s := by
  rw [covers_iff_test]
  constructor
  · intro h p
    have ht : bitPrefix p (depth L) ∈ words (depth L) :=
      mem_words_of_length (prefix_length p (depth L))
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hst⟩ := h (bitPrefix p (depth L)) ht
    refine ⟨s,hs,?_⟩
    change bitPrefix p s.length = s
    exact (take_prefix p (length_le_depth hs)).symm.trans hst
  · intro h t ht
    have hlen : t.length = depth L := mem_words_length ht
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hp⟩ := h (extension t)
    refine ⟨s,hs,?_⟩
    change bitPrefix (extension t) s.length = s at hp
    calc
      t.take s.length = (bitPrefix (extension t) t.length).take s.length := by
        rw [prefix_extension]
      _ = bitPrefix (extension t) s.length := take_prefix _
        (hlen.symm ▸ length_le_depth hs)
      _ = s := hp

theorem search_correct (p : Bits) (a : Input) (m : ℕ) :
    (∃ r, Certified (bitPrefix p r) a m) ↔ Unanimous (rho p) a m := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r,hr⟩
    exact certified_sound _ a m hr p (mem_cylinder_prefix p r)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨L,hL,hG⟩ := finite_good_cover p a m h
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := finite_prefix_bound p a m L hG
    exact ⟨r,L,hL,hr⟩

prop:miller-category.label: prop:miller-category
prop:miller-category.reconstruction: Composition, restriction, finite products/coproducts, ranges, zero and compatible joins use effective operations; ranges/joins work because the output is fixed despite oracle-dependent timing. Agreement is inherited from partial functions.

instance locallyConnected : LocallyConnected (Object z) where
  hom_ext := by
    intro X Y f g h
    apply Arrow.ext
    funext x
    have he := congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => k.val x)
      (h (singletonIdem X x) (singleton_connected X x))
    have hs : x ∈ support (singletonIdem X x) := by
      rw [singletonIdem,support_setIdem]
      rfl
    have hx : (singletonIdem X x).hom.val x = Part.some x :=
      Part.eq_some_iff.mpr ((mem_idem (singletonIdem X x) x x).mpr ⟨hs,rfl⟩)
    change ((singletonIdem X x).hom.val x).bind f.val =
      ((singletonIdem X x).hom.val x).bind g.val at he
    simpa only [hx,Part.bind_some] using he

lem:miller-cut-reduction.label: lem:miller-cut-reduction
lem:miller-cut-reduction.reconstruction: To reduce A_i to the strict cuts, construct open sets U^i_e of z by enumerated finite halting cylinders; using compactness of P_z characterize them as unions of complements of effectively closed dyadic box unions K_{e,m,t}.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Cut.separatingReal_program
references.source:
theorem separatingReal_program :
    ∃ d : ℕ,∀ p : Bits,∀ e k : ℕ,∃ i : ℕ,
      i∈OracleProgram.numberedEval d p (Nat.pair e k) ∧
      |(Rationals.q i:ℝ)-separatingReal e (rho p)|<((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := FiniteUse.exists_program SeparatingProgram.encodedUse
    SeparatingProgram.encodedAlgorithm SeparatingProgram.encodedUse_computable
    SeparatingProgram.encodedAlgorithm_computable
  refine ⟨d,?_⟩
  intro p e k
  let N := SeparatingProgram.use e k
  let i := SeparatingProgram.index (bitPrefix p N) e k
  have hv : OracleProgram.numberedEval d p (Nat.pair e k)=Part.some i := by
    simpa only [SeparatingProgram.encodedUse,SeparatingProgram.encodedAlgorithm,
      Nat.unpair_pair,OracleProgram.numericalPrefix,normalizeWord_numericalPrefix] using hd p (Nat.pair e k)
  refine ⟨i,?_,SeparatingProgram.index_error p N e k (le_refl N)⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact Part.mem_some _

    a (reduction e)=separatingPoint e a := by
  change a (specializationIndex approximationIndex e)=separatingPoint e a
  apply miller_coordinate_of_approximation a ha approximationIndex separatingPoint ?_ e
  intro p x k

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Cut.reduction_lower
references.source:
theorem reduction_lower (a : Point) (ha : IsMiller a) (e : ℕ) :
    reduction e ∈ CutDigits.lowerCut a ↔
      ∃ m,m ∈ Unanimity.tau a e e ∧ m%2=0 := by
  change (a (reduction e) : ℝ)<1/2 ↔ _
  rw [reduction_value a ha e]
  change separatingReal e a<1/2 ↔ _
  have h := separatingReal_lt_half e a
  change separatingReal e a<1/2 ↔ ∃ m,m%2=0 ∧ m ∈ Unanimity.tau a e e at h
  simpa only [and_comm] using h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Cut.reduction_upper
references.source:
theorem reduction_upper (a : Point) (ha : IsMiller a) (e : ℕ) :
    reduction e ∈ CutDigits.upperCut a ↔
      ∃ m,m ∈ Unanimity.tau a e e ∧ m%2=1 := by
  change 1/2<(a (reduction e) : ℝ) ↔ _
  rw [reduction_value a ha e]
  change 1/2<separatingReal e a ↔ _
  have h := separatingReal_gt_half e a

references.source:
theorem mono_has_partial_inverse (z : Point) {X Y : CanonicalTotal z}
    (m : X ⟶ Y) [Mono m] :
    ∃ r : Y.obj ⟶ X.obj,m.hom ≫ r = 𝟙 X.obj ∧ r ≫ m.hom = rst r := by
  let E := pointPresentation z
  let n := E.inverse.map m
  have : Mono n := by dsimp [n]; infer_instance
  let s := PartialSpans.inverse n
  let iX := E.counitIso.app X
  let iY := E.counitIso.app Y
  let a := inclusion.map n.hom
  let b := inclusion.map s
  have hab : a ≫ b = 𝟙 _ := by
    change inclusion.map n.hom ≫ inclusion.map s = _
    rw [← inclusion.map_comp,PartialSpans.hom_inverse,inclusion.map_id]
  have hba : b ≫ a = rst b := by
    change inclusion.map s ≫ inclusion.map n.hom = _
    rw [← inclusion.map_comp,PartialSpans.inverse_hom]
    exact inclusion_rst s
  have hn : a ≫ iY.hom.hom = iX.hom.hom ≫ m.hom := by
    exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom) (E.counitIso.hom.naturality m)
  let jX : inclusion.obj (E.inverse.obj X).obj ≅ X.obj :=
    ⟨iX.hom.hom, iX.inv.hom,
      congrArg (fun k => k.hom) iX.hom_inv_id,
      congrArg (fun k => k.hom) iX.inv_hom_id⟩
  let jY : inclusion.obj (E.inverse.obj Y).obj ≅ Y.obj :=
    ⟨iY.hom.hom, iY.inv.hom,
      congrArg (fun k => k.hom) iY.hom_inv_id,
      congrArg (fun k => k.hom) iY.inv_hom_id⟩
  exact conjugate_partial_inverse jX jY a b m.hom hab hba hn

def canonicalPresentedSyntax (z : Point) (V : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)
    (σ π : ℕ → PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) (d : ℕ) :
    CategoricalSyntax ((Total.pointPresentation z).functor.obj
      ((Syntax.predicateFunctor (Uniform.Family.ofPoint z)).obj V))
      (fun n => (Total.pointPresentation z).functor.obj
        ((Syntax.predicateFunctor (Uniform.Family.ofPoint z)).obj (σ n)))
      (fun n => (Total.pointPresentation z).functor.obj
        ((Syntax.predicateFunctor (Uniform.Family.ofPoint z)).obj (π n))) d := by
  let P := Uniform.Family.ofPoint z
  let E := Total.pointPresentation z
  let S := presentedSyntax P V σ π d
  let p := SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression ((Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj V)
    (fun n => (Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj (σ n)) d
  let q := SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression ((Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj V)
    (fun n => (Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj (π n)) d
  let D := pushedData E p q S.algebra S.initial S.stable
  have hp := SyntaxOperationsTransport.mapCoefficients_termExpression E.functor.obj
    ((Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj V) (fun n => (Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj (σ n)) d
  have hq := SyntaxOperationsTransport.mapCoefficients_formulaExpression E.functor.obj
    ((Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj V) (fun n => (Syntax.predicateFunctor P).obj (π n)) d
  exact {
    decidableVariables := DecidableVariables.Transport.mapped E S.decidableVariables _ (Iso.refl _)
    algebra := castAlgebra hp hq D.1
    initial := castAlgebraInitial hp hq D.1 D.2.1
    stable := castAlgebraStable hp hq D.1 D.2.2
    lists := SyntacticLists.Transport.mappedStableListAlgebra E _ _ (Iso.refl _) S.lists }

theorem modelsRCF_iff_exists_realization (M : Interpretation K) : ModelsWords M RCFAxiomWords ↔
    ∃ fieldInst : Field K,∃ orderInst : LinearOrder K,
      let : Field K := fieldInst
      let : LinearOrder K := orderInst
      ∃ compatible : IsStrictOrderedRing K,
        let : IsStrictOrderedRing K := compatible
        IsRealClosed K ∧ M.functions=Semantics.functions (constantValue M) ∧
          M.relations=Semantics.relations (K := K) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let hM := matrices_valid_of_models M h
    refine ⟨fieldStructure M hM,linearOrderStructure M hM,strictOrderedRing M hM,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact realClosed_of_models M h
    · exact functions_comparison M hM
    · exact relations_comparison M hM
  · rintro ⟨fieldInst,orderInst,compatible,hrcf,hfunctions,hrelations⟩
    let : Field K := fieldInst
    let : LinearOrder K := orderInst
    let : IsStrictOrderedRing K := compatible
    let : IsRealClosed K := hrcf
    intro word hw
    obtain ⟨φ,hcode,hvalid⟩ := Semantics.rcf_words_valid (constantValue M) word hw
    refine ⟨φ,hcode,fun ρ => ?_⟩
    change φ.Holds M.functions M.relations ρ
    rw [hfunctions,hrelations]
    exact hvalid ρ

    IsPullback (inclusion s Γ hΓ) (wordProjection s Γ hΓ) s
      (AxiomSubobjects.axiomInclusion P Fm Γ hΓ) := by

  refine PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk (wordProjection_square s Γ hΓ)

def givenPresentation : B ≅ axCarrier s (givenCodes s a) (givenCodes_enumerable s a) where
  hom := givenForward s a
  inv := givenBackward s a
  hom_inv_id := by
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    apply Total.val_ext_on_source
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp ((Total.total_iff a.hom).mp a.property b hb)
    have hf := (givenForward_graph s a b x).mpr hx
    have hg := (givenBackward_graph s a x b).mpr
      ⟨Total.val_target (givenForward s a).hom b x hf,hx⟩
    exact (Part.eq_some_iff.mpr ((Total.mem_val_comp _ _ b b).mpr ⟨x,hf,hg⟩)).trans
      (Part.eq_some_iff.mpr ((Total.mem_supportIdentity B.obj.support b b).mpr ⟨hb,rfl⟩)).symm
  inv_hom_id := by
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    apply Total.val_ext_on_source
    intro x hx
    have hr := (pulled_given_support s a x).mp hx
    rw [Total.support_range] at hr
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hr
    have hf := (givenBackward_graph s a x b).mpr ⟨hx,hb⟩
    have hg := (givenForward_graph s a b x).mpr hb
    exact (Part.eq_some_iff.mpr ((Total.mem_val_comp _ _ x x).mpr ⟨b,hf,hg⟩)).trans
      (Part.eq_some_iff.mpr ((Total.mem_supportIdentity _ x x).mpr ⟨hx,rfl⟩)).symm

theorem sentenceInclusion_graph (point word : ℕ) :
    word ∈ Total.val ((S₁).sentenceInclusion ≫ (formulaIso P V σ π d).hom).hom point ↔
      ∃ q : PredicateInterpretation.Obj ℕ (S₀).sentenceObject,
        q.val ∈ Total.val (sentenceIso P V σ π d).hom.hom point ∧
          ((PredicateInterpretation.functor 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).map (S₀).sentenceInclusion q).val = word := by
  have hc :
      word ∈ Total.val ((S₁).sentenceInclusion ≫ (formulaIso P V σ π d).hom).hom point ↔
        ∃ n, n ∈ Total.val (sentenceIso P V σ π d).hom.hom point ∧
          word ∈ Total.val ((F).map (S₀).sentenceInclusion).hom n :=
    (Iff.of_eq (congrArg
      (fun u : (S₁).sentenceObject ⟶ (F).obj (S₀).algebra.a.2 =>
        word ∈ Total.val u.hom point)
      (sentenceIso_inclusion P V σ π d).symm)).trans
      (Total.mem_val_comp (sentenceIso P V σ π d).hom.hom
        ((F).map (S₀).sentenceInclusion).hom point word)
  refine hc.trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n,hn,hw⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hword⟩ := (Syntax.predicateFunctor_graph P (S₀).sentenceInclusion n word).mp hw
    exact ⟨q,hq.symm ▸ hn,hword⟩
  · rintro ⟨q,hq,hword⟩
    exact ⟨q.val,hq,(Syntax.predicateFunctor_graph P (S₀).sentenceInclusion q.val word).mpr
      ⟨q,rfl,hword⟩⟩

theorem success_iff (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ ψ : Fm) :
    (∃ a : (U).obj (S).admissibleSubstitution,
      (U).map (S).admissibleInclusion a=formulaInput P σ π d x t φ ∧
      (U).map (S).formulaSubstitution a=formulaPoint P σ π d ψ) ↔
        decodedResult P σ π d x t φ=some ψ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,hi,hr⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun f => (U).map f a) (S).formulaSubstitution_square
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply,hi,hr] at h

    exact (congrArg (decodeOption P σ π d) h).trans (decode_optionPoint P σ π d _)
  · intro h
    have hv : formulaOptionValue P σ π d x t φ=optionPoint P σ π d (some ψ) :=
      (optionPoint_decode P σ π d _).symm.trans (congrArg (optionPoint P σ π d) h)
    exact Points.pullback_point_exists (S).formulaSubstitutionOption
      (coprod.inr : (S).algebra.a.2 ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj (S).algebra.a.2)
      (formulaInput P σ π d x t φ) (formulaPoint P σ π d ψ) hv

theorem equal_binder_option (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ : Fm) :
    formulaOptionValue P σ π d x t (.all x φ)=optionPoint P σ π d (some (.all x φ)) := by
  let Z : Total.TotalCategory P := ⟨Total.terminalCarrier⟩
  let xp : Z ⟶ (F).obj (V) := Total.underlyingPoint (Points.namePoint P x)
  let tp : Z ⟶ (S).substitutionParameters := Total.underlyingPoint (parameterPoint P σ π d x t)
  let bp : Z ⟶ (S).algebra.a.2 := Total.underlyingPoint (formulaPoint P σ π d φ)
  let k : Z ⟶ (S).quantifierAdmissibilityParameters := prod.lift (prod.lift xp bp) tp
  have hx : tp ≫ prod.fst=xp := by
    exact (PointFrame.point_natural
      (prod.fst : (S).substitutionParameters ⟶ (F).obj (V))
      (parameterPoint P σ π d x t)).symm.trans
        (congrArg Total.underlyingPoint
          (Points.pairPoint_fst (Points.namePoint P x) (termPoint P σ π d t)))
  have he : k ≫ (S).quantifiedEquality=Two.constant Z true := by
    have ht := ((S).decidableVariables.test_true_iff xp xp).mpr rfl
    simpa only [k,CategoricalSyntax.quantifiedEquality,prod.comp_lift,
      prod.lift_fst,prod.lift_snd,prod.lift_fst_assoc,prod.lift_snd_assoc,
      prod.comp_lift_assoc,Category.assoc,hx] using ht
  have hh := (S).quantified_equal_name k he
  have h : prod.lift (prod.lift xp bp ≫ (S).quantifierConstructor) tp ≫
      (S).formulaSubstitutionOption=(prod.lift xp bp ≫ (S).quantifierConstructor) ≫ coprod.inr := by
    simpa only [k,CategoricalSyntax.quantifiedInput,prod.lift_map_assoc,
      Category.comp_id,prod.lift_fst,prod.lift_fst_assoc,Category.assoc] using hh
  let z : (U).obj Z := ⟨0,rfl⟩
  have hxv : (U).map xp z=Points.namePoint P x := at_point _
  have htv : (U).map tp z=parameterPoint P σ π d x t := at_point _
  have hbv : (U).map bp z=formulaPoint P σ π d φ := at_point _
  have hv := congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ OptionSyntax.obj (S).algebra.a.2 => (U).map f z) h
  simpa only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply,Points.lift_point,hxv,htv,hbv,
    Points.quantifier_point,formulaOptionValue,formulaInput,Points.substitutionPoint,
    parameterPoint,optionPoint] using hv

theorem rawCode_represents (X : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔 × PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)
    (p : SyntaxPolynomial (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (z : Data X p) :
    (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation 𝗣𝗔 X.1 X.2 p).val.Evalb
      ![rawCode X p z,(realize X p z).val] := by
  induction p with
  | term => exact (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_term_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 _ _).mpr ⟨z.property,rfl⟩
  | formula => exact (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_formula_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 _ _).mpr ⟨z.property,rfl⟩
  | coefficient C =>
      exact (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_coefficient_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 C _ _).mpr
        ⟨z.property,rfl⟩
  | unit =>
      exact (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_unit_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 _ _).mpr
        ⟨(SyntacticSyntax.modelTerminalPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ).property,rfl⟩
  | product p q hp hq =>
      apply (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_product_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 p q _ _).mpr
      refine ⟨_,_,_,_,rfl,hp z.1,hq z.2,?_,?_⟩
      · exact (SyntacticLists.chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 ℕ prod.fst _ _).mpr
          (SyntacticLists.pairPoint_fst 𝗣𝗔 ℕ _ _)
      · exact (SyntacticLists.chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 ℕ prod.snd _ _).mpr
          (SyntacticLists.pairPoint_snd 𝗣𝗔 ℕ _ _)
  | sum p q hp hq =>
      cases z with
      | inl x =>
          apply (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_sum_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 p q _ _).mpr
          exact Or.inl ⟨_,_,rfl,hp x,(SyntacticLists.chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 ℕ coprod.inl _ _).mpr rfl⟩
      | inr y =>
          apply (SyntacticSyntax.baseRepresentation_sum_eval 𝗣𝗔 ℕ X.1 X.2 p q _ _).mpr
          exact Or.inr ⟨_,_,rfl,hq y,(SyntacticLists.chosenGraph_map_iff 𝗣𝗔 ℕ coprod.inr _ _).mpr rfl⟩

theorem framed_operation_transport_normalized
    (R₀ : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔) (R₁ : Total.TotalCategory P) (e : (F).obj R₀ ≅ R₁)
    (r₀ : (N).obj R₀)
    (X : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔 × PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)
    (Y : Total.TotalCategory P × Total.TotalCategory P) (c : (FP).obj X ≅ Y)
    (p : SyntaxPolynomial (PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔)) (q : SyntaxPolynomial (Total.TotalCategory P))
    (hq : Syntax.Polynomial.mapped P p=q)
    {W : PredicateCategory 𝗣𝗔} {Z : Total.TotalCategory P} (j : (F).obj W ≅ Z)
    (v : R₀ ⨯ p.eval.obj X ⟶ W) (w : R₁ ⨯ q.eval.obj Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : (F).map v ≫ j.hom=
      (NamedSyntaxComparison.Options.productIso (F) e
        (NamedSyntaxComparison.constructorInput P X Y c p q hq)).hom ≫ w)
    (z : Data X p) :
    let r₁ := (U).map e.hom (sourcePoint P R₀ r₀)
    (U).map (prod.snd : R₁ ⨯ Z ⟶ Z)
      ((U).map (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R₁ Y q ≫ parameterHom w).left
        ((U).map (PointFrame.realize R₁ r₁ (constantFamily R₁ Y.1,constantFamily R₁ Y.2) q
          (castFrameData P hq (mappedFrameData P R₁ r₁ X Y c p z))).left ⟨0,rfl⟩))=
      (U).map j.hom (sourcePoint P W ((N).map v (SyntacticLists.pairPoint 𝗣𝗔 ℕ r₀ (realize X p z)))) := by
  subst q
  have hc := congrArg (fun i => (NamedSyntaxComparison.Options.productIso (F) e i).hom ≫ w)
    (baseChart_constructorInput P X Y c p)
  have ht := framed_operation_transport P R₀ R₁ e r₀ X Y c p j v w (h.trans hc.symm) z
  simpa only [castFrameData] using ht

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.NativeSubstitution.PointFrame.realize_parameterComparison
references.source:
theorem realize_parameterComparison (R : Total.TotalCategory P) (r : (U).obj R)
    (X Y : Total.TotalCategory P) (p : SyntaxPolynomial (Total.TotalCategory P))
    (z : Data R r (constantFamily R X,constantFamily R Y) p) :
    realize R r (constantFamily R X,constantFamily R Y) p z ≫
        SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) p=
      nodeFrame (Total.underlyingPoint r) (nodeBaseArrow R r X Y p z) := by
  induction p with
  | term =>
      change z ≫ 𝟙 _=nodeFrame (Total.underlyingPoint r) (z.left ≫ prod.snd)
      rw [Category.comp_id]
      exact nodeFrame_eta (Total.underlyingPoint r) z
  | formula =>
      change z ≫ 𝟙 _=nodeFrame (Total.underlyingPoint r) (z.left ≫ prod.snd)
      rw [Category.comp_id]
      exact nodeFrame_eta (Total.underlyingPoint r) z
  | coefficient C =>
      change PointFrame.constant R r C z ≫ 𝟙 _=nodeFrame (Total.underlyingPoint r) (Total.underlyingPoint z)
      rw [Category.comp_id]
      rfl
  | unit => exact nodeFrame_unit (Total.underlyingPoint r)
  | product p q hp hq =>
      change prod.lift (realize R r _ p z.1) (realize R r _ q z.2) ≫
        (prod.map (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) p)
          (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) q) ≫
            constantProductComparison R (p.eval.obj (X,Y)) (q.eval.obj (X,Y)))=_
      rw [← Category.assoc,prod.lift_map,hp,hq]
      exact nodeFrame_product (Total.underlyingPoint r)
        (nodeBaseArrow R r X Y p z.1) (nodeBaseArrow R r X Y q z.2)
  | sum p q hp hq =>
      cases z with
      | inl z =>
          change (realize R r _ p z ≫ coprod.inl) ≫
            (coprod.map (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) p)
              (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) q) ≫
                coprod.desc ((constantFamilyFunctor R).map coprod.inl)
                  ((constantFamilyFunctor R).map coprod.inr))=_
          simp only [Category.assoc,coprod.inl_map_assoc,coprod.inl_desc]
          rw [← Category.assoc,hp]
          exact nodeFrame_map (Total.underlyingPoint r) (nodeBaseArrow R r X Y p z) coprod.inl
      | inr z =>
          change (realize R r _ q z ≫ coprod.inr) ≫
            (coprod.map (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) p)
              (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison R (X,Y) q) ≫
                coprod.desc ((constantFamilyFunctor R).map coprod.inl)
                  ((constantFamilyFunctor R).map coprod.inr))=_
          simp only [Category.assoc,coprod.inr_map_assoc,coprod.inr_desc]
          rw [← Category.assoc,hq]
          exact nodeFrame_map (Total.underlyingPoint r) (nodeBaseArrow R r X Y q z) coprod.inr

theorem termState_comparison (x : ℕ) (t r : Tm) :
    termState P σ π d x t r=expectedTermState P σ π d x t r := by
  induction r with
  | var y =>
      exact (termState_step P σ π d x t (.var y)).trans
        ((congrArg (termStepValue P σ π d x t) (term_native_input_variable P σ π d x y t)).trans
          (expectedTermState_step P σ π d x t (.var y)))
  | app k label children ih =>
      exact (termState_step P σ π d x t (.app k label children)).trans
        ((congrArg (termStepValue P σ π d x t)
          (term_native_input_function P σ π d x t k label children ih)).trans
            (expectedTermState_step P σ π d x t (.app k label children)))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.NativeSubstitution.termValue_eq_native
references.source:
theorem termValue_eq_native (x : ℕ) (t r : Tm) :
    termValue P σ π d x t r=termPoint P σ π d (r.substitute x t) := by
  have h := congrArg ((U).map (prod.snd : (S).substitutionCarriers.1 ⟶ (S).algebra.a.1))
    ((termState_comparison P σ π d x t r).trans (expectedTermState_native P σ π d x t r))
  exact (termState_result P σ π d x t r).symm.trans (h.trans (Points.pairPoint_snd _ _))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.NativeSubstitution.formulaState_comparison
references.source:
theorem formulaState_comparison (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ : Fm) :
    formulaState P σ π d x t φ=expectedFormulaState P σ π d x t φ := by
  induction φ with
  | equal u v =>
      apply state_of_node_data P σ π d x t (.equal u v)
      have hh :=
          congrArg (fun z => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl z))) : PointFrame.Data (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a (q)))
            (congrArg₂ Prod.mk (termLeaf_native P σ π d x t u) (termLeaf_native P σ π d x t v))
      simp only [formulaNodeInput,SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression,PointFrame.mapData,formulaNativeStateInputData,
        paFormulaNodeData,Standard.mapData,formulaStateInputData,Standard.mappedFrameData,
        Standard.castFrameData,SyntaxPolynomial.power,NamedSyntaxComparison.substitutionStateIso]
      convert hh using 1
  | relation k label children =>
      apply state_of_node_data P σ π d x t (.relation k label children)
      simp only [formulaNodeInput,SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression,PointFrame.mapData,formulaNativeStateInputData,
        paFormulaNodeData,Standard.mapData,formulaStateInputData]
      have hn := PointFrame.arityData_natural (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t)
        (S).substitutionFold (fun n => (F).obj (π n)) d k (sourcePoint P (π k.val) label)
        (fun i => termLeaf P σ π d (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (children i))
      have hh := congrArg (fun z => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr z))) :
        PointFrame.Data (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a (q))) hn
      refine hh.trans ?_
      rw [Standard.mapData_arityData,Standard.mappedFrameData_arity]
      apply congrArg (fun f => Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr
        (PointFrame.arityData (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a
          (fun n => (F).obj (π n)) d k (sourcePoint P (π k.val) label) f)))))
      funext i
      exact termLeaf_native P σ π d x t (children i)
  | neg body ih =>
      apply state_of_node_data P σ π d x t (.neg body)
      have hh :=
          congrArg (fun f => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr f)) : PointFrame.Data (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a (q))) (formulaLeaf_native P σ π d x t body ih)
      simp only [formulaNodeInput,SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression,PointFrame.mapData,formulaNativeStateInputData,
        paFormulaNodeData,Standard.mapData,formulaStateInputData,Standard.mappedFrameData,
        NamedSyntaxComparison.substitutionStateIso]
      convert hh using 1
  | imp left right ihl ihr =>
      apply state_of_node_data P σ π d x t (.imp left right)
      have hh :=
          congrArg (fun z => (Sum.inl (Sum.inr z) : PointFrame.Data (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a (q)))
            (congrArg₂ Prod.mk (formulaLeaf_native P σ π d x t left ihl)
              (formulaLeaf_native P σ π d x t right ihr))
      simp only [formulaNodeInput,SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression,PointFrame.mapData,formulaNativeStateInputData,
        paFormulaNodeData,Standard.mapData,formulaStateInputData,Standard.mappedFrameData,
        Standard.castFrameData,SyntaxPolynomial.power,NamedSyntaxComparison.substitutionStateIso]
      convert hh using 1
  | all y body ih =>
      apply state_of_node_data P σ π d x t (.all y body)
      have hh :=
          congrArg (fun f => (Sum.inr (Points.namePoint P y,f) : PointFrame.Data (R) (parameterPoint P σ π d x t) (S).substitutionAlgebra.a (q))) (formulaLeaf_native P σ π d x t body ih)
      simp only [formulaNodeInput,SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression,PointFrame.mapData,formulaNativeStateInputData,
        paFormulaNodeData,Standard.mapData,formulaStateInputData,Standard.mappedFrameData,
        Points.namePoint,NamedSyntaxComparison.substitutionStateIso]
      convert hh using 1
      all_goals rfl

theorem native_substitution_instance (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ ψ : Fm)
    (hs : φ.substitute x t=some ψ) :
    ∃ a : (U).obj (S).admissibleSubstitution,
      (U).map (S).admissibleInclusion a=Points.substitutionPoint P σ π d x φ t ∧
      (U).map (S).formulaSubstitution a=formulaPoint P σ π d ψ :=
  (success_iff P σ π d x t φ ψ).mpr ((decodedResult_eq_substitute P σ π d x t φ).trans hs)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.NativeSubstitution.native_substitution_reflection
references.source:
theorem native_substitution_reflection (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ ψ : Fm)
    (a : (U).obj (S).admissibleSubstitution)
    (hi : (U).map (S).admissibleInclusion a=Points.substitutionPoint P σ π d x φ t)
    (hr : (U).map (S).formulaSubstitution a=formulaPoint P σ π d ψ) :
    φ.FreeFor x t ∧ φ.substitute x t=some ψ := by
  have hs := (decodedResult_eq_substitute P σ π d x t φ).symm.trans
    ((success_iff P σ π d x t φ ψ).mp ⟨a,hi,hr⟩)
  refine ⟨(Formula.substitute_isSome_iff φ x t).mp ?_,hs⟩
  rw [hs]
  rfl

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.NativeSubstitution.native_freeFor_iff_success
references.source:
theorem native_freeFor_iff_success (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ : Fm) :
    φ.FreeFor x t ↔ ∃ a : (U).obj (S).admissibleSubstitution,
      (U).map (S).admissibleInclusion a=Points.substitutionPoint P σ π d x φ t := by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hs := (Formula.substitute_isSome_iff φ x t).mpr hf
    cases he : φ.substitute x t with
    | none =>
        rw [he] at hs
        change (false : Bool)=true at hs
        cases hs
    | some ψ =>
        obtain ⟨a,ha,_⟩ := native_substitution_instance P σ π d x t φ ψ he
        exact ⟨a,ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
    let ψ := NamedProofImage.decodeFormula P σ π d ((U).map (S).formulaSubstitution a)
    exact (native_substitution_reflection P σ π d x t φ ψ a ha
      (NamedProofImage.formulaPoint_decode P σ π d _).symm).1

theorem native_failure_iff (x : ℕ) (t : Tm) (φ : Fm) :

theorem finite_realizes {φ : Fm} (h : FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ) :
    ∃ p : (U).obj (proofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ),
      (U).map (conclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) p=formulaPoint P σ π d φ := by
  obtain ⟨L,hL,hφ⟩ := h
  exact native_realizes P σ π d Γ hΓ L hL hφ

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.conclusion_finite
references.source:
theorem conclusion_finite (p : (U).obj (proofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ)) :
    FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ (decodeFormula P σ π d ((U).map (c) p)) := by
  apply Derivation.WordInduction.firstOrder_conclusion_induction
    (S).logicalAxioms (S).sentenceInclusion (axioms P σ π d Γ hΓ)
    (S).quantifierConstructor (S).implicationConstructor
    (fun q => FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ (decodeFormula P σ π d q))
    (logical_parameter_finite P σ π d Γ)
    (axiom_finite_proof P σ π d Γ hΓ)
    (generalization_finite P σ π d Γ)
    (modusPonens_finite P σ π d Γ) p

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.realizes_iff_finite
references.source:
theorem realizes_iff_finite (φ : Fm) :
    (∃ p : (U).obj (proofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ),(U).map (c) p=formulaPoint P σ π d φ) ↔
      FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p,hp⟩
    have h := conclusion_finite P σ π d Γ hΓ p
    rwa [hp,decode_formulaPoint] at h
  · exact finite_realizes P σ π d Γ hΓ

theorem formula_range_iff (φ : Fm) :
    formulaCode φ∈Total.Subobjects.imageCodes (c) ↔ FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n,hn⟩
    let p : (U).obj (proofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ) := ⟨n,Total.val_source (c).hom n _ hn⟩
    apply (realizes_iff_finite P σ π d Γ hΓ φ).mp
    refine ⟨p,(Total.totalFunction_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    simpa only [formulaPoint_value] using hn
  · exact finite_formula_range P σ π d Γ hΓ

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.sentence_range_iff
references.source:
theorem sentence_range_iff (φ : Fm) (hc : φ.freeVariables=[]) :
    (sentencePoint P σ π d φ hc).val∈Total.Subobjects.imageCodes
      (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) ↔ FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n,hn⟩
    let q : (U).obj (sentenceProofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ) :=
      ⟨n,Total.val_source (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ).hom n _ hn⟩
    have hq : (U).map (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) q=sentencePoint P σ π d φ hc :=
      (Total.totalFunction_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr hn
    let p := (U).map (pullback.fst (c) (S).sentenceInclusion) q
    have hp : (U).map (c) p=formulaPoint P σ π d φ := by
      have hv := congrArg (fun k : sentenceProofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ ⟶ (S).algebra.a.2 =>
        (U).map k q) (pullback.condition (f := (c)) (g := (S).sentenceInclusion))
      simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply] at hv
      have hi : (U).map (S).sentenceInclusion ((U).map (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) q)=
          formulaPoint P σ π d φ :=
        (congrArg ((U).map (S).sentenceInclusion) hq).trans (sentencePoint_inclusion P σ π d φ hc)
      exact hv.trans hi
    exact (realizes_iff_finite P σ π d Γ hΓ φ).mp ⟨p,hp⟩
  · exact fun h => finite_sentence_range P σ π d Γ hΓ h hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.sentence_image_iff

theorem sentence_image_iff (φ : Fm) (hc : φ.freeVariables=[]) :
    (sentencePoint P σ π d φ hc).val∈Total.Subobjects.imageCodes
      (image.ι (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ)) ↔ FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ := by
  rw [Total.Subobjects.imageCodes_image_ι]
  exact sentence_range_iff P σ π d Γ hΓ φ hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.NamedProofImage.sentence_word_range_iff
references.source:
theorem sentence_word_range_iff (φ : Fm) :
    formulaCode φ∈Total.Subobjects.imageCodes
      (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ ≫ sentenceWord P σ π d) ↔
      FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ φ ∧ φ.freeVariables=[] := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n,hn⟩
    let q : (U).obj (sentenceProofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ) :=
      ⟨n,Total.val_source (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ ≫ sentenceWord P σ π d).hom n _ hn⟩
    let s := (U).map (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) q
    let f := (U).map (S).sentenceInclusion s
    let p := (U).map (pullback.fst (c) (S).sentenceInclusion) q
    have hp : (U).map (c) p=f := by
      have hv := congrArg (fun k : sentenceProofObject P σ π d Γ hΓ ⟶ (S).algebra.a.2 =>
        (U).map k q) (pullback.condition (f := (c)) (g := (S).sentenceInclusion))
      simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply] at hv
      exact hv
    have hw : ((U).map (sentenceWord P σ π d) s).val=formulaCode φ := by
      have hm := Part.mem_unique (Total.totalFunction_mem
        (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ ≫ sentenceWord P σ π d) q) hn
      have hh : ((U).map (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ ≫ sentenceWord P σ π d) q).val=
          formulaCode φ := hm
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val ((U).map_comp_apply
        (sentenceConclusion P σ π d Γ hΓ) (sentenceWord P σ π d) q)
      exact hv.symm.trans hh
    have hf : f.val=formulaCode φ := (sentence_word_value P σ π d s).symm.trans hw
    have hdecode : decodeFormula P σ π d f=φ :=
      NamedPostfixEncoding.formulaCode_injective ((decodeFormula_code P σ π d f).trans hf)
    have hproof := conclusion_finite P σ π d Γ hΓ p
    rw [hp,hdecode] at hproof
    have hclosed : (decodeFormula P σ π d f).freeVariables=[] :=
      sentence_inclusion_closed P σ π d s
    rw [hdecode] at hclosed
    exact ⟨hproof,hclosed⟩
  · rintro ⟨h,hc⟩
    exact finite_sentence_word_range P σ π d Γ hΓ h hc

    formulaCode φ∈Total.support (refutationIdem P Γ hΓ) ↔
      FiniteAxiomProof σ π d Γ (.neg φ) ∧ φ.freeVariables=[] := by
  rw [refutationIdem_support]

def proofAlgebraIso : canonicalProofAlgebra a σ π d Γ hΓ ≅ mappedProofAlgebra a σ π d Γ hΓ :=
  (canonicalProofInitial a σ π d Γ hΓ).uniqueUpToIso (mappedProofInitial a σ π d Γ hΓ)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalPresentation.proof_constructor
references.source:
theorem proof_constructor :
    (canonicalProofAlgebra a σ π d Γ hΓ).str ≫ (proofOverIso a σ π d Γ hΓ).hom =
      (canonicalRules a σ π d Γ hΓ).inference.map (proofOverIso a σ π d Γ hΓ).hom ≫
        (mappedProofAlgebra a σ π d Γ hΓ).str :=
  (proofAlgebraIso a σ π d Γ hΓ).hom.h.symm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalPresentation.canonical_sentenceTheory_eq
references.source:
theorem canonical_sentenceTheory_eq :
    imageSubobject (canonicalSentenceConclusion a σ π d Γ hΓ) =
      Subobject.mk (mappedSentenceImageInclusion a σ π d Γ hΓ) :=
  Subobject.mk_eq_mk_of_comm _ _ (sentenceImageIso a σ π d Γ hΓ)
    (sentenceImageIso_inclusion a σ π d Γ hΓ)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalPresentation.canonicalAxiomIso

def canonicalAxiomIso : canonicalAxiomObject a σ π d Γ hΓ ≅ chosenAxiomObject a σ π d Γ hΓ :=

        (mappedSentenceIso a (V) σ π d).hom) :=

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.TheoryDomainApplication.categorical_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem categorical_incompleteness (ha : IsMiller a) (Γ : Set ℕ)
    (hΓ : Uniform.Enumerable (P) (·∈Γ)) (hext : RealClosedBounds.Extends a Γ)
    (hcons : Consistent Γ) :
    Inseparable (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) (Idem.pull (negation a) (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)) ∧
      theoremIdem a Γ hΓ ⊔ Idem.pull (negation a) (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)≠⊤ := by
  have hb : RealClosedBounds.Extends a (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a) :=
    RealClosedBounds.extends_of_inclusion a (Set.Subset.refl _)
  exact domain_incompleteness
    (C := CutInseparability.SourceSplit.SplitSource a) («U» := (N)) («S» := (SC))
    (CutInseparability.SourceSplit.printed_cut_inseparability a ha)
    (theta a) (theta_total a) (negation a) (negation_total a) (baseIdem a)
    (lower_bound a _ (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) hb)
    (upper_bound a _ (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) hb)
    (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) (theoremIdem_mono a Γ hΓ hext) (consistency_disjoint a Γ hΓ hcons)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.TheoryDomainApplication.consistent_iff_disjoint
references.source:
theorem consistent_iff_disjoint (Γ : Set ℕ) (hΓ : Uniform.Enumerable (P) (·∈Γ)) :
    Consistent Γ ↔
      theoremIdem a Γ hΓ ⊓ Idem.pull (negation a) (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)=⊥ := by
  constructor
  · exact consistency_disjoint a Γ hΓ
  · intro hd φ hc hp
    let s := NamedProofImage.sentencePoint (P) σ π d φ hc
    have ht : s.val∈CarrierIdempotents.support (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) :=
      (literal_theorem_mem a Γ hΓ φ hc).mpr hp.1
    have hn : s.val∈CarrierIdempotents.support
        (Idem.pull (negation a) (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)) := by
      apply (CarrierIdempotents.support_pull_total (TheorySentenceMorphisms.negation (P))
        (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) s).mpr
      change ((U).map (TheorySentenceMorphisms.negation (P)) s).val∈_
      rw [show s=NamedProofImage.sentencePoint (P) σ π d φ hc from rfl,
        TheorySentenceMorphisms.negation_point]
      exact (literal_theorem_mem a Γ hΓ (.neg φ) hc).mpr hp.2
    have hs := (CarrierIdempotents.disjoint_iff _ _).mp hd
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hs ht hn

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.RealClosedConsistency.theoryAxioms_consistent
references.source:
theorem theoryAxioms_consistent (a : Point) :
    TheoryDomainApplication.Consistent (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a) := by
  intro φ _ h
  have hp := RealClosedSoundness.finiteProof_real_sound a h.1 (fun _ => 0)
  have hn := RealClosedSoundness.finiteProof_real_sound a h.2 (fun _ => 0)
  exact hn hp

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Incompleteness.essential_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem essential_incompleteness (ha : IsMiller a) (Γ : Set ℕ)
    (hΓ : Uniform.Enumerable (P) (·∈Γ)) (hext : RealClosedBounds.Extends a Γ)
    (hcons : TheoryDomainApplication.Consistent Γ) :
    Inseparable (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) (refutationIdem a Γ hΓ) ∧
      theoremIdem a Γ hΓ ⊔ refutationIdem a Γ hΓ≠⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨hi,hnc⟩ := TheoryDomainApplication.categorical_incompleteness a ha Γ hΓ hext hcons
  constructor
  · simpa only [theorem_conjugacy,refutation_conjugacy] using
      chart_inseparable (P) _ _ hi
  · intro hc
    apply hnc
    apply (chartIdemIso (P)).injective
    rw [(chartIdemIso (P)).map_sup,(chartIdemIso (P)).map_top,
      theorem_conjugacy,refutation_conjugacy]
    exact hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.Incompleteness.native_incomplete
references.source:
theorem native_incomplete (ha : IsMiller a) (Γ : Set ℕ)
    (hΓ : Uniform.Enumerable (P) (·∈Γ)) (hext : RealClosedBounds.Extends a Γ)
    (hcons : TheoryDomainApplication.Consistent Γ) :
    ∃ φ : Formula,φ.freeVariables=[] ∧ ¬RealClosedBounds.Proof Γ φ ∧
      ¬RealClosedBounds.Proof Γ (.neg φ) := by
  classical
  have hn := literal_noncoverage a ha Γ hΓ hext hcons
  have hex : ∃ word,word∈TheorySentenceWords.literalSet ∧
      word∉CarrierIdempotents.support (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) ∪
        CarrierIdempotents.support (refutationIdem a Γ hΓ) := by
    by_contra h
    apply hn
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro word (hw | hw)
      · exact (TheorySentenceWords.literal_support (P) word).mp
          (CarrierIdempotents.support_subset (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) hw)
      · exact (TheorySentenceWords.literal_support (P) word).mp
          (CarrierIdempotents.support_subset (refutationIdem a Γ hΓ) hw)
    · intro word hw
      by_contra hnot
      exact h ⟨word,hw,hnot⟩
  obtain ⟨word,hword,hnot⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨φ,hc,rfl⟩ := (TheorySentenceWords.literal_iff_native word).mp hword
  refine ⟨φ,hc,?_,?_⟩
  · intro hp
    exact hnot (Or.inl ((theorem_word_iff a Γ hΓ φ).mpr ⟨hp,hc⟩))
  · intro hp
    exact hnot (Or.inr ((refutation_word_iff a Γ hΓ φ).mpr ⟨hp,hc⟩))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalIncompleteness.printed_categorical_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem printed_categorical_incompleteness (ha : IsMiller a) (Γ : Set ℕ)
    (hΓ : Uniform.Enumerable (P) (·∈Γ))
    (hext : theoremIdem a (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a)
      (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) ≤ theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)
    (hcons : theoremIdem a Γ hΓ⊓Idem.pull (nu a) (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ)=⊥) :
    Inseparable (theoremIdem a Γ hΓ) (refutationIdem a Γ hΓ) ∧
      theoremIdem a Γ hΓ⊔refutationIdem a Γ hΓ≠⊤ :=
  printed_essential_incompleteness a ha Γ hΓ
    ((extends_iff_theoremIdem_le a Γ hΓ).mpr hext) hcons

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.axiom_subobject_recovery
references.source:
theorem axiom_subobject_recovery (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m] :
    Subobject.mk m=Subobject.mk (CanonicalPresentation.chosenAxioms a σ π d
      (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m)) :=
  Subobject.mk_eq_mk_of_comm _ _ (axiomIso a m) (axiomIso_inclusion a m)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.sentence_image_recovery
references.source:
theorem sentence_image_recovery (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m] :
    imageSubobject (sentenceConclusion a m)=imageSubobject
      (CanonicalPresentation.chosenSentenceConclusion a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone (S₂).logicalAxioms (S₂).sentenceInclusion
      m (CanonicalPresentation.chosenAxioms a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m))
      (S₂).quantifierConstructor (S₂).implicationConstructor
      (axiomIso a m).hom (axiomIso_inclusion a m) (proofAlgebra a m) (proofInitial a m)
      (CanonicalPresentation.chosenProofAlgebra a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m))
  · exact firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone (S₂).logicalAxioms (S₂).sentenceInclusion
      (CanonicalPresentation.chosenAxioms a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m)) m
      (S₂).quantifierConstructor (S₂).implicationConstructor
      (axiomIso a m).inv (axiomIso_inverse_inclusion a m)
      (CanonicalPresentation.chosenProofAlgebra a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m))
      (CanonicalPresentation.chosenProofInitial a σ π d
        (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m)) (proofAlgebra a m)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.range_recovery
references.source:
theorem range_recovery (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m] :
    theoremIdem a m=CanonicalIncompleteness.theoremIdem a
      (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m) := by
  let c := CanonicalPresentation.chosenSentenceConclusion a σ π d
    (recoveredCodes a m) (recoveredCodes_enumerable a m)
  have h := range_of_image_eq a (sentenceConclusion a m) (image.ι c)
    (sentence_image_recovery a m)
  have hc := range_of_image_eq a c (image.ι c) (rfl : imageSubobject c=Subobject.mk (image.ι c))
  exact h.trans hc.symm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.finite_proof_transport_iff_theoremIdem_le
references.source:
theorem finite_proof_transport_iff_theoremIdem_le
    (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m] :
    (∀ φ : OrderedFieldSyntax.Formula,
      RealClosedBounds.Proof (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a) φ →
        RealClosedBounds.Proof (recoveredCodes a m) φ) ↔
      CanonicalIncompleteness.theoremIdem a (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a)
        (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) ≤ theoremIdem a m :=
  (RealClosedBounds.extends_iff_proof_transport a (recoveredCodes a m)).symm.trans
    (extends_iff_theoremIdem_le a m)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.printed_categorical_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem printed_categorical_incompleteness (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m]
    (ha : IsMiller a)
    (hext : CanonicalIncompleteness.theoremIdem a (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a)
      (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) ≤ theoremIdem a m)
    (hcons : theoremIdem a m⊓Idem.pull (S₂).sentenceNegation.hom (theoremIdem a m)=⊥) :
    Inseparable (theoremIdem a m) (refutationIdem a m) ∧
      theoremIdem a m⊔refutationIdem a m≠⊤ :=
  printed_essential_incompleteness a m ha
    ((extends_iff_theoremIdem_le a m).mpr hext) hcons

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.printed_essential_incompleteness_of_consistent
references.source:
theorem printed_essential_incompleteness_of_consistent
    (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m]
    (ha : IsMiller a) (hext : RealClosedBounds.Extends a (recoveredCodes a m))
    (hcons : TheoryDomainApplication.Consistent (recoveredCodes a m)) :
    Inseparable (theoremIdem a m) (refutationIdem a m) ∧
      theoremIdem a m⊔refutationIdem a m≠⊤ :=
  printed_essential_incompleteness a m ha hext ((consistent_iff_disjoint a m).mp hcons)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.printed_native_incomplete_of_consistent
references.source:
theorem printed_native_incomplete_of_consistent
    (m : A ⟶ (S₂).sentenceObject) [Mono m]
    (ha : IsMiller a) (hext : RealClosedBounds.Extends a (recoveredCodes a m))
    (hcons : TheoryDomainApplication.Consistent (recoveredCodes a m)) :
    ∃ φ : OrderedFieldSyntax.Formula,φ.freeVariables=[] ∧
      ¬RealClosedBounds.Proof (recoveredCodes a m) φ ∧
      ¬RealClosedBounds.Proof (recoveredCodes a m) (.neg φ) :=
  printed_native_incomplete a m ha hext ((consistent_iff_disjoint a m).mp hcons)

cor:miller-associated-categories.label: cor:miller-associated-categories
cor:miller-associated-categories.reconstruction: For every consistent internal enlargement u, the slice is Turing and its constant theory is essentially incomplete with inseparable domains and no total Boolean decision extension.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedData.point_factors
references.source:
theorem point_factors (U : Theory a) :
    ∃ p : pointDomain a ⟶ (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a), p ≫ U.val.arrow = theoremPoint a :=
  NullaryLogicalPoint.factors (syntaxData a).logicalAxioms (syntaxData a).sentenceInclusion
    (syntaxData a).quantifierConstructor (syntaxData a).implicationConstructor (proofs a)
    (theoremPoint a) (logicalPoint a) (logicalPoint_diagram a) U

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedTheories.global_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem global_incompleteness (ha : IsMiller a) (U : Theory a)
    (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (refutation a U) = ⊥) :
    SubobjectInseparable U.val (refutation a U) ∧ U.val ⊔ refutation a U ≠ ⊤ := by
  let e := orderIso (inverses a) (syntaxData a).sentenceObject
  have ht := theory_domain a U
  have hr := refutation_domain a U
  have hx : CanonicalIncompleteness.theoremIdem a (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms a)
      (RealClosedAxioms.theoryAxioms_enumerable a) ≤
      CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.theoremIdem a U.val.arrow := by
    rw [ht, ← base_domain]
    exact (domain_le_iff (inverses a) _ _).mpr hExt
  have hc' : CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.theoremIdem a U.val.arrow ⊓
      Idem.pull (syntaxData a).sentenceNegation.hom
        (CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.theoremIdem a U.val.arrow) = ⊥ := by
    change CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.theoremIdem a U.val.arrow ⊓
      CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.refutationIdem a U.val.arrow = ⊥
    rw [ht, hr]
    change e U.val ⊓ e (refutation a U) = ⊥
    rw [← e.map_inf, hc, e.map_bot]
  have hh := CanonicalAxiomIncompleteness.printed_categorical_incompleteness a U.val.arrow ha hx hc'
  have hi : Inseparable (domain (inverses a) U.val) (domain (inverses a) (refutation a U)) := by
    simpa only [ht, hr] using hh.1
  refine ⟨(inseparable_iff (inverses a) _ _).mp hi, ?_⟩
  intro hcomplete
  apply hh.2
  rw [ht, hr]
  change e U.val ⊔ e (refutation a U) = ⊤
  rw [← e.map_sup, hcomplete, e.map_top]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedIncompleteness.essentially_incomplete
references.source:
theorem essentially_incomplete (ha : IsMiller a) (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (refutation a U) = ⊥) :
    ((constantTheory a U).val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback
      ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a)).map
        (syntaxData a).sentenceNegation)).obj (constantTheory a U).val = ⊥) ∧
    ∀ W : FirstOrderReflection.Theory (sliceProofs a (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a)),
      (constantTheory a U).val ≤ W.val →
      W.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a)).map
        (syntaxData a).sentenceNegation)).obj W.val = ⊥ →
      W.val ⊔ (Subobject.pullback ((constantFamilyFunctor (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a)).map
        (syntaxData a).sentenceNegation)).obj W.val ≠ ⊤ :=
  ⟨SliceSubobjectPredicates.constant_consistency (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a)
    (syntaxData a).sentenceNegation U.val hc,
    every_consistent_extension_incomplete a U ha hExt⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedIncompleteness.actual_domains_inseparable
references.source:
theorem actual_domains_inseparable (ha : IsMiller a) (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (refutation a U) = ⊥) :
    SubobjectInseparable (actualTheoryDomain a U)
      ((Subobject.pullback (actualNegation a U)).obj (actualTheoryDomain a U)) := by
  have h := SliceInseparability.PartialTotals.inseparable (Over (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a))
    _ _ (constant_inseparable a U ha hExt hc)
  rw [FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_pullback] at h
  exact h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedIncompleteness.actual_essentially_incomplete
references.source:
theorem actual_essentially_incomplete (ha : IsMiller a) (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ (refutation a U) = ⊥) :
    (actualTheoryDomain a U ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (actualNegation a U)).obj
      (actualTheoryDomain a U) = ⊥) ∧
    ∀ W : Subobject ((PartialMaps.totalEquivalence
        (D := Over (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a))).functor.obj
          (constantFamily (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a) (syntaxData a).sentenceObject)),
      actualTheoryDomain a U ≤ W →
      W ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (actualNegation a U)).obj W = ⊥ →
      W ⊔ (Subobject.pullback (actualNegation a U)).obj W ≠ ⊤ := by
  have hi := actual_domains_inseparable a U ha hExt hc
  exact ⟨hi.1, fun W hW hcW => SliceInseparability.noncoverage
    (actualNegation a U) (actualTheoryDomain a U) hi W hW hcW⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.turingData
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.family_domain
references.source:
theorem family_domain (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation a U = ⊥) :
    rst ((constantFunctor a U).map (decision a U hc)) =
      (constantFunctor a U).map (domain (inverses a) (U.val ⊔ refutation a U)).hom := by
  erw [← (constantData a U).property.2.1, decision_domain]
  rfl

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.family_true
references.source:
theorem family_true (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation a U = ⊥) :
    (constantFunctor a U).map U.val.arrow.hom ≫
        (constantFunctor a U).map (decision a U hc) =
      (constantFunctor a U).map (Two.constant (U.val : Total.CanonicalTotal a) true).hom := by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, decision_true]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.family_false
references.source:
theorem family_false (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation a U = ⊥) :
    (constantFunctor a U).map (refutation a U).arrow.hom ≫
        (constantFunctor a U).map (decision a U hc) =
      (constantFunctor a U).map
        (Two.constant ((refutation a U) : Total.CanonicalTotal a) false).hom := by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, decision_false]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.no_total_extension
references.source:
theorem no_total_extension (ha : IsMiller a) (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation a U = ⊥) :
    ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension ((constantFunctor a U).map (decision a U hc)) := by
  have hi := (global_incompleteness a ha U hExt hc).1
  have hn : ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension (decision a U hc) :=
    (BooleanPartialDecision.inseparable_iff_noTotalExtension (inverses a) _ _ hc).mp hi
  intro he
  exact hn (((constantData a U).property.2.2 _).mp he)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.postcompose_full
references.source:
theorem postcompose_full {T W : Total.CanonicalTotal a} (i : T ⟶ W) [Mono i] :
    (postcompose a i).Full := (comparisonData a i).property.1

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.postcompose_faithful
references.source:
theorem postcompose_faithful {T W : Total.CanonicalTotal a} (i : T ⟶ W) [Mono i] :
    (postcompose a i).Faithful := (comparisonData a i).property.2.1

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.postcompose_restriction
references.source:
theorem postcompose_restriction {T W : Total.CanonicalTotal a} (i : T ⟶ W) [Mono i] :
    PreservesRestriction (postcompose a i) := (comparisonData a i).property.2.2.1

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedStructure.postcompose_not_essSurj
references.source:

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.Miller.AssociatedCategories.printed_statement
references.source:
theorem printed_statement (ha : IsMiller a) (U : Theory a) (hExt : base a ≤ U.val)
    (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation a U = ⊥) : Conclusions a U hc where
  turing := ⟨turingData a U⟩
  constant_theory := constantTheory_value a U
  closed_consistent := (essentially_incomplete a U ha hExt hc).1
  closed_extensions := (essentially_incomplete a U ha hExt hc).2
  actual_consistent := (actual_essentially_incomplete a U ha hExt hc).1
  actual_extensions := (actual_essentially_incomplete a U ha hExt hc).2
  actual_inseparable := actual_domains_inseparable a U ha hExt hc
  decision_domain := AssociatedStructure.decision_domain a U hc
  decision_true := AssociatedStructure.decision_true a U hc
  decision_false := AssociatedStructure.decision_false a U hc
  family_domain := AssociatedStructure.family_domain a U hc
  family_true := AssociatedStructure.family_true a U hc
  family_false := AssociatedStructure.family_false a U hc
  no_total_extension := AssociatedStructure.no_total_extension a U ha hExt hc
  comparisons := by
    intro U' i _hi _hfac _hc
    exact ⟨postcompose_full a i, postcompose_faithful a i,
      postcompose_restriction a i, postcompose_not_essSurj a i⟩

  apply tupleCode.map_injective
  rw [evaluation_value]
  change component j (forkCode.map (forkCode.preimage 0)) = tupleCode.map (tupleCode.preimage 0)

  apply tupleCode.map_injective
  have ht : tupleCode.map (Ranges.range ((evaluation j).map f)).hom =
      (Ranges.range (tupleCode.map ((evaluation j).map f))).hom :=
    PartialMapEquivalence.preserves_ranges NumericalTuples.equivalence _

      (productComparison j W Y).hom ≫ tupleProducts.map ((evaluation j).map f) ((evaluation j).map g) := by
  unfold RestrictionProducts.ProductData.map

references.source:
def totalEquivalence : Total ≌ (WalkingSpan ⥤ EnumerableCarriers.Total) where
  functor := totalFunctor
  inverse := fromFunctor
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => Iso.refl X) (by
    intro X Y f
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    apply Hom.ext
    · change f.hom.center ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.center
      simp
    · change f.hom.left ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.left
      simp
    · change f.hom.right ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.right
      simp)
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun F => spanIsoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
      (by change (F.map WalkingSpan.Hom.fst) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ _; simp)
      (by change (F.map WalkingSpan.Hom.snd) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ _; simp))
    (by
      intro F G f
      ext j
      rcases j with _ | (_ | _)
      all_goals simp [totalFunctor, fromFunctor, fromNatural])
  functor_unitIso_comp X := by
    ext j
    rcases j with _ | (_ | _)
    all_goals simp [totalFunctor, fromFunctor, totalDiagram, fromDiagram]

def inferenceIso : (rules axioms implication).inference ≅ printedH axioms implication :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (inputIso axioms implication) (by
    intro Q Q' h
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Limits.Sigma.map ((rules axioms implication).ruleMap h) ≫
        toPrintedLeft axioms implication Q' =
      toPrintedLeft axioms implication Q ≫ coprod.map (𝟙 Ax) (mpMap implication h)
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · erw [Sigma.ι_map_assoc,toPrintedLeft_ι_zero,toPrintedLeft_ι_zero_assoc,
        coprod.inl_map,Category.id_comp,RulePresentation.ruleMap_fst_assoc]
      rfl
    · exact (unaryInputInitial axioms implication Q).hom_ext _ _
    · erw [Sigma.ι_map_assoc,toPrintedLeft_ι_two,toPrintedLeft_ι_two_assoc,coprod.inr_map]
      rfl)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivation.Naturality.fold_natural
references.source:
theorem fold_natural (hn : AlgebraNaturality hA hB hA' hB' D D' f hf ha hb h hc) :
    fold A B hA hB D ≫ h = proofMap hA hB hA' hB' f hf ha hb ≫ fold A' B' hA' hB' D' := by
  apply NumericalTuples.Map.ext
  funext x
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := (mem_proofCarrier A B hA hB x.val).mp x.property
  let t := ProofTree.decode x.val
  let y := Component.proofPoint A B hA hB t ⟨p,hp⟩
  have hy : y = x := Subtype.ext (ProofTree.encode_decode x.val)
  have hs := fold_natural_selected hA hB hA' hB' D D' f hf ha hb h hc hn hp
  have hm := proofMap_selected hA hB hA' hB' f hf ha hb t ⟨p,hp⟩
  have hh : (fold A B hA hB D ≫ h).toFun y =
      (proofMap hA hB hA' hB' f hf ha hb ≫ fold A' B' hA' hB' D').toFun y :=
    hs.trans (congrArg (fold A' B' hA' hB' D').toFun hm.symm)
  exact (congrArg (fun z => (fold A B hA hB D ≫ h).toFun z) hy).symm.trans
    (hh.trans (congrArg
      (fun z => (proofMap hA hB hA' hB' f hf ha hb ≫ fold A' B' hA' hB' D').toFun z) hy))

references.source:
theorem componentAlgebra_naturality (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V)
    (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (rules a b).inference) {j k : WalkingSpan} (g : j ⟶ k) :
    Naturality.AlgebraNaturality
      (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b)
      (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b)
      (componentAlgebra a b B j) (componentAlgebra a b B k)
      (spanAtoms g) (spanAtoms_computable g) (componentSupport_map g a) (componentSupport_map g b)
      ((componentTransition g).app B.a.left) (componentOver_transition B.a g) :=
  Naturality.algebraNaturalityOfNodes
    (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b)
    (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b)
    (componentAlgebra a b B j) (componentAlgebra a b B k)
    (spanAtoms g) (spanAtoms_computable g) (componentSupport_map g a) (componentSupport_map g b)
    ((componentTransition g).app B.a.left) (componentOver_transition B.a g)
    (componentAlgebra_node_natural a b B g)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivation.constructorComponents_natural
references.source:
theorem constructorComponents_natural (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V)
    {j k : WalkingSpan} (g : j ⟶ k) :
    (componentTransition g).app ((rules a b).inference.obj (proofSlice a b)).left ≫
        constructorComponent a b k =
      constructorComponent a b j ≫ (componentTransition g).app (proofObject a b) := by
  apply NumericalTuples.Map.ext
  funext x
  let u := (componentInputIso a b (proofSlice a b) j).hom.toFun x
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Component.nodeInput_surjective (componentSupport j a) (componentSupport j b)
    (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b) (componentOver (proofSlice a b) j) u
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => f.toFun x) (componentInputIso_transition a b (proofSlice a b) g)
  have hm := componentInputTransition_node a b (proofSlice a b) g n
  have hv := hi.trans ((congrArg (componentInputTransition a b (proofSlice a b) g).toFun hn.symm).trans hm)
  have hs := Naturality.node_natural
    (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b)
    (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b)
    (pointwiseAlgebra a b j) (pointwiseAlgebra a b k)
    (spanAtoms g) (spanAtoms_computable g) (componentSupport_map g a) (componentSupport_map g b)
    ((componentTransition g).app (proofObject a b)) (componentOver_transition (proofSlice a b) g)
    (pointwiseAlgebra_naturality a b g) n
  exact (congrArg (pointwiseAlgebra a b k).str.left.toFun hv).trans
    (hs.symm.trans (congrArg
      (fun v => ((componentTransition g).app (proofObject a b)).toFun
        ((pointwiseAlgebra a b j).str.left.toFun v)) hn))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivation.foldComponents_natural
references.source:
theorem foldComponents_natural (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V)
    (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (rules a b).inference) {j k : WalkingSpan} (g : j ⟶ k) :
    (componentTransition g).app (proofObject a b) ≫ foldedComponent a b B k =
      foldedComponent a b B j ≫ (componentTransition g).app B.a.left := by
  have hn := Naturality.fold_natural
    (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b)
    (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b)
    (componentAlgebra a b B j) (componentAlgebra a b B k)
    (spanAtoms g) (spanAtoms_computable g) (componentSupport_map g a) (componentSupport_map g b)
    ((componentTransition g).app B.a.left) (componentOver_transition B.a g)
    (componentAlgebra_naturality a b B g)
  calc
    _ = (componentTransition g).app (proofObject a b) ≫
        ((componentProofIso a b k).hom ≫
          Naturality.fold (componentSupport k a) (componentSupport k b)
            (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b) (componentAlgebra a b B k)) := by
      rw [foldedComponent_eq_native]
    _ = ((componentProofIso a b j).hom ≫ Naturality.proofMap
        (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b)
        (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b)
        (spanAtoms g) (spanAtoms_computable g) (componentSupport_map g a) (componentSupport_map g b)) ≫
          Naturality.fold (componentSupport k a) (componentSupport k b)
            (componentSupport_re k a) (componentSupport_re k b) (componentAlgebra a b B k) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc,component_proof_transition]
    _ = (componentProofIso a b j).hom ≫
        (Naturality.fold (componentSupport j a) (componentSupport j b)
          (componentSupport_re j a) (componentSupport_re j b) (componentAlgebra a b B j) ≫
            (componentTransition g).app B.a.left) := by rw [Category.assoc,← hn]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Category.assoc,← foldedComponent_eq_native]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivation.foldHom
references.source:
def foldHom (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V) (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (rules a b).inference) :
    inferenceAlgebra a b ⟶ B where
  f := Over.homMk (foldCarrier a b B) (fold_conclusion a b B)
  h := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply component_jointly_faithful
    intro j
    let m := (component_inferenceIso a b j).hom ≫ foldedComponentHom a b B j
    have he : componentOverMap
        (Over.homMk (foldCarrier a b B) (fold_conclusion a b B)) j = m.f := by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      change (componentFunctor j).map (foldCarrier a b B) =
        ((component_inferenceIso a b j).hom ≫ foldedComponentHom a b B j).f.left
      erw [Endofunctor.Algebra.comp_f,Over.comp_left,
        component_inferenceIso_hom_left,Category.id_comp]
      exact foldCarrier_component a b B j
    have hm := m.h
    rw [← he] at hm
    exact (component_hom_condition a b (inferenceAlgebra a b) B
      (Over.homMk (foldCarrier a b B) (fold_conclusion a b B)) j).mp hm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivation.fold_unique
references.source:
theorem fold_unique (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V)
    (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (rules a b).inference) (m : inferenceAlgebra a b ⟶ B) :
    m = foldHom a b B := by
  apply Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.ext
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply component_jointly_faithful
  intro j
  let v := (component_inferenceIso a b j).hom ≫ foldedComponentHom a b B j
  have he := (component_inferenceInitial a b j).hom_ext
    ((toComponentAlgebra a b j).map m) v
  have hv := congrArg (fun h => h.f.left) he
  simpa only [toComponentAlgebra_map_left,v,Endofunctor.Algebra.comp_f,
    Over.comp_left,component_inferenceIso_hom_left,Category.id_comp,foldedComponent,
    foldHom,Over.homMk_left,foldCarrier_component] using hv

theorem printed_unique (a b : Idem EffectiveFork.V) (Q : EffectiveFork.Total)

theorem least_theorem_image (a b : Idem V) :
    ClosedUnder (ForkDerivation.rules a b).inference (image.ι (conclusion a b)) ∧
      ∀ {U : E} (m : U ⟶ S) [Mono m],
        ClosedUnder (ForkDerivation.rules a b).inference m →
          ∃ w : image (conclusion a b) ⟶ U,
            w ≫ m = image.ι (conclusion a b) :=
  (ForkDerivation.rules a b).least_theorem_subobject
    (ForkDerivation.inferenceAlgebra a b) (ForkDerivation.inferenceInitial a b)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivationImages.theoremSubobject_isLeast
references.source:
theorem theoremSubobject_isLeast (a b : Idem V) :
    IsLeast {P : Subobject S |
      ClosedUnder (ForkDerivation.rules a b).inference P.arrow}
      (theoremSubobject a b) := by
  have h := least_theorem_image a b
  constructor
  · exact closed_of_iso _ _ _ (imageSubobjectIso (conclusion a b)).symm
      (imageSubobject_arrow' (conclusion a b)) h.1
  · intro P hP
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := h.2 P.arrow hP
    apply Subobject.le_of_comm ((imageSubobjectIso (conclusion a b)).hom ≫ w)
    rw [Category.assoc,hw,imageSubobject_arrow]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivationImages.range_regular_image
references.source:
theorem range_regular_image (a b : Idem V) :
    (theoremRange a b).hom =
      EffectiveFork.domainRetraction (theoremRange a b) ≫ (theoremInclusion a b).hom := by
  have hr : EffectiveFork.domainRetraction (theoremRange a b) ≫
      (theoremInclusion a b).hom =
      rst (EffectiveFork.domainRetraction (theoremRange a b)) :=
    (EffectiveFork.retraction_inclusion (theoremRange a b)).trans
      (domainRetraction_restriction (theoremRange a b)).symm
  have h := LocalConnectedness.V46.range_regularImage
    (EffectiveFork.imageQuotient (conclusion a b)) (theoremInclusion a b)
    (EffectiveFork.domainRetraction (theoremRange a b))
    (EffectiveFork.inclusion_retraction (theoremRange a b)) hr
  have hf : (EffectiveFork.imageQuotient (conclusion a b)).hom ≫
      (theoremInclusion a b).hom = (conclusion a b).hom :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom) (EffectiveFork.image_factorization (conclusion a b))
  rw [hf] at h
  exact h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivationImages.proof_presentation
references.source:
theorem proof_presentation (a b : Idem V) (hd : a ⊓ b = ⊥) :
    IsLeast {P : Subobject S |
      ClosedUnder (ForkDerivation.rules a b).inference P.arrow}
      (theoremSubobject a b) ∧
    IsLeast {e | ForkSyntax.IsTheory a b e} (theoremRange a b) ∧
      a ≤ Idem.pull ForkSyntax.theta (theoremRange a b) ∧
      b ≤ Idem.pull ForkSyntax.theta (Idem.pull ForkSyntax.nu (theoremRange a b)) ∧
      theoremRange a b ⊓ Idem.pull ForkSyntax.nu (theoremRange a b) = ⊥ := by
  refine ⟨theoremSubobject_isLeast a b,component_theory_isLeast a b,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [theoremRange_eq_t0]
    exact ForkSyntax.positive_inclusion a b
  · rw [theoremRange_eq_t0]
    exact ForkSyntax.negative_inclusion a b
  · rw [theoremRange_eq_t0]
    exact ForkSyntax.t0_consistency a b hd

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkDerivationImages.LiteralDiagram.imageIso

def imageIso (a b : Idem V) : image (conclusion a b) ≅ theoremObject a b :=
  (image.isoStrongEpiMono

thm:cosheaf-observation.label: thm:cosheaf-observation
thm:cosheaf-observation.reconstruction: For every consistent compatible family the base pair reduces to theorem/refutation in the partial category. At each endpoint positive/negative provable-atom index sets form a functor in the extension order, are disjoint c.e. and recursively inseparable, leaving a sentence undecided.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.ForkSyntax.cosheaf_observation

theorem cosheaf_observation (i : Bool) (t : Theory) :
    Inseparable t.val (Idem.pull nu t.val) ∧
      (REPred (· ∈ tuplePositiveSet i t.val) ∧ REPred (· ∈ tupleNegativeSet i t.val)) ∧
      (Disjoint (tuplePositiveSet i t.val) (tupleNegativeSet i t.val) ∧
        ¬ ∃ D : Set (ℕ × ℕ),ComputablePred (· ∈ D) ∧ tuplePositiveSet i t.val ⊆ D ∧
          Disjoint D (tupleNegativeSet i t.val)) ∧ t.val ⊔ Idem.pull nu t.val≠⊤ :=
  ⟨(coded_observation i t).1,tuple_observations_enumerable i t.val,
    tuple_observations_inseparable i t,(coded_observation i t).2.2⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.ForkSyntax.observationFunctor
references.source:
def observationFunctor (i : Bool) : Theory ⥤ RecursivePairs.Object where
  obj t := observedPair i t
  map {t t'} f :=
    { map := 𝟙 ClassicalPrograms.U2
      total := rst_id _
      positive := by
        change tuplePositive i t.val ≤ Idem.pull (𝟙 ClassicalPrograms.U2) (tuplePositive i t'.val)
        rw [Idem.pull_id]
        apply Idem.pull_mono ClassicalPrograms.pairCodeIso.hom
        apply ClassicalPrograms.supportIdem_le
        exact (EnumerableCarriers.support_le_iff _ _).mp
          (observedPositive_mono i (show t.val ≤ t'.val from leOfHom f))
      negative := by
        change tupleNegative i t.val ≤ Idem.pull (𝟙 ClassicalPrograms.U2) (tupleNegative i t'.val)
        rw [Idem.pull_id]
        apply Idem.pull_mono ClassicalPrograms.pairCodeIso.hom
        apply ClassicalPrograms.supportIdem_le
        exact (EnumerableCarriers.support_le_iff _ _).mp
          (observedNegative_mono i (show t.val ≤ t'.val from leOfHom f)) }
  map_id t := by apply RecursivePairs.Hom.ext; rfl
  map_comp f g := by
    apply RecursivePairs.Hom.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp (𝟙 ClassicalPrograms.U2)).symm

theorem cosheaf_observation_v46 (i : Bool) (t : Theory) :
    Inseparable t.val (Idem.pull nu t.val) ∧
      (REPred (· ∈ tuplePositiveSet i t.val) ∧
        REPred (· ∈ tupleNegativeSet i t.val)) ∧
      (Disjoint (tuplePositiveSet i t.val) (tupleNegativeSet i t.val) ∧
        ¬ ∃ D : Set (ℕ × ℕ), ComputablePred (· ∈ D) ∧
          tuplePositiveSet i t.val ⊆ D ∧ Disjoint D (tupleNegativeSet i t.val)) ∧
      ({x : ℕ × ℕ | Nat.pair x.1 x.2 ∈ support EffectiveFork.endpointPair0} ⊆
          tuplePositiveSet i t.val ∧
        {x : ℕ × ℕ | Nat.pair x.1 x.2 ∈ support EffectiveFork.endpointPair1} ⊆
          tupleNegativeSet i t.val) ∧
      endpointTheory i t.val ⊔
        Idem.pull (natArrow negCode negCode_computable) (endpointTheory i t.val) ≠ ⊤ :=
  ⟨(essential_incompleteness_v46 t.val t.property.1 t.property.2.1).1,
    tuple_observations_enumerable i t.val, tuple_observations_inseparable i t,
    tuple_observed_bounds i t.val t.property.1, endpoint_theory_incomplete i t⟩

    endpointTheory i t.val ⊔
      Idem.pull (natArrow negCode negCode_computable) (endpointTheory i t.val) ≠ ⊤ := by
  apply (endpoint_essential_incompleteness i (endpointTheory i t.val)
    (endpointTheory_mono i t.property.1) ?_).2
  cases i
  · exact congrArg EffectiveFork.rightIdem t.property.2.1
  · exact congrArg EffectiveFork.leftIdem t.property.2.1

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.ForkSyntax.endpoint_complete_iff
references.source:
theorem endpoint_complete_iff (t : Idem natCarrier) :
    t ⊔ Idem.pull (natArrow negCode negCode_computable) t = ⊤ ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ support t ∨ negCode n ∈ support t := by
  constructor
  · intro h n
    have hn : n ∈ support (t ⊔ Idem.pull (natArrow negCode negCode_computable) t) := by
      rw [h, EnumerableCarriers.support_top]
      exact Set.mem_univ n
    rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_sup] at hn
    rcases hn with hn | hn
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · right
      rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_pull] at hn
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyt⟩ := hn
      simpa only [(mem_natArrow _ _ n y).mp hy] using hyt
  · intro h
    apply EnumerableCarriers.support_injective
    ext n
    rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_sup, EnumerableCarriers.support_top]
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact Set.mem_univ n
    · intro _
      rcases h n with hn | hn
      · exact Or.inl hn
      · right
        rw [EnumerableCarriers.support_pull]
        exact ⟨negCode n, (mem_natArrow _ _ _ _).mpr rfl, hn⟩
