theorem endpoint_axiom_extension_incomplete (i : Bool) (A : Set ℕ)
    (hA : REPred (· ∈ A))
    (hext : EnumerableCarriers.support (ForkSyntax.endpointTheory i categoricalTheory) ⊆
      ForkAxiomClosure.theoremCodes A)
    (hc : ∀ p : ForkSyntax.Formula,
      ¬(ForkAxiomClosure.Derives A p ∧ ForkAxiomClosure.Derives A (.neg p))) :
    ∃ p : ForkSyntax.Formula,
      ¬ForkAxiomClosure.Derives A p ∧ ¬ForkAxiomClosure.Derives A (.neg p) := by
  apply ForkAxiomClosure.endpoint_axiom_extension_incomplete i A hA _ hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAxiomClosure.derives_iff_record
references.source:
theorem derives_iff_record (A : Set ℕ) (p : Formula) :
    Derives A p ↔ ∃ t : ProofTree,
      conclusion t = some p ∧ ∀ n ∈ t.positiveList, n ∈ A := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | logical1 p q => exact ⟨.logical1 p q, rfl, by simp [ProofTree.positiveList, ProofTree.fold]⟩
    | logical2 p q r => exact ⟨.logical2 p q r, rfl, by simp [ProofTree.positiveList, ProofTree.fold]⟩
    | logical3 p q => exact ⟨.logical3 p q, rfl, by simp [ProofTree.positiveList, ProofTree.fold]⟩
    | @fromAxiom n hn =>
      exact ⟨.positive n, rfl, by simpa [ProofTree.positiveList, ProofTree.fold, List.singleton] using hn⟩
    | @mp p q _ _ ihp ihq =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := ihp
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := ihq
      refine ⟨.mp t u, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change mpStep (conclusion t, conclusion u) = some q
        rw [ht, hu]
        simp [mpStep, mpResult_eq]
      · intro n hn
        change n ∈ t.positiveList ++ u.positiveList at hn
        exact (List.mem_append.mp hn).elim (hs n) (hr n)
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hs⟩
    exact derives_of_conclusion A t hs p ht

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAxiomClosure.endpoint_axiom_extension_incomplete
references.source:
theorem endpoint_axiom_extension_incomplete (i : Bool) (A : Set ℕ)
    (hA : REPred (· ∈ A))
    (hext : EnumerableCarriers.support (ForkSyntax.endpointTheory i ForkSyntax.categoricalTheory) ⊆
      theoremCodes A)
    (hc : ∀ p : Formula, ¬(Derives A p ∧ Derives A (.neg p))) :
    ∃ p : Formula, ¬Derives A p ∧ ¬Derives A (.neg p) := by
  have hcons : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ theoremCodes A → negCode n ∉ theoremCodes A := by
    intro n hn hneg
    exact hc (Formula.decode n) ⟨hn, by
      change Derives A (Formula.decode (negCode n)) at hneg
      rwa [ForkSyntax.decode_negCode] at hneg⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hneg⟩ := ForkSyntax.endpoint_ce_extension_incomplete i (theoremCodes A)
    (theoremCodes_re A hA) hext hcons
  refine ⟨Formula.decode n, hn, ?_⟩
  simpa only [theoremCodes, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ForkSyntax.decode_negCode] using hneg

    (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (polynomial N E Q))
    (f g : (Over.map b).obj (algebra N D P).a ⟶ B.a)
    (hf : (comparison N b h).app (algebra N D P).a ≫ (polynomial N E Q).map f ≫ B.str =
      (Over.map b).map (algebra N D P).str ≫ f)
    (hg : (comparison N b h).app (algebra N D P).a ≫ (polynomial N E Q).map g ≫ B.str =
      (Over.map b).map (algebra N D P).str ≫ g) : f = g :=
  LaxAlgebraAdjunction.unique (Over.mapPullbackAdj b) (comparison N b h)

theorem underlying_unique (N : C) {D E P Q : C} (b : P ⟶ Q) (h : D ⟶ E)
    (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (polynomial N E Q))
    (f g : (algebra N D P).a.left ⟶ B.a.left)
    (hfP : f ≫ B.a.hom = (algebra N D P).a.hom ≫ b)
    (hgP : g ≫ B.a.hom = (algebra N D P).a.hom ≫ b)
    (hf : (comparison N b h).app (algebra N D P).a ≫
      (polynomial N E Q).map (Over.homMk f hfP) ≫ B.str =
        (Over.map b).map (algebra N D P).str ≫ Over.homMk f hfP)
    (hg : (comparison N b h).app (algebra N D P).a ≫
      (polynomial N E Q).map (Over.homMk g hgP) ≫ B.str =
        (Over.map b).map (algebra N D P).str ≫ Over.homMk g hgP) : f = g :=
  congrArg Over.Hom.left (unique N b h B (Over.homMk f hfP) (Over.homMk g hgP) hf hg)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.LaxAlgebraAdjunction.fold_natural
references.source:
theorem fold_natural (A B : Endofunctor.Algebra F) (hA : IsInitial A)
    (A' B' : Endofunctor.Algebra G) (s : L.obj A.a ⟶ A'.a) (t : L.obj B.a ⟶ B'.a)
    (hs : θ.app A.a ≫ G.map s ≫ A'.str = L.map A.str ≫ s)
    (ht : θ.app B.a ≫ G.map t ≫ B'.str = L.map B.str ≫ t)
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A' ⟶ B') : s ≫ g.f = L.map f.f ≫ t := by
  apply unique adj θ A hA B'
  · rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, g.h]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun m => m ≫ g.f) hs
  · have hn : θ.app A.a ≫ G.map (L.map f.f) = L.map (F.map f.f) ≫ θ.app B.a :=
      (θ.naturality f.f).symm
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc (θ.app A.a) (G.map (L.map f.f)) _, hn,
      Category.assoc, ht, ← L.map_comp_assoc, f.h, L.map_comp, Category.assoc]

theorem fork_source_square (D P : Object) {j l : WalkingSpan} (f : j ⟶ l) :
    (ForkFormulaParameterChange.comparison (numbers.obj j) (P.map f) (D.map f)).app
        (constantFamily (P.obj j) (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j)).a) ≫
      (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.polynomial (numbers.obj l) (D.obj l) (P.obj l)).map
        (parameterMap (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (D.obj l) (P.obj j) (P.obj l) (P.map f)
          ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f)) ≫
      (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj l) (D.obj l) (P.obj l)).str =
    (Over.map (P.map f)).map
        (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).str ≫
      parameterMap (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (D.obj l) (P.obj j) (P.obj l) (P.map f)
        ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f) := by
  apply source_square (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (D.obj l) (P.obj j) (P.obj l)
    (P.map f) (D.map f) ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f)
  rw [base_input (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (D.obj l)
    (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j)).a
    (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj l)).a
    (D.map f) ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f)]
  have hn := (ForkFirstOrderFormula.transition (D.map f) (numbers.obj j)).naturality
    ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f)
  have hc := DiagramInitialAlgebras.transition_constructor
    (ForkFirstOrderFormula.polynomialDiagram D)
    (fun j => componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j))
    (fun j => componentInitial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j)) f
  calc
    _ = ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.polynomial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j)).map
        ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f) ≫
      (ForkFirstOrderFormula.transition (D.map f) (numbers.obj j)).app
        (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj l)).a) ≫
          (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj l)).str :=
      congrArg (fun m => m ≫ (componentAlgebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj l)).str) hn.symm
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc, ForkFirstOrderFormula.polynomialDiagram,
        ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra, DiagramInitialAlgebras.algebra,
        DiagramInitialAlgebras.carrier, numbers, Functor.const_obj_obj] using hc

references.source:
theorem fold_natural (B : Algebra D P) {j l : WalkingSpan} (f : j ⟶ l) :
    (parameterCarrierFunctor D P).map f ≫ (componentFold D P B l).f.left =
      (componentFold D P B j).f.left ≫ B.carrier.left.map f := by
  have h := LaxAlgebraAdjunction.fold_natural (Over.mapPullbackAdj (P.map f))
    (ForkFormulaParameterChange.comparison (numbers.obj j) (P.map f) (D.map f))
    (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j))
    (componentAlgebra D P B j)
    (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.initial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j))
    (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj l) (D.obj l) (P.obj l))
    (componentAlgebra D P B l)
    (ForkFormulaTransitionSquares.parameterMap (numbers.obj j)
      (D.obj j) (D.obj l) (P.obj j) (P.obj l) (P.map f)
      ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a.map f))
    (carrierTransition P B.carrier f)
    (ForkFormulaTransitionSquares.fork_source_square D P f) (B.naturality f)
    (componentFold D P B j) (componentFold D P B l)
  exact congrArg Over.Hom.left h

def parameterCarrierIso : parameterCarrier D P ≅
    constantFamily P (ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).a where
  hom := toConstant D P
  inv := fromConstant D P
  hom_inv_id := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext j
    apply prod.hom_ext
    · change ((prod.lift (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P)).app j ≫
        (fromConstantLeft D P).app j) ≫ prod.fst = (𝟙 _ : _ ⟶ _) ≫ prod.fst
      rw [Category.assoc, fromConstantLeft, prod.lift_fst, Category.id_comp]
      exact congrArg (fun m => m.app j) (prod.lift_fst (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P))
    · change ((prod.lift (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P)).app j ≫
        (fromConstantLeft D P).app j) ≫ prod.snd = (𝟙 _ : _ ⟶ _) ≫ prod.snd
      rw [Category.assoc, fromConstantLeft, prod.lift_snd, Category.id_comp]
      exact congrArg (fun m => m.app j) (prod.lift_snd (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P))
  inv_hom_id := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply prod.hom_ext
    · change fromConstantLeft D P ≫ prod.lift (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P) ≫
        prod.fst = 𝟙 _ ≫ prod.fst
      rw [prod.lift_fst, Category.id_comp]
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext j
      exact prod.lift_fst _ _
    · change fromConstantLeft D P ≫ prod.lift (parameterProjection D P) (formulaProjection D P) ≫
        prod.snd = 𝟙 _ ≫ prod.snd
      rw [prod.lift_snd, Category.id_comp]
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext j
      exact prod.lift_snd _ _

def syntaxData (V : J ⥤ C) (σ π : ℕ → J ⥤ C) (d : ℕ) :
    Σ A : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
      (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)),
      IsInitial A := by
  let r := SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d
  let s := SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d
  have h : (Σ A : Endofunctor.Algebra (polynomial id r s), IsInitial A) :=
    ⟨algebra id r s, initial id r s⟩
  have he : polynomial id r s = SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor r s := by
    unfold polynomial
    rw [SyntaxPolynomial.mapCoefficients_id r, SyntaxPolynomial.mapCoefficients_id s]
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

def jointIso (p q : SyntaxPolynomial I) (j : J) :

        (q.mapCoefficients (globalCoefficients c P)) ⋙
        (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j).prod (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j) ≅
      ((SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j).prod (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j)) ⋙
        SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor (p.mapCoefficients (localCoefficients c P j))
          (q.mapCoefficients (localCoefficients c P j)) :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => Iso.prod (asIso (component c P p X j))
    (asIso (component c P q X j))) (by
      intro X Y m
      exact Prod.ext
        (LaxPolynomialComparison.naturality (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j)
          (fun i => (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (c i) j).hom) p m)
        (LaxPolynomialComparison.naturality (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j)
          (fun i => (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (c i) j).hom) q m))

theorem transition_square (p : SyntaxPolynomial I) (X : Over P × Over P)
    {j k : J} (f : j ⟶ k) :
    SliceEvaluation.transition P ((p.mapCoefficients (globalCoefficients c P)).eval.obj X) f ≫
        component c P p X k =
      (Over.map (P.map f)).map (component c P p X j) ≫ input c P p X f :=
  LaxPolynomialComparison.natural_square (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j)
    (fun i => (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (c i) j).hom)
    (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P k) (Over.map (P.map f))
    (fun i => (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (c i) k).hom)
    (fun i => SliceEvaluation.coefficientTransition P (c i) f)
    (Over.postMap (X := P) ((evaluation J C).map f))
    (fun i => SliceEvaluation.coefficient_square P (c i) f) p X

references.source:
theorem operation_square (p : SyntaxPolynomial I) (X : Over P × Over P) (Y : Over P)
    (r : (p.mapCoefficients (globalCoefficients c P)).eval.obj X ⟶ Y)
    {j k : J} (f : j ⟶ k) :
    input c P p X f ≫ operation c P p X Y r k =
      (Over.map (P.map f)).map (operation c P p X Y r j) ≫ SliceEvaluation.transition P Y f := by
  apply (cancel_epi ((Over.map (P.map f)).map (component c P p X j))).mp
  dsimp only [operation]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← transition_square c P p X f,
    Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_inv, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact ((Over.postMap (X := P) ((evaluation J C).map f)).naturality r).symm

CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkCanonicalFormulaSource.source_square
references.source:
theorem source_square (j : WalkingSpan) :
    (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j).map (algebra D P).str ≫
        (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (carrier D) j).hom =
      SlicePolynomialComparison.component (coefficients D) P template
          (ForkCanonicalParameterTargets.carriers D P (algebra D P)) j ≫
        (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.polynomial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).map
          (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (carrier D) j).hom ≫
        (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).str := by
  rw [parameter_structure, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    SliceParameterConstructorComparison.coefficient_natural P (constructor D) j,
    ← Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P
      ((template.mapCoefficients (coefficients D)).eval.obj (baseCarriers D)) j).hom ≫
    (constantFamilyFunctor (P.obj j)).map
      (DiagramPolynomialComparison.component (coefficients D) (baseCarriers D) template j ≫
        (ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).str.app j) = _
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  have h := congrArg (fun m => m ≫ (constantFamilyFunctor (P.obj j)).map
      ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).str.app j))
    (SliceParameterConstructorComparison.comparison_square (coefficients D) P
      (baseCarriers D) template j)
  have hι : SliceParameterConstructorComparison.relativeInput (coefficients D) P
      (baseCarriers D) template j =
      SlicePolynomialComparison.component (coefficients D) P template
          (ForkCanonicalParameterTargets.carriers D P (algebra D P)) j ≫
        (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.polynomial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).map
          (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (carrier D) j).hom := rfl
  have hκ : (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).str =
      PolynomialParameterValues.comparison (P.obj j) (fun i => (coefficients D i).obj j)
          ((baseCarriers D).1.obj j, (baseCarriers D).2.obj j) template ≫
        (constantFamilyFunctor (P.obj j)).map ((ForkFirstOrderFormula.algebra D).str.app j) := rfl
  rw [hι] at h
  rw [hκ]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

theorem source_hom (j : WalkingSpan) :
    (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.polynomial (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).map
        (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (carrier D) j).hom ≫
      (ForkFormulaParameterComponents.algebra (numbers.obj j) (D.obj j) (P.obj j)).str =
    (ForkCanonicalParameterTargets.target D P (algebra D P)).str j ≫
      (SliceEvaluation.coefficientIso P (carrier D) j).hom := by
  change _ = (inv (SlicePolynomialComparison.component (coefficients D) P template
      (ForkCanonicalParameterTargets.carriers D P (algebra D P)) j) ≫
    (SliceEvaluation.componentFunctor P j).map (algebra D P).str) ≫ _
  rw [Category.assoc, source_square, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.LabelledParameterAlgebras.comparison_data
references.source:
theorem comparison_data (p : SyntaxPolynomial I) :
    (⟨(p.mapCoefficients c).withParameters P,
      SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison P X (p.mapCoefficients c)⟩ :
      Σ r : SyntaxPolynomial (Over P), r.eval.obj (constantFamily P X.1, constantFamily P X.2) ⟶
        constantFamily P ((p.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X)) =
      ⟨p.mapCoefficients (fun i => constantFamily P (c i)),
        PolynomialParameterValues.comparison P c X p⟩ := by
  induction p with
  | term => rfl
  | formula => rfl
  | coefficient => rfl
  | unit => rfl
  | product p q hp hq =>
      exact congrArg₂ (fun a b =>
        (⟨.product a.1 b.1, prod.map a.2 b.2 ≫ constantProductComparison P
          ((p.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X) ((q.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X)⟩ :
          Σ r : SyntaxPolynomial (Over P), r.eval.obj (constantFamily P X.1, constantFamily P X.2) ⟶
            constantFamily P (((p.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X) ⨯ ((q.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X)))) hp hq
  | sum p q hp hq =>
      exact congrArg₂ (fun a b =>
        (⟨.sum a.1 b.1, coprod.map a.2 b.2 ≫ constantCoproductComparison P
          ((p.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X) ((q.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X)⟩ :
          Σ r : SyntaxPolynomial (Over P), r.eval.obj (constantFamily P X.1, constantFamily P X.2) ⟶
            constantFamily P (((p.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X) ⨿ ((q.mapCoefficients c).eval.obj X)))) hp hq

references.source:
theorem algebra_data :
    (⟨_, SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters (p.mapCoefficients c) (q.mapCoefficients c) A P⟩ :
      Σ F : (Over P × Over P) ⥤ (Over P × Over P), Endofunctor.Algebra F) =
      ⟨_, algebra c P p q A⟩ := by
  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b =>
    (⟨SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor a.1 b.1,
      ⟨(constantFamily P A.a.1, constantFamily P A.a.2),
        (a.2 ≫ (constantFamilyFunctor P).map A.str.1,
          b.2 ≫ (constantFamilyFunctor P).map A.str.2)⟩⟩ :
      Σ F : (Over P × Over P) ⥤ (Over P × Over P), Endofunctor.Algebra F))
    (comparison_data c P A.a p) (comparison_data c P A.a q)

references.source:
theorem fold_natural (B : Endofunctor.Algebra (polynomial c P p q))
    {j k : J} (f : j ⟶ k) :
    transition P A.a f ≫ (foldComponent c P p q A hA B k).f =
      ((Over.map (P.map f)).prod (Over.map (P.map f))).map
        (foldComponent c P p q A hA B j).f ≫ transition P B.a f :=
  LaxAlgebraAdjunction.fold_natural (ProductAdjunction.square (Over.mapPullbackAdj (P.map f)))
    (comparison c P p q f) (component c P p q A j) (component c P p q B j) (hA j)
    (component c P p q A k) (component c P p q B k) (transition P A.a f) (transition P B.a f)
    (transition_constructor c P p q A f) (transition_constructor c P p q B f)
    (foldComponent c P p q A hA B j) (foldComponent c P p q A hA B k)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SliceAlgebraInitiality.initial
references.source:
def initial : IsInitial A :=
  IsInitial.ofUniqueHom (fold c P p q A hA) (by
    intro B m
    have h (j : J) : (evaluation P j).map m.f = (foldComponent c P p q A hA B j).f :=
      congrArg Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.f ((hA j).hom_ext
        (⟨(evaluation P j).map m.f,
          (AlgebraEvaluation.hom_condition_iff (evaluation P j)
            (SlicePolynomialComparison.jointIso c P p q j) A B m.f).mpr
              (congrArg (evaluation P j).map m.h)⟩ :
          component c P p q A j ⟶ component c P p q B j) _)
    apply Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      exact NatTrans.ext (funext (fun j => congrArg (fun n => n.1.left) (h j)))
    · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      exact NatTrans.ext (funext (fun j => congrArg (fun n => n.2.left) (h j))))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.NumericalDiagramParameterStability.data
references.source:
def data (r s : SyntaxPolynomial (J ⥤ C)) :
    Σ A : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor r s),
      IsInitial A × (∀ P : J ⥤ C, IsInitial (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters r s A P)) := by
  let S := fun a b : SyntaxPolynomial (J ⥤ C) =>
    Σ A : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor a b),
      IsInitial A × (∀ P : J ⥤ C, IsInitial (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters a b A P))
  have h : S (r.mapCoefficients id) (s.mapCoefficients id) :=
    ⟨algebra id r s, NumericalCanonicalDiagramSyntax.initial id r s, stable id r s⟩
  exact Eq.mp (congrArg₂ S (SyntaxPolynomial.mapCoefficients_id r)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.mapCoefficients_id s)) h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForwardRuleRelabelling.comparison
references.source:
def comparison : R.inference ⋙ Over.map χ.base ⟶ Over.map χ.base ⋙ S.inference where
  app Q := Over.homMk (input χ Q ((Over.map χ.base).obj Q) (𝟙 _) (by simp))
    (input_conclusion χ Q ((Over.map χ.base).obj Q) (𝟙 _) (by simp))
  naturality {Q Q'} f := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Limits.Sigma.map (R.ruleMap f) ≫
      Limits.Sigma.map (branch χ Q' ((Over.map χ.base).obj Q') (𝟙 _) _) =
      Limits.Sigma.map (branch χ Q ((Over.map χ.base).obj Q) (𝟙 _) _) ≫
        Limits.Sigma.map (S.ruleMap ((Over.map χ.base).map f))
    rw [Limits.Sigma.map_comp_map, Limits.Sigma.map_comp_map]
    congr 1
    funext i
    apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp [branch, base, RulePresentation.Translation.mapRule,
      RulePresentation.ruleMap, Category.assoc]

theorem fold_constructor : input χ A.a B.a (fold χ A hA B).left (Over.w _) ≫ B.str.left =
    A.str.left ≫ (fold χ A hA B).left := by
  have h := congrArg Over.Hom.left
    (LaxAlgebraAdjunction.fold_constructor (Over.mapPullbackAdj χ.base) (comparison χ) A hA B)
  change ((comparison χ).app A.a).left ≫ (S.inference.map (fold χ A hA B)).left ≫
    B.str.left = A.str.left ≫ (fold χ A hA B).left at h
  rw [← Category.assoc, input_factor_hom] at h
  exact h

include hA in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForwardRuleRelabelling.unique
references.source:
theorem unique (m n : A.a.left ⟶ B.a.left)
    (hm : m ≫ B.a.hom = A.a.hom ≫ χ.base) (hn : n ≫ B.a.hom = A.a.hom ≫ χ.base)
    (hc : input χ A.a B.a m hm ≫ B.str.left = A.str.left ≫ m)
    (hd : input χ A.a B.a n hn ≫ B.str.left = A.str.left ≫ n) : m = n := by
  apply congrArg Over.Hom.left
    (LaxAlgebraAdjunction.unique (Over.mapPullbackAdj χ.base) (comparison χ) A hA B
      (Over.homMk m hm) (Over.homMk n hn) ?_ ?_)
  · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change ((comparison χ).app A.a).left ≫ (S.inference.map (Over.homMk m hm)).left ≫
      B.str.left = A.str.left ≫ m
    rw [← Category.assoc, input_factor]
    exact hc
  · apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change ((comparison χ).app A.a).left ≫ (S.inference.map (Over.homMk n hn)).left ≫
      B.str.left = A.str.left ≫ n
    rw [← Category.assoc, input_factor]
    exact hd

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.FiniteInferenceEvaluation.comparison
references.source:
def comparison : R.inference ⋙ Over.post K ≅ Over.post K ⋙ (mappedRules K R).inference :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (overIso K R) (by
    intro Q Q' f
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change K.map (Limits.Sigma.map (R.ruleMap f)) ≫ (sumIso K R Q').hom =
      (sumIso K R Q).hom ≫ Limits.Sigma.map ((mappedRules K R).ruleMap ((Over.post K).map f))
    apply mapSum_hom_ext K (R.ruleObject Q)
    intro i
    rw [← K.map_comp_assoc, Sigma.ι_map, K.map_comp_assoc, sumIso_iota_assoc,
      sumIso_iota, ← Category.assoc, branch_natural, Category.assoc]
    simp only [Sigma.ι_map])

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.FiniteInferenceEvaluation.sum_transformation
references.source:
theorem sum_transformation (Q : Over F) :
    α.app (R.inference.obj Q).left ≫ (sumIso L R Q).hom =
      (sumIso K R Q).hom ≫
        (relabelling K R L α).input ((Over.post K).obj Q) ((Over.post L).obj Q)
          (α.app Q.left) (α.naturality Q.hom).symm := by
  apply mapSum_hom_ext K (R.ruleObject Q)
  intro i
  erw [← Category.assoc, α.naturality (Sigma.ι (R.ruleObject Q) i), Category.assoc, sumIso_iota,
    ← Category.assoc, branch_transformation, Category.assoc,
    ← ForwardRuleRelabelling.input_iota]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  erw [sumIso_iota]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra_transformation
references.source:
theorem algebra_transformation (B : Endofunctor.Algebra R.inference) :
    (relabelling K R L α).input (algebra K R B).a (algebra L R B).a
        (α.app B.a.left) (α.naturality B.a.hom).symm ≫ (algebra L R B).str.left =
      (algebra K R B).str.left ≫ α.app B.a.left := by
  rw [algebra_str, algebra_str]
  change (relabelling K R L α).input ((Over.post K).obj B.a) ((Over.post L).obj B.a)
      (α.app B.a.left) (α.naturality B.a.hom).symm ≫
      ((sumIso L R B.a).inv ≫ L.map B.str.left) =
    ((sumIso K R B.a).inv ≫ K.map B.str.left) ≫ α.app B.a.left
  apply (cancel_epi (sumIso K R B.a).hom).mp
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← sum_transformation, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact (α.naturality B.str.left).symm

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.InitialRuleDiagrams.sourceIso
references.source:
def sourceIso (j : J) : FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra (evaluation j) R (algebra R A hA) ≅ A j :=
  Endofunctor.Algebra.isoMk (Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (by simp; rfl)) (by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    rw [Over.comp_left, Over.comp_left, FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra_str]
    change (Limits.Sigma.map ((rules R j).ruleMap
      (Over.homMk (𝟙 _) (by exact Category.id_comp _)))) ≫ (A j).str.left =
      ((FiniteInferenceEvaluation.sumIso (evaluation j) R (source R A hA)).inv ≫
        ((FiniteInferenceEvaluation.sumIso (evaluation j) R (source R A hA)).hom ≫
          (A j).str.left)) ≫ 𝟙 _
    simp only [Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    have hb (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
        (rules R j).ruleMap (Over.homMk (𝟙 _) (by exact Category.id_comp _) :
          (Over.post (evaluation j)).obj (source R A hA) ⟶ (A j).a) i =
          𝟙 ((rules R j).ruleObject (A j).a i) := by
      apply pullback.hom_ext
      · erw [RulePresentation.ruleMap_fst, Category.id_comp]
        rfl
      · erw [RulePresentation.ruleMap_snd]
        change (pullback.snd ((rules R j).premises i) (finitePowerMap (A j).a.hom i.val)) ≫
          finitePowerMap (𝟙 (A j).a.left) i.val = 𝟙 _ ≫
            pullback.snd ((rules R j).premises i) (finitePowerMap (A j).a.hom i.val)
        rw [finitePowerMap_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    have hs : Limits.Sigma.map ((rules R j).ruleMap
        (Over.homMk (𝟙 _) (by exact Category.id_comp _) :
          (Over.post (evaluation j)).obj (source R A hA) ⟶ (A j).a)) =
          𝟙 (∐ (rules R j).ruleObject (A j).a) := by
      apply Sigma.hom_ext
      intro i
      erw [Sigma.ι_map, hb, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
      rfl
    erw [hs, Category.id_comp])

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.InitialRuleDiagrams.initial

    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext j
    exact congrArg (fun n => n.f.left) ((componentInitial R A hA j).hom_ext
      (⟨(Over.post (evaluation j)).map m.f,
        (AlgebraEvaluation.hom_condition_iff (Over.post (evaluation j))
          (FiniteInferenceEvaluation.comparison (evaluation j) R) (algebra R A hA) B m.f).mpr
            (congrArg (Over.post (evaluation j)).map m.h)⟩ :
          FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra (evaluation j) R (algebra R A hA) ⟶
            FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra (evaluation j) R B)
      (⟨(Over.post (evaluation j)).map (fold R A hA B).f,
        (AlgebraEvaluation.hom_condition_iff (Over.post (evaluation j))
          (FiniteInferenceEvaluation.comparison (evaluation j) R) (algebra R A hA) B _).mpr
            (congrArg (Over.post (evaluation j)).map (fold R A hA B).h)⟩ :
          FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra (evaluation j) R (algebra R A hA) ⟶
            FiniteInferenceEvaluation.algebra (evaluation j) R B)))

prop:fork-first-order-conservative.label: prop:fork-first-order-conservative
prop:fork-first-order-conservative.reconstruction: Choose global distinguished atom and tautology top=p⇒p. Erase equality to top and ∀ to its body, preserving other constructors. This natural map retracts j after sentence inclusion and is invariant under admissible substitution. Claim conservativity, consistency, internal and endpoint incompleteness.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkErasureClosure.closed
references.source:
theorem closed : ClosedUnder ((S).logicalRules (axiomImage a b).arrow).inference
    (erasedTheory a b).arrow := by
  apply RuleClosureFactors.firstOrder_closed
  · let T := erasedTheory a b
    have hl : T.Factors (S).logicalAxioms := pullback_factors erase _ _
      ((Subobject.factors_iff _ _).mpr (ForkErasedSchemeProofs.image_factor a b))
    have hn := (pullback_factors_iff (S).sentenceInclusion T _).mp
      (Subobject.factors_of_le _ (signed_le a b) (Subobject.factors_self _))
    change T.Factors _
    apply (Subobject.factors_iff _ _).mpr
    exact ⟨coprod.desc (T.factorThru _ hl) (T.factorThru _ hn), by
      simp [coprod.desc_comp]⟩
  · exact generalization a b
  · exact modus_ponens a b

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkErasureClosure.formula_le
references.source:
theorem formula_le : formulaTheory a b ≤ (Subobject.pullback erase).obj (propTheory a b) := by
  let Q := proofFamily (axiomImage a b)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ((S).logicalRules (axiomImage a b).arrow).least_theorem_subobject Q
    (ForkParameterizedDeduction.nullaryPresentations.initial labels _) |>.2
      (erasedTheory a b).arrow (closed a b)
  change imageSubobject Q.a.hom ≤ erasedTheory a b
  exact imageSubobject_le Q.a.hom (factorThruImage _ ≫ w) (by rw [Category.assoc, hw, image.fac])

  apply SignedFirstOrder.essential_incomplete_of_subobject_inseparable _ _ _ inseparable
  change theory.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj theory.val = ⊥

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkEndpointSentences.extension_incomplete
references.source:
theorem extension_incomplete (i : Bool) (U : Set ℕ) (hu : REPred (· ∈ U))
    (he : ∀ x ∈ theorems i, NumericalTuples.code _ x.val ∈ U)
    (hc : ∀ x : Point (carrier i), NumericalTuples.code _ x.val ∈ U →
      NumericalTuples.code _ ((neg i).toFun x).val ∉ U) :
    ∃ x : Point (carrier i), NumericalTuples.code _ x.val ∉ U ∧
      NumericalTuples.code _ ((neg i).toFun x).val ∉ U := by
  let P : Set ℕ := (embeddedCode i) ⁻¹' U
  have hp : REPred (· ∈ P) := hu.comp (embeddedCode_computable i)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hneg⟩ := ForkSyntax.endpoint_ce_extension_incomplete i P hp
    (fun n hn => he _ (old_theorem i n hn)) (by
      intro n h
      change NumericalTuples.code _ (embedded i (ForkSyntax.negCode n)).val ∉ U
      rw [embedded_neg]
      exact hc _ h)
  refine ⟨embedded i n, hn, ?_⟩
  rw [← embedded_neg]
  exact hneg

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkFirstOrderApplication.endpoint
references.source:
theorem endpoint (he : theorems i ⊆ closureSet i Γ hΓ)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ closureSet i Γ hΓ, (neg i).toFun x ∉ closureSet i Γ hΓ) :
    ∃ x : Point (carrier i), x ∉ closureSet i Γ hΓ ∧ (neg i).toFun x ∉ closureSet i Γ hΓ := by
  let c := localConclusion i Γ hΓ
  obtain ⟨x, h, hn⟩ := extension_incomplete i (codes c) (closure_codes_re i Γ hΓ)
    (fun x hx => (mem_codes c x).mpr (he hx))
    (fun x hx hn => hc x ((mem_codes c x).mp hx) ((mem_codes c _).mp hn))
  exact ⟨x, fun hx => h ((mem_codes c x).mpr hx), fun hx => hn ((mem_codes c _).mpr hx)⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkFirstOrderApplication.printed_statement
references.source:
theorem printed_statement :
    (sentenceTheory A B ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj (sentenceTheory A B) = ⊥) ∧
    (∀ U : FirstOrderReflection.Theory proofFamily, sentenceTheory A B ≤ U.val →
      U.val ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj U.val = ⊥ →
        U.val ⊔ (Subobject.pullback (S).sentenceNegation).obj U.val ≠ ⊤) ∧
    (Subobject.pullback ForkPropositionalEmbedding.embedding).obj (sentenceTheory A B) =
      Subobject.mk (ForkDerivationImages.LiteralDiagram.theoremInclusion A B) ∧
    ∀ (k : Bool) (Δ : Set (Tuple (carrier k).dimension)) (hΔ : REPred (· ∈ Δ)),
      theorems k ⊆ closureSet k Δ hΔ →
      (∀ x ∈ closureSet k Δ hΔ, (neg k).toFun x ∉ closureSet k Δ hΔ) →
      ∃ x : Point (carrier k), x ∉ closureSet k Δ hΔ ∧ (neg k).toFun x ∉ closureSet k Δ hΔ := by
  refine ⟨ForkInternalIncompleteness.consistent A B EffectiveFork.Recursion.image_pair_inseparable_v46.disjoint,
    ?_, ForkConservativeRestriction.restriction_to_domain A B, endpoint⟩
  intro U he hc
  rw [ForkInternalIncompleteness.signed_theory] at he
  exact ForkInternalIncompleteness.essentially_incomplete.2 U he hc

cor:fork-associated-theories.label: cor:fork-associated-theories
cor:fork-associated-theories.reconstruction: Any consistent enlargement gives Turing partial slices, full faithfulness/properness of postcomposition, essential incompleteness and inseparability of the constant theory. The common global theorem j(top) provides the evaluation point and transports any slice separator back.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedCategories.printedStatement
references.source:
def printedStatement (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation U.val = ⊥) : Application U i where
  source := turing _
  target := turing _
  full := MonicPartialSliceComparison.full i
  faithful := MonicPartialSliceComparison.faithful i
  proper := MonicPartialSliceComparison.proper i
  essential := essentially_incomplete U (extension U i hi) hc
  inseparable := domains_inseparable U (extension U i hi) hc

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedCategories.turing
references.source:
def turing (P : Object) : CompatibleSplitSlices.TuringData (PartialMaps.Par (Over P)) :=
  sliceTuring restriction_eq ForkInternalIncompleteness.inverses equivalence.symm P
    EffectiveFork.V EffectiveFork.tau EffectiveFork.tau_isTuring (fun X => by
      obtain ⟨j, s, hj, hjs, _⟩ := EffectiveFork.dominance X
      exact ⟨j, s, hj, hjs⟩)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedCategories.boolean_obstruction
references.source:
theorem boolean_obstruction (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation U.val = ⊥) :
    let a := theoremDomain U
    let b := (Subobject.pullback (ForkAssociatedTheories.negation U)).obj a
    ∃ hd : a ⊓ b = ⊥,
      rst (decision U hd) = (domain MonicPartialSliceComparison.inverses (a ⊔ b)).hom ∧
      a.arrow.hom ≫ decision U hd =
        (Two.constant (a : PartialMaps.Tot (Over (U.val : Object))) true).hom ∧
      b.arrow.hom ≫ decision U hd =
        (Two.constant (b : PartialMaps.Tot (Over (U.val : Object))) false).hom ∧
      ¬ RestrictionRetraction.HasTotalExtension (decision U hd) := by
  have h := domains_inseparable U (extension U i hi) hc
  let m : MonoInverses (PartialMaps.Par (Over (U.val : Object))) :=
    MonicPartialSliceComparison.inverses
  exact ⟨h.1, BooleanPartialDecision.domain_eq m _ _ h.1,
    BooleanPartialDecision.positive_value m _ _ h.1,
    BooleanPartialDecision.negative_value m _ _ h.1,
    (BooleanPartialDecision.inseparable_iff_noTotalExtension m _ _ h.1).mp h⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedTheories.point_value
references.source:
theorem point_value : point U hExt ≫ U.val.arrow = truth ≫ embedding :=
  U.val.factorThru_arrow _ _

include hExt in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedTheories.essentially_incomplete
references.source:
theorem essentially_incomplete (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation U.val = ⊥) :
    AssociatedClosedTheories.EssentiallyIncomplete presentation (U.val : Object)
      (sliceProofs _) (constantTheory U) := by
  apply (AssociatedClosedTheories.essential_incomplete_iff presentation (U.val : Object)
    (sliceProofs _) (ForkParameterizedDeduction.initial labels _)
    (point U hExt) terminalIsTerminal U hc).mp
  exact AssociatedCategory.essential_incomplete_of_reduction presentation _ _
    ForkInternalIncompleteness.inseparable (NullaryInterpretation.atomSentence firstOrder) base
    (ForkInternalIncompleteness.atomic_bounds A B).1
    (ForkInternalIncompleteness.atomic_bounds A B).2 U hExt hc

include hExt in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedTheories.domains_inseparable
references.source:
theorem domains_inseparable (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation U.val = ⊥) :
    SubobjectInseparable (theoremDomain U)
      ((Subobject.pullback (negation U)).obj (theoremDomain U)) := by
  have h := SliceInseparability.PartialTotals.inseparable (Over (U.val : Object))
    _ _ (slice_domains U hExt hc)
  rw [FiniteLimitSubobjects.object_pullback] at h
  exact h

include hExt in

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkAssociatedTheories.actual_incompleteness
references.source:
theorem actual_incompleteness (hc : U.val ⊓ refutation U.val = ⊥) :
    (theoremDomain U ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (negation U)).obj (theoremDomain U) = ⊥) ∧
    ∀ W : Subobject ((PartialMaps.totalEquivalence (D := Over (U.val : Object))).functor.obj
        (constantFamily (U.val : Object) firstOrder.sentenceObject)),
      theoremDomain U ≤ W → W ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (negation U)).obj W = ⊥ →
        W ⊔ (Subobject.pullback (negation U)).obj W ≠ ⊤ := by
  have hi := domains_inseparable U hExt hc
  exact ⟨hi.1, fun W hW hcW => SliceInseparability.noncoverage (negation U) _ hi W hW hcW⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.MonicPartialSliceComparison.postcompose
references.source: def postcompose : Par (Over T) ⥤ Par (Over U) := inducedFunctor (Over.map i)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.MonicPartialSliceComparison.full
references.source:
theorem full : (postcompose i).Full where
  map_surjective {X Y} f := by
    induction f using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ s =>
      refine ⟨ofSpan (liftSpan i s), ofSpan_eq_of_iso ?_⟩
      let z : (rawMap (Over.map i) (liftSpan i s)).apex ≅ s.apex :=
        Over.isoMk (Iso.refl s.apex.left) (by
          change 𝟙 _ ≫ s.apex.hom = (s.l.left ≫ X.obj.hom) ≫ i
          rw [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc]
          exact (Over.w s.l).symm)
      exact CategoryTheory.Span.mkIso z
        (Over.OverMorphism.ext (Category.id_comp s.l.left))
        (Over.OverMorphism.ext (Category.id_comp s.r.left))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.MonicPartialSliceComparison.faithful
references.source:
theorem faithful : (postcompose i).Faithful where
  map_injective {X Y} f g h := by
    induction f using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ s =>
      induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ t =>
        obtain ⟨e⟩ := (ofSpan_eq_iff (rawMap (Over.map i) s) (rawMap (Over.map i) t)).mp h
        let z := CategoryTheory.Span.SpanBicat.apexIso e
        have hl : z.hom.left ≫ t.l.left = s.l.left := congrArg (fun m => m.left) e.hom.hom_l
        have hr : z.hom.left ≫ t.r.left = s.r.left := congrArg (fun m => m.left) e.hom.hom_r
        have hw : z.hom.left ≫ t.apex.hom = s.apex.hom := by
          rw [← Over.w t.l, ← Category.assoc, hl, Over.w s.l]
        apply ofSpan_eq_of_iso
        exact CategoryTheory.Span.mkIso (Over.isoMk ((Over.forget U).mapIso z) hw)
          (Over.OverMorphism.ext hl) (Over.OverMorphism.ext hr)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.MonicPartialSliceComparison.proper
references.source:
theorem proper (h : ¬ IsIso i) : ¬ (postcompose i).EssSurj := by
  intro surj
  let := surj
  let Z : Par (Over U) := ⟨Over.mk (𝟙 U)⟩
  let X := (postcompose i).objPreimage Z
  let e := (postcompose i).objObjPreimageIso Z
  let k := totalValue e.inv (iso_total e.symm)
  have hk : (k.left ≫ X.obj.hom) ≫ i = 𝟙 U := by
    rw [Category.assoc]
    exact Over.w k
  apply h
  exact ⟨⟨k.left ≫ X.obj.hom, (cancel_mono i).mp (by simp [Category.assoc, hk]), hk⟩⟩

def:categorical-syntax.label: def:categorical-syntax
def:categorical-syntax.reconstruction: Definition of named-variable syntax requires an initial two-sorted K-algebra stable under parameters and a parameter-stable initial list algebra 1+V×−.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax
references.source:
structure CategoricalSyntax (V : D) (σ π : ℕ → D) (d : ℕ) where
  decidableVariables : DecidableVariables V
  algebra : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d))
  initial : IsInitial algebra
  stable : ∀ P : D, IsInitial (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)
      algebra P)
  lists : StableListAlgebra V

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.DecidableVariables
references.source:
structure DecidableVariables (V : D) where
  test : V ⨯ V ⟶ (⊤_ D) ⨿ (⊤_ D)
  diagonal : IsPullback (prod.lift (𝟙 V) (𝟙 V)) (terminal.from V) test coprod.inr

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
references.source:
def jointFunctor (p q : SyntaxPolynomial D) : D × D ⥤ D × D :=
  p.eval.prod' q.eval

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression
references.source:
def termExpression (V : D) (σ : ℕ → D) (d : ℕ) : SyntaxPolynomial D :=
  .sum (.coefficient V) (constructors σ d)

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.StableListAlgebra
references.source:
structure StableListAlgebra (V : D) where
  algebra : ListAlgebra V
  initial : IsInitial algebra.asAlgebra
  stable : ∀ P : D, IsInitial (algebra.withParameters P).asAlgebra

def:sentence-object.label: def:sentence-object
def:sentence-object.reconstruction: Sentences are pullback of nil under FV_Fm. Negation restricts by its FV equation; existential quantifier is defined by ¬∀¬.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.occurrenceAlgebra
references.source:
def occurrenceAlgebra : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
    (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)) where
  a := (S.lists.algebra.carrier, S.lists.algebra.carrier)
  str :=
    (coprod.desc S.lists.singleton (S.lists.constructorOccurrences σ d),
      coprod.desc
        (coprod.desc
          (coprod.desc (coprod.desc S.lists.append (S.lists.constructorOccurrences π d))
            (𝟙 S.lists.algebra.carrier))
          S.lists.append)
        (S.lists.deletion S.decidableVariables))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.termOccurrences
references.source:
def termOccurrences : S.algebra.a.1 ⟶ S.lists.algebra.carrier :=
  (S.fold S.occurrenceAlgebra).1

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.formulaOccurrences
references.source:
def formulaOccurrences : S.algebra.a.2 ⟶ S.lists.algebra.carrier :=
  (S.fold S.occurrenceAlgebra).2

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.sentenceObject
references.source: def sentenceObject : D := pullback S.formulaOccurrences S.lists.algebra.nil

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.sentenceInclusion
references.source: def sentenceInclusion : S.sentenceObject ⟶ S.algebra.a.2 := pullback.fst _ _

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.sentenceNegation
references.source:
def sentenceNegation : S.sentenceObject ⟶ S.sentenceObject :=
  pullback.lift (S.sentenceInclusion ≫ S.negationConstructor)
    (pullback.snd S.formulaOccurrences S.lists.algebra.nil) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, S.negation_occurrences]
      exact pullback.condition)

prop:categorical-substitution.label: prop:categorical-substitution
prop:categorical-substitution.reconstruction: Initiality gives unique total term substitution and optional formula substitution. Original coordinates form algebra endomorphism of initial object, so are identities. Pull back success for result and a complemented Adm mono.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.substitutionAlgebra
references.source:
def substitutionAlgebra : Endofunctor.Algebra (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
    ((SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d).withParameters S.substitutionParameters)
    ((SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d).withParameters S.substitutionParameters)) where
  a := (constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers.1,
    constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers.2)
  str :=
    (coprod.desc (parameterHom S.variableSubstitutionPair)
      (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers
        (SyntaxPolynomial.constructors σ d) ≫
          (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.functionSubstitutionPair),
      coprod.desc
        (coprod.desc
          (coprod.desc
            (coprod.desc
              (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers
                (SyntaxPolynomial.power .term 2) ≫
                  (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.equalitySubstitutionPair)
              (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers
                (SyntaxPolynomial.constructors π d) ≫
                  (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.relationSubstitutionPair))
            ((constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.negationSubstitutionPair))
          (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers
            (SyntaxPolynomial.power .formula 2) ≫
              (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.implicationSubstitutionPair))
        (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.substitutionCarriers
          (.product (.coefficient V) .formula) ≫ parameterHom S.quantifierSubstitutionPair))

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.substitutionOriginalHom
references.source:
def substitutionOriginalHom : S.substitutionAlgebra ⟶
    SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
      (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d) S.algebra S.substitutionParameters where
  f := ((constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst,
    (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst)
  h := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · change ((SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d).withParameters
          S.substitutionParameters).eval.map
          ((constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst,
            (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst) ≫
          (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a
            (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d) ≫
              (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.algebra.str.1) =
          S.substitutionAlgebra.str.1 ≫
            (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst
      have hn := SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison_natural S.substitutionParameters
        S.originalProjection (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
      dsimp only [originalProjection] at hn
      dsimp only [substitutionAlgebra]
      rw [← Category.assoc, hn]
      apply coprod.hom_ext
      · simpa [SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression, SyntaxPolynomial.eval,
          SyntaxPolynomial.sumFunctor, substitutionAlgebra, SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters,
          SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison, constantCoproductComparison,
          originalProjection, variableConstructor, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc,
          ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using
            S.variableSubstitution_original.symm
      · simp [SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression, SyntaxPolynomial.eval,
          SyntaxPolynomial.sumFunctor,
          SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison_inr_assoc,
          originalProjection, functionSubstitutionPair, functionConstructors,
          ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    · change ((SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d).withParameters
          S.substitutionParameters).eval.map
          ((constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst,
            (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst) ≫
          (SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a
            (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d) ≫
              (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map S.algebra.str.2) =
          S.substitutionAlgebra.str.2 ≫
            (constantFamilyFunctor S.substitutionParameters).map prod.fst
      have hn := SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison_natural S.substitutionParameters
        S.originalProjection (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d)
      dsimp only [originalProjection] at hn
      dsimp only [substitutionAlgebra]
      rw [← Category.assoc, hn]
      repeat' apply coprod.hom_ext
      all_goals
        simp [SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression, SyntaxPolynomial.eval,
          SyntaxPolynomial.sumFunctor, SyntaxPolynomial.productFunctor,
          SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison_inl_assoc,
          SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison_inr_assoc, originalProjection,
          equalitySubstitutionPair, relationSubstitutionPair, negationSubstitutionPair,
          implicationSubstitutionPair, equalityConstructor, relationConstructors,
          negationConstructor, negationInjection, implicationConstructor,
          S.quantifierSubstitution_original, ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      all_goals simp [SyntaxPolynomial.parameterComparison, SyntaxPolynomial.power,
        SyntaxPolynomial.eval, SyntaxPolynomial.productFunctor, quantifierConstructor] <;> rfl

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.substitutionFold_original
references.source:
theorem substitutionFold_original :
    S.substitutionFold ≫ S.substitutionOriginalHom.f =
      𝟙 (constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a.1,
        constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a.2) := by
  let A := SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
    (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d) S.algebra S.substitutionParameters
  let f : A ⟶ S.substitutionAlgebra := (S.stable S.substitutionParameters).to _
  have h : f ≫ S.substitutionOriginalHom = 𝟙 A :=
    (S.stable S.substitutionParameters).hom_ext _ _
  exact congrArg Endofunctor.Algebra.Hom.f h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.substitutionFold_unique
references.source:
theorem substitutionFold_unique
    (f : (constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a.1,
      constantFamily S.substitutionParameters S.algebra.a.2) ⟶ S.substitutionAlgebra.a)
    (hf : (SyntaxPolynomial.jointFunctor
      ((SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d).withParameters S.substitutionParameters)
      ((SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d).withParameters S.substitutionParameters)).map
        f ≫ S.substitutionAlgebra.str =
      (SyntaxPolynomial.algebraWithParameters (SyntaxPolynomial.termExpression V σ d)
        (SyntaxPolynomial.formulaExpression V π d) S.algebra S.substitutionParameters).str ≫ f) :
    f = S.substitutionFold :=
  S.foldWithParameters_unique _ _ f hf

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.termSubstitution
references.source:
def termSubstitution : S.algebra.a.1 ⨯ S.substitutionParameters ⟶ S.algebra.a.1 :=
  (prod.braiding _ _).hom ≫ S.substitutionFold.1.left ≫ prod.snd ≫ prod.snd

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.formulaSubstitutionOption
CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.admissibility_complemented
references.source:
theorem admissibility_complemented :
    IsCompl (Subobject.mk S.admissibleInclusion)
      (Subobject.mk (pullback.fst S.formulaSubstitutionOption coprod.inl)) :=
  (SumFibers.complementary S.formulaSubstitutionOption).symm

def:deductively-closed.label: def:deductively-closed
def:deductively-closed.reconstruction: Definition of a closed subobject is existence of an H-algebra on a mono with matching conclusion.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ClosedUnder
references.source:
def ClosedUnder (H : Over F ⥤ Over F) {T : D} (m : T ⟶ F) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (H.obj (Over.mk m) ⟶ Over.mk m)

thm:least-theorem-subobject.label: thm:least-theorem-subobject
thm:least-theorem-subobject.reconstruction: Assume an actual initial H-algebra. Factor its conclusion c=me. Products and pullbacks preserve regular epis and finite coproducts preserve coequalizers, so He is regular epi.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.RulePresentation.least_theorem_subobject
references.source:
theorem least_theorem_subobject (A : Endofunctor.Algebra R.inference)
    (hA : IsInitial A) :
    ClosedUnder R.inference (image.ι A.a.hom) ∧
      ∀ {U : D} (m : U ⟶ F) [Mono m], ClosedUnder R.inference m →
        ∃ w : image A.a.hom ⟶ U, w ≫ m = image.ι A.a.hom :=
  least_closed_image R.inference A R.inference_preservesRegularEpis hA

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.RulePresentation.inference
references.source:
def inference : Over F ⥤ Over F where
  obj Q := Over.mk (Sigma.desc (R.ruleConclusion Q))
  map {Q Q'} h := Over.homMk (Limits.Sigma.map (R.ruleMap h)) (by
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    simp [ruleConclusion])
  map_id Q := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    simp
  map_comp h k := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    simp

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.RulePresentation.inference_preservesRegularEpis
references.source:
theorem inference_preservesRegularEpis :
    PreservesUnderlyingRegularEpis R.inference := by
  intro Q Q' h hh
  have := hh
  change IsRegularEpi (Limits.Sigma.map (R.ruleMap h))
  exact sigma_map_regularEpi (R.ruleMap h) (fun i => R.ruleMap_regularEpi h i)

thm:first-order-theory.label: thm:first-order-theory
thm:first-order-theory.reconstruction: If this H_A has initial algebra, its image is least rule-closed formula subobject, and the image of sentence-only conclusions is its pullback by the sentence inclusion (regular-image stability).

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.generated_firstOrder_theory
references.source:
theorem generated_firstOrder_theory {A : D} (axioms : A ⟶ S.sentenceObject)
    (P : Endofunctor.Algebra (S.logicalRules axioms).inference) (hP : IsInitial P) :
    ClosedUnder (S.logicalRules axioms).inference (image.ι P.a.hom) ∧
      (∀ {T : D} (m : T ⟶ S.algebra.a.2) [Mono m],
        ClosedUnder (S.logicalRules axioms).inference m →
          ∃ w : image P.a.hom ⟶ T, w ≫ m = image.ι P.a.hom) ∧
      (∃ a : S.logicalParameters ⨿ A ⟶ image P.a.hom,
        a ≫ image.ι P.a.hom = coprod.desc S.logicalAxioms
          (axioms ≫ S.sentenceInclusion)) ∧
      imageSubobject (pullback.snd P.a.hom S.sentenceInclusion) =
        (Subobject.pullback S.sentenceInclusion).obj (imageSubobject P.a.hom) := by
  have h := firstOrder_least_image S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
    S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor P hP
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2, firstOrder_axioms_factor S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
    S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor P,
    sentenceImage_subobject P.a.hom S.sentenceInclusion⟩

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.logicalAxioms
references.source:
def logicalAxioms : S.logicalParameters ⟶ S.algebra.a.2 :=
  coprod.desc (coprod.desc (coprod.desc (coprod.desc
    (coprod.desc (coprod.desc S.hilbertOne S.hilbertTwo) S.hilbertThree)
      S.hilbertInstantiation) S.hilbertDistribution) S.hilbertReflexivity) S.hilbertEquality

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.CategoricalSyntax.logicalRules
references.source:
def logicalRules {A : D} (axioms : A ⟶ S.sentenceObject) :
    RulePresentation S.algebra.a.2 2 :=
  firstOrderRules S.logicalAxioms S.sentenceInclusion axioms
    S.quantifierConstructor S.implicationConstructor

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.firstOrder_least_image
references.source:
theorem firstOrder_least_image (logical : L ⟶ F) (sentence : S ⟶ F)
    (axioms : A ⟶ S) (all : V ⨯ F ⟶ F) (imp : F ⨯ F ⟶ F)
    (P : Endofunctor.Algebra (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).inference)
    (hP : IsInitial P) :
    ClosedUnder (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).inference
      (image.ι P.a.hom) ∧
      ∀ {T : D} (m : T ⟶ F) [Mono m],
        ClosedUnder (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).inference m →
          ∃ w : image P.a.hom ⟶ T, w ≫ m = image.ι P.a.hom :=
  (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).least_theorem_subobject P hP

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.firstOrder_axioms_factor
references.source:
theorem firstOrder_axioms_factor (logical : L ⟶ F) (sentence : S ⟶ F)
    (axioms : A ⟶ S) (all : V ⨯ F ⟶ F) (imp : F ⨯ F ⟶ F)
    (P : Endofunctor.Algebra (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).inference) :
    ∃ a : L ⨿ A ⟶ image P.a.hom,
      a ≫ image.ι P.a.hom = coprod.desc logical (axioms ≫ sentence) := by
  refine ⟨(firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).nullaryToProof P ≫
    factorThruImage P.a.hom, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, image.fac]
  exact (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).nullaryToProof_conclusion P

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.sentenceImage_subobject
references.source:
theorem sentenceImage_subobject {P F S : D} (c : P ⟶ F) (j : S ⟶ F) :
    imageSubobject (pullback.snd c j) = (Subobject.pullback j).obj (imageSubobject c) := by
  change Subobject.mk (image.ι (pullback.snd c j)) =
    (Subobject.pullback j).obj (Subobject.mk (image.ι c))
  rw [Subobject.pullback_obj_mk (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (image.ι c) j)]
  exact Subobject.mk_eq_mk_of_comm _ _ (sentenceImageIso c j).symm
    (by simp [sentenceImageIso])

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone
references.source:
theorem firstOrder_sentence_image_monotone (logical : L ⟶ F) (sentence : S ⟶ F)
    (axioms : A ⟶ S) (axioms' : A' ⟶ S)
    (all : V ⨯ F ⟶ F) (imp : F ⨯ F ⟶ F)
    (k : A ⟶ A') (hk : k ≫ axioms' = axioms)
    (P : Endofunctor.Algebra (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms all imp).inference)
    (hP : IsInitial P)
    (P' : Endofunctor.Algebra (firstOrderRules logical sentence axioms' all imp).inference) :
    imageSubobject (pullback.snd P.a.hom sentence) ≤
      imageSubobject (pullback.snd P'.a.hom sentence) := by
  rw [sentenceImage_subobject, sentenceImage_subobject]
  exact (Subobject.pullback sentence).monotone
    (firstOrder_image_monotone logical sentence axioms axioms' all imp k hk P hP P')

lem:range-regular-image.label: lem:range-regular-image
lem:range-regular-image.reconstruction: In a split restriction category with regular total category and partial inverse r of the particular image mono m, mr fixes f; split any idempotent a fixing f and factor f through its monic inclusion to infer am=m. Thus mr=bar r=ran f.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.V46.range_regularImage
references.source:
theorem range_regularImage {X I Y : TotalCategory S} (e : X ⟶ I)
    (m : I ⟶ Y) [IsRegularEpi e] (r : Y.obj ⟶ I.obj)
    (hmr : m.hom ≫ r = 𝟙 I.obj) (hrm : r ≫ m.hom = rst r) :
    (Ranges.range (e.hom ≫ m.hom)).hom = r ≫ m.hom := by
  let a := Ranges.range (e.hom ≫ m.hom)
  have hreceives : (e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ a.hom = e.hom ≫ m.hom :=
    Ranges.receives _
  have hleast : a ≤ Idem.ofRestrict r := by
    apply Ranges.least
    change (e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ rst r = e.hom ≫ m.hom
    rw [← hrm]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc m.hom, hmr, Category.id_comp]
  obtain ⟨J, j, s, hj, hjs, hsj⟩ := Splits.splitting a
  let JT : TotalCategory S := ⟨J⟩
  let jT : JT ⟶ Y := ⟨j, hj⟩
  have : Mono jT := total_split_mono jT s hjs
  have hscomp : ((e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ s) ≫ j = e.hom ≫ m.hom := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hsj, hreceives]
  have hsf : isTotal ((e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ s) := by
    change rst ((e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ s) = 𝟙 X.obj
    rw [← rst_comp_of_isTotal _ hj, hscomp]
    exact isTotal_comp e.property m.property
  let sf : X ⟶ JT := ⟨(e.hom ≫ m.hom) ≫ s, hsf⟩
  have sq : CommSq sf e jT m := ⟨by apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext; exact hscomp⟩
  have hu : sq.lift.hom ≫ j = m.hom :=
    congrArg (fun k : I ⟶ Y => k.hom) sq.fac_right
  have hma : m.hom ≫ a.hom = m.hom := by
    rw [← hu, Category.assoc, ← hsj, ← Category.assoc j, hjs, Category.id_comp]
  have hother : Idem.ofRestrict r ≤ a := by
    change rst r ≫ a.hom = rst r
    rw [← hrm, Category.assoc, hma]
  have ha := le_antisymm hleast hother
  exact (congrArg Idem.hom ha).trans hrm.symm

prop:fork-cosheaves.label: prop:fork-cosheaves
prop:fork-cosheaves.reconstruction: Every cover of a proper open contains itself; covers of X without X contain L and R. Thus the pushout over D is exactly the remaining axiom. Restriction to these opens and extension by their pushout are inverse up to a natural isomorphism, with action on arrows forced by coprojections.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.EffectiveFork.totalEquivalence
references.source:
def totalEquivalence : Total ≌ (WalkingSpan ⥤ EnumerableCarriers.Total) where
  functor := totalFunctor
  inverse := fromFunctor
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => Iso.refl X) (by
    intro X Y f
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    apply Hom.ext
    · change f.hom.center ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.center
      simp
    · change f.hom.left ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.left
      simp
    · change f.hom.right ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f.hom.right
      simp)
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun F => spanIsoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
      (by change (F.map WalkingSpan.Hom.fst) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ _; simp)
      (by change (F.map WalkingSpan.Hom.snd) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ _; simp))
    (by
      intro F G f
      ext j
      rcases j with _ | (_ | _)
      all_goals simp [totalFunctor, fromFunctor, fromNatural])
  functor_unitIso_comp X := by
    ext j
    rcases j with _ | (_ | _)
    all_goals simp [totalFunctor, fromFunctor, totalDiagram, fromDiagram]

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.EffectiveFork.total_mono_iff_injective
references.source:
theorem total_mono_iff_injective {X Y : Total} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Mono f ↔ Injective f.hom := by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    letI : Mono f := hm
    apply injective_of_partialMono
    apply partial_mono_of_total_tests
    intro W u v hu hv he
    let u' : (⟨W⟩ : Total) ⟶ X := ⟨u, hu⟩
    let v' : (⟨W⟩ : Total) ⟶ X := ⟨v, hv⟩
    have he' : u' ≫ f = v' ≫ f := by
      apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
      exact he
    have huv := (cancel_mono f).mp he'
    exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom ≫ rst f.hom) huv
  · intro hi
    constructor
    intro W u v he
    apply WideSubcategory.hom_ext
    have hh := partialMono_of_injective f.hom hi u.hom v.hom
      (congrArg (fun k => k.hom) he)
    simpa only [show rst f.hom = 𝟙 X.obj from f.property, Category.comp_id] using hh

references.source:
theorem map_total {X Y : MonicSpanCategory} (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) :
    equivalence.functor.map (PartialMaps.ofTotal f) = f.hom := by
  change PartialSpans.inverse (𝟙 X.obj) ≫ f.hom = f.hom
  have h := PartialSpans.hom_inverse (𝟙 X.obj)
  change (𝟙 X.obj.obj : X.obj.obj ⟶ X.obj.obj) ≫
    PartialSpans.inverse (𝟙 X.obj) = 𝟙 X.obj.obj at h
  rw [Category.id_comp] at h
  rw [h, Category.id_comp]

theorem span_image {X Y : MonicSpanCategory} (s : PartialMaps.Raw X Y) :
    equivalence.functor.map (Ranges.range (PartialMaps.ofSpan s)).hom =
      (Ranges.range s.r.hom).hom := by
  rw [preserves_ranges]
  change (Ranges.range (PartialMapEquivalence.mapSpan
    (CategoryTheory.Equivalence.refl : Total ≌ Total) s).value).hom = _
  rw [span_range]
  rfl

    (PartialSpans.hom_inverse s.mono) s.map.hom

theorem span_pullback_range {X Y : Object} (s : PartialSpans.Span X Y)
    {P Z : Total} {p : P ⟶ s.apex} {q : P ⟶ Z} (g : Z ⟶ (⟨Y⟩ : Total))
    (h : IsPullback p q s.map g) :
    Ranges.range q.hom = Idem.pull g.hom (Ranges.range s.value) := by
  rw [span_range]
  exact EffectiveFork.pullback_image h

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.V46.ForkRangeStability.partial_range_stable
references.source:
theorem partial_range_stable {X Y : Object} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ s : PartialSpans.Span X Y, s.value = f ∧
      ∀ (Z : Total) (g : Z ⟶ (⟨Y⟩ : Total)),
        Ranges.range (pullback.snd s.map g).hom = Idem.pull g.hom (Ranges.range f) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := PartialSpans.Span.exists_value f
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  intro Z g
  rw [← hs]
  exact span_pullback_range s g (IsPullback.of_hasPullback s.map g)

lem:fork-dominance.label: lem:fork-dominance
lem:fork-dominance.reconstruction: Embed an arbitrary Y by coding its component inputs and both endpoint images in V₀, and coding endpoint elements at V_i. This is natural and injective, with c.e. images and inverse natural by injectivity. Thus obtains a restriction mono m:Y→V.

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.EffectiveFork.dominance
references.source:
theorem dominance (X : Object) :
    ∃ (m : X ⟶ V) (s : V ⟶ X), isTotal m ∧ m ≫ s = 𝟙 X ∧ s ≫ m = rst s := by
  let m := embedding X
  have hm : isTotal m := coherentEncoding_total X Computable.id Computable.id Computable.id
  have hi : Injective m := embedding_injective X
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := section_of_injective m hi
  have he := partialMono_of_injective m hi (m ≫ s) (𝟙 X)
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc, Category.id_comp] using hs.receives)
  rw [show rst m=𝟙 X from hm, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at he
  exact ⟨m,s,hm,he,hs.comp⟩

lem:fork-frames.label: lem:fork-frames

def productFrame : V ≅ product V V where

  inv := productFrameBackward
  hom_inv_id := Hom.ext
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse splitCenter mergeCenter
      splitCenter_computable mergeCenter_computable (fun _ _ => prod_support _)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (fun x _ => merge_split_center x))
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse splitEndpoint mergeEndpoint
      splitEndpoint_computable splitEndpoint_computable (fun _ _ => prod_support _)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (fun x _ => merge_split_endpoint x))
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse splitEndpoint mergeEndpoint
      splitEndpoint_computable splitEndpoint_computable (fun _ _ => prod_support _)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (fun x _ => merge_split_endpoint x))
  inv_hom_id := Hom.ext
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse mergeCenter splitCenter
      mergeCenter_computable splitCenter_computable (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      (fun _ _ => prod_support _) (fun x _ => split_merge_center x))
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse mergeEndpoint splitEndpoint
      splitEndpoint_computable splitEndpoint_computable (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      (fun _ _ => prod_support _) (fun x _ => split_merge_endpoint x))
    (EnumerableCarriers.totalFromFunction_inverse mergeEndpoint splitEndpoint
      splitEndpoint_computable splitEndpoint_computable (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      (fun _ _ => prod_support _) (fun x _ => split_merge_endpoint x))

references.source:
theorem idempotent_splits_through_range {X : C} (f : X ⟶ X) (hf : f ≫ f = f) :
    ∃ (Y : C) (m : Y ⟶ X) (s : X ⟶ Y),
      isTotal m ∧ m ≫ s = 𝟙 Y ∧ s ≫ m = f := by
  let a := Ranges.range f
  obtain ⟨Y, m, r, hm, hmr, hrm⟩ := Splits.splitting a
  have haf : a.hom ≫ f = a.hom := by
    have h := Ranges.agreement f f (𝟙 X) (by simpa only [Category.comp_id] using hf)
    simpa only [Category.comp_id] using h
  have hma : m ≫ a.hom = m := by
    rw [← hrm, ← Category.assoc, hmr, Category.id_comp]
  have hmf : m ≫ f = m := by
    calc
      m ≫ f = (m ≫ a.hom) ≫ f := by rw [hma]
      _ = m ≫ a.hom := by rw [Category.assoc, haf]
      _ = m := hma
  refine ⟨Y, m, f ≫ r, hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hmf, hmr]
  · rw [Category.assoc, hrm]
    exact Ranges.receives f

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.fork_not_restriction_equivalent
references.source:
theorem fork_not_restriction_equivalent
    (e : EffectiveFork.Recursion.Rec ≌ ClassicalPrograms.Rec)
    (hF : PreservesRestriction e.functor) (hG : PreservesRestriction e.inverse) : False := by
  let R := EffectiveFork.Recursion.realization
  have hR : PreservesRestriction R := fun f => EffectiveFork.Recursion.realization_rst f
  let eR := hR.totalEquivalence
  let X := eR.inverse.obj ⟨EffectiveFork.terminalFork⟩
  have hX : IsTerminal X := EffectiveFork.terminalFork_isTerminal.isTerminalObj eR.inverse _
  have h5 : Nat.card (Idem X.obj)=5 :=
    (hR.terminal_idem_card X ⟨EffectiveFork.terminalFork⟩ hX
      EffectiveFork.terminalFork_isTerminal).trans EffectiveFork.terminal_idem_card
  let eS := splittingEquivalenceOfRestriction e hF hG
  have hS : PreservesRestriction eS.functor := hF.splitFunctor_rst
  let Y := EnumerableCarriers.inclusion_rst.totalFunctor.obj
    (⟨EnumerableCarriers.terminalCarrier⟩ : EnumerableCarriers.Total)
  have hY : IsTerminal Y := EnumerableCarriers.terminalIsTerminal.isTerminalObj
    EnumerableCarriers.inclusion_rst.totalEquivalence.functor _
  have h2 : Nat.card (Idem Y.obj)=2 :=
    (EnumerableCarriers.inclusion_rst.terminal_idem_card
      ⟨EnumerableCarriers.terminalCarrier⟩ Y EnumerableCarriers.terminalIsTerminal hY).symm.trans
      EnumerableCarriers.terminal_idem_card
  have hc := hS.terminal_idem_card X Y hX hY
  rw [h5,h2] at hc
  norm_num at hc

references.source:
theorem no_lift_of_summand_inverse_images
    (s : PartialFun.of ℕ ⟶ coprod (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ))
    (h₀ : Idem.pull s (summand0 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ)) =
      (rangeFunctor K).mapIdem separatorComplement)
    (h₁ : Idem.pull s (summand1 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ)) =
      (rangeFunctor K).mapIdem separator) :
    ¬ ∃ ℓ : N K ⟶ coprod (N K) (N K),
      (inclusion K).map ℓ = s ≫ ((rangeFunctor K).comparison (N K) (N K)).hom :=
  no_lift_of_compatible_restriction (inducedRestriction_eq K) (rangeFunctor K)
    (tau K) (tau_isTuring K) (parityIso K) (inclusion_nonzero K) _ _
    ((rangeFunctor K).map_complementary separator_complementary)
    ((rangeFunctor K).map_mono pair0_le_separator)
    ((rangeFunctor K).map_mono pair1_le_separatorComplement) s h₀ h₁

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.OracleComputation.Restricted.no_lift_of_output_summands
references.source:
theorem no_lift_of_output_summands (s : ℕ →. (ℕ ⊕ ℕ))
    (h₀ : ∀ n, (∃ y : ℕ, Sum.inl y ∈ s n) ↔ n ∉ A)
    (h₁ : ∀ n, (∃ y : ℕ, Sum.inr y ∈ s n) ↔ n ∈ A) :
    ¬ ∃ ℓ : N K ⟶ coprod (N K) (N K), (inclusion K).map ℓ = s := by
  let f : PartialFun.of ℕ ⟶ coprod (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ) := s
  have hleft : Idem.pull f (summand0 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ)) =
      (rangeFunctor K).mapIdem separatorComplement := by
    apply PartialFunctions.support_injective
    change PartialFunctions.support (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) _ =
      PartialFunctions.support (PartialFunctions.setIdem (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) (Aᶜ : Set ℕ))
    rw [PartialFunctions.support_pull f _,
      PartialFunctions.support_setIdem (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) (Aᶜ : Set ℕ)]
    ext n
    change (∃ y : ℕ ⊕ ℕ, y ∈ s n ∧ y ∈ PartialFunctions.support
      (summand0 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ))) ↔ n ∉ A
    simp only [ClassicalPrograms.mem_support_summand0]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hy, z, rfl⟩
      exact (h₀ n).mp ⟨z, hy⟩
    · intro hn
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (h₀ n).mpr hn
      exact ⟨_, hz, z, rfl⟩
  have hright : Idem.pull f (summand1 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ)) =
      (rangeFunctor K).mapIdem separator := by
    apply PartialFunctions.support_injective
    change PartialFunctions.support (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) _ =
      PartialFunctions.support (PartialFunctions.setIdem (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) A)
    rw [PartialFunctions.support_pull f _,
      PartialFunctions.support_setIdem (X := PartialFun.of ℕ) A]
    ext n
    change (∃ y : ℕ ⊕ ℕ, y ∈ s n ∧ y ∈ PartialFunctions.support
      (summand1 (PartialFun.of ℕ) (PartialFun.of ℕ))) ↔ n ∈ A
    simp only [ClassicalPrograms.mem_support_summand1]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hy, z, rfl⟩
      exact (h₁ n).mp ⟨z, hy⟩
    · intro hn
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (h₁ n).mpr hn
      exact ⟨_, hz, z, rfl⟩
  rintro ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩
  apply no_lift_of_summand_inverse_images f hleft hright
  refine ⟨ℓ, ?_⟩
  rw [rangeFunctor_comparison_hom]
  exact hℓ.trans (Category.comp_id f).symm

  intro f
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_arrowOfIndex T' (objectCode X) (objectCode Y) f

references.name: CategoricalEssentialIncompleteness.LocalConnectedness.SyntacticExtension.map_isTuringMorphism

theorem map_isTuringMorphism {W X Y : CodedProgramCategory T}
    (τ : nearProd W X ⟶ Y) (hτ : RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism τ) :
    RecursionCategory.IsTuringMorphism ((functor T T').map τ) := by
  intro V φ
  let V₀ : CodedProgramCategory T := object T (objectCode V)
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ⟩ := map_surjective T T' (nearProd V₀ X) Y φ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, heq⟩ := hτ V₀ φ₀
  refine ⟨(functor T T').map g, (rangeFunctor T T').map_total g hg, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun k => (functor T T').map k) heq
  rw [(functor T T').map_comp, map_product, (functor T T').map_id, hφ] at h
  exact h
